abstract: In the logistics networks, the distribution center links the supply point and demand point, which severs as a bridge between them and it is very important. So a good location for distribution center can surely enhance the profits of logistics industry. After introducing the concept of distribution center and the significance of site testing, this paper proposed the principles and steps of site testing of logistics distribution center. Then, among the numerous site testing methods, we chose the Integer Programming method to select a site. Finally, through model establishment and model solving, we get the best location for city distribution center.

articleTitle: Research of Refueling customer classifications based on kernel clustering algorithm under the organic combined model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The kernel clustering algorithm under the organic combined model of the GA and the PSO was put forward. According to the customers' data of certain, this kernel clustering algorithm was applied to classify the Refueling customers into three groups: the first group includes 3 customers, 5 and 7 customers for the second group and the third group respectively. The result shows that the samples can be classified and the center of mass can be obtained using the data description based on kernel methods. But the clustering region is different when the σ of kernel method gets the different value. This makes the clustering process to be complex, also spends the longer time. While kernel method's clustering algorithm organically combined with the PSO and GA can get the same result in the shorter time and the calculation is simpler.

articleTitle: Research on OpenGL's application in precision seed-metering device designing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper puts forward a DEM design software employing OpenGL as back end display software, for improving the seed metering design precision in agriculture production, introducing the basic principle and modeling method of OpenGL. In the end, a practice design of precision seed-metering device is cited as an example for proving this method to be in effect.

articleTitle: Identification of peer-to-peer traffic based on process fingerprint
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In local area network (LAN), the large-scaled peer-to-peer (P2P) application has aroused our attention by its convenience as well as the problems inborn. The network traffic and the resources consumed have severely influenced the usage of other network application, and this makes the study of identification on P2P traffic much more significant. This article advances an identification method based on the host process fingerprint, which can be done on the client computer with P2P application on. Experiments show that method has a high classification capability on the P2P traffic in LAN.

articleTitle: An integrated preprocessing method on real estate file images recognition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an effective image preprocessing chain for estate electron file to eliminate most of the effect of noise and enhance the recognition performance. Owing to its' diversity and particularity, the processing of real estate file images is extremely significant compared with the general images', so a integrated preprocessing chain is firstly applied for images of estate file .It includes image graying and binarization, the smoothing of the images, the removing of separate noise, image correcting and the effective image segmentation. The experimental result shows that this presented chain can effectively process the real estate file images according to its characteristic and achieve a high average precision.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis of an MRF damper on milling chatter control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The MRF (Magnetorheological Fluid) working mode and mechanics model were firstly constructed, an MRF damper system was formed by designing MRF damper, application to the milling chatter control was studied. Theoretical analysis results show that the MRF damper's stiffness and damp increase with magnetic field strength's increment, the main vibration system amplitude decreases with magnetic field strength's increment. The MRF damper's control vibration capacity increases with magnetic field strength's increment, however, magnetic field strength value is bigger, its control vibration effect isn't certainly better, it exists a proper value. Milling chatter phenomenon can be controlled if magnetic field strength can be properly chosen.

articleTitle: Research of architecture pattern based on .NET distributed system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In the Distributed System design, a .NET based N-layer Architecture pattern is proposed. It separates the Business Logic Layer, Data Access Layer and Presentation Layer; effectively reduces the redundancy in coding, thus promotes an improved expandability for the entire system. A specific implementation method is presented regarding the Data Service Layer and Business Service Layer, thereby better fulfilling the needs to rapidly develop Rapid Application Development.

articleTitle: Research on water resources decision support system integrated with facilities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Water Resources and Facilities closely linked to Agricultural production is one of critical factors of restricting sustainable development. The existing system has not integrated all of the spatial data about water resources. This article introduces design and implementation of water resources Decision supports system integrated with facilities in detail. The system design goal and basic principle are put forward firstly. Then the system function is analyzed including map operation, data management, data query, buffer analyze and thematic-map editing, flood simulation, and so on. It is tested with the spatial data of Jingzhou city after implemented based on SuperMap. The result shows that the system can provide decision supports for managers such as the flood control and drainage scheduling, water conservancy construction and water resource analysis.

articleTitle: The design of analog video data grabber system based on TMS320VC33 and SAA7111A
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Analog video data grabber system based on TMS320VC33 and SAA7111A is proposed for a kind of automatic optical alignment measuring device. System uses the enhanced video processing chip SAA7111A to complete A/D conversion. The function of SAA7111A and the register configuration method of I2C Bus are introduced in the paper. System uses FPGA to control video data grabber and collaborative work of DSP. DSP processes video data. The paper gives design method of hardware and software. Experimental results indicate that the system can satisfy the requirements.

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization based on improved social cognitive optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Social cognitive optimization (SCO) algorithm is presented based on human intelligence with the social cognitive theory. This paper improves the SCO algorithm with shrinking search in the Simulating Fisher fishing Optimization algorithm. Reactive power optimization is a typical high-dimensional, nonlinear, discontinuous problem. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm has high convergence speed and is easy to implement, but it also exists precocious phenomenon. Considering minimum network loss as the objective function, make the simulation in standard IEEE-14 and IEEE-30 node system. The results show that the improved social cognitive optimization algorithm can achieve a better global optimal solution compared with PSO and SCO algorithms.

articleTitle: The optimization design and FEA analysis in car sunroof design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper the reverse engineering and software CATIA was used to create 3D model and virtual prototype of the car sunroof motion mechanism. Then the model was imported into Software ADAMS to create the virtual kinematics model. After that parameterized the model and an optimization design was carried out with sunroof motion mechanism in software ADAMS. Finally a transient dynamical FEA simulation and analysis about the motion mechanism were done with software ANSYS Workbench. The research work in this paper can not only improve the design quality and efficiency of car sunroof ,and also shorten the product development period and cost.

articleTitle: Dynamic stress analysis of automatic weapons breech mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The impacting dynamic stresses of automatic weapon's key elements(breech mechanism) are analyzed and studied in this paper. The distribution and magnitude of dynamic stresses of the breech mechanism have been obtained with LS-DYNA when they are impacted. The intensity of the breech mechanism has been checked. The obtained results in this paper are of significant importance for breech mechanism design.

articleTitle: A study on Chinese students' beliefs and attitude towards CALL
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This study attempts to explore Chinese students' beliefs and attitude towards Computer Assisted language learning (CALL) and the difference in attitude and beliefs towards CALL between good language learners (GL) and poor language learners (PL). The author designed the questionnaire composed by two parts - CALL Belief and Information Input Channel and Load via computers and internet. 100 valid questionnaires were adopted. The results of questionnaire and CET4 scores were analyzed by SPSS 13.0. Descriptive statistics was obtained to see the overall patterns of students' attitude and belief towards CALL. The differences in attitude and belief between GL and PL were examined by a Test. The major findings are: 1) most students are optimistic about the technology-based language learning. 2) Computer and internet can help learners process and understand English learning material better and faster. 3) No significant difference of learners' attitude and beliefs towards CALL between GL and PL.

articleTitle: The static security analysis based on predicting section
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In view of the limitation of lack of forward looking in current static security analysis ,we form the predicting section by using the date of short-term load forecasting, the power generating plan data and the change date of grid structure and offer the static security based on this section. It has a great significance to power system security.

articleTitle: Research of the risk assessment of thermal power project investment based on Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper according to the investment phase of thermal power projects analyzes the risk factors affecting project investment, on this basis, establishes risk assessment index system of thermal power project investment, and proposes a viable risk assessment model based on BP (Back Propagation) neural network. This model uses BP neural network's self-learning feature, through amending the weight constantly in the training process, to make the network's actual output vector be close to the expecting output value gradually. Through simulation of the example by MATLAB neural network tool, the author verifies the reliability of the model, the study of the example shows that this method provides an effective management tool for the risk assessment of thermal power project investment.

articleTitle: The study of analysis technology of automotive exhaust
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This topic is raised in the current that the vehicle exhaust pollution has been increasing higher and higher standards of automobile exhaust testing, with the aim of eliminating environmental interference and improves the accuracy of the exhaust gas. The system overcomes the shortcomings of the existing automobile exhaust gas analyzer, using the compensation method to judge the exhaust gas .the system uses different formula to calculate for the different parameters after obtained the data from the sensor, and will eventually provide a correct and accurate results when it compensated the signal affected by the environment by different methods.

articleTitle: On the optimal solution of primal optimization problem of one-class SVM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: One-class SVM, which is a good machine learning method, has recently attracted wide interest. In this paper, we focus on the properties of the optimal solution to its primal optimization problem. We first prove that the optimal solution with respect to the normal vector of the hyperplane is unique, and then present and prove the necessary and sufficient conditions for the case where the optimal solution with respect to the bias of the hyperplane is not unique. At last, we present a method to compute the bias in the case where the optimal solution with respect to the bias is not unique.

articleTitle: The positioning precision analysis of the ball screw drive system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The ball screw drive system is obtained widespread application in the modern machine. Along with the improving of feeding velocity and working precision, its positioning precision becomes more and more important. Considering the bearing stiffness and the contact deformation between the worktable and the screw, using boundary conditions and matching conditions, the vibration frequency equation of the screw is derived and the mode shape of the screw is solved. Longitudinal and torsional vibration of the screw and vibration of the worktable are studied. Dynamic model of the ball screw drive system of machines is established using Lagrange equation. The model is analyzed by the mode superposition and Runge-Kutta method to calculate the transient response of the worktable. The effect of the system parameters on the worktable's vibration are studied to supply a base for designing the drive system.

articleTitle: On the current situation of developing RFID middleware in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper is intended to reveal the problems existing in domestic RFID middleware development. It contrasted the RFID middleware developing situation of Chinese and foreign countries' though the developing companies and brands, then it analyzed domestic demand, the developers' actions, the barriers of closed-loop applications, developing strategy, etc. The author thinks that domestic industry of RFID middleware gets into trouble now, and to get rid of the adverse situation, the internal and external troubles must be overcome. The most important is to create RFID middleware brands of Chinese own, form the solid RFID industry chain, and select the appropriate marketing strategy. The paper's innovation is that its analysis is combined the behaviors of supply and demand sides, and not based on single case.

articleTitle: A novel evolutionary algorithm for the traveling salesman problem
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The traveling salesman problem (TSP) is a famous NP-hard problem. The established evolutionary algorithms (EAs) cannot get satisfactory solutions of large or even medium scale TSP instances. To change this situation, a effective EA based on inver-over operator is introduced. In this algorithm, two novel crossover operators, the segment replacing crossover and the order adjusting crossover, are proposed. Moreover, a mechanism for changing the crossover and the mutation rate of the inver-over operator according to generations and a parameter, the critical value, is employed. The results of the experiment show that this new algorithm outperforms the basic EA based on the inver-over operator in all the 4 instances.

articleTitle: Analysis of atmospheric pressure and temperature changes on the image quality of aerial camera
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper starts from the study of the aerial camera's work environment, analyzes the temperature and atmosphere pressure changes on aerial camera's imaging quality of influence. Point out that when the altitude of the camera changes, atmospheric pressure and temperature of constant change, so the camera's optical focal surface position changes, thus affecting the image quality of the camera, causing changes in the camera's focal surface optical, and affecting the camera's image quality. Summarize the rules that the temperature and pressure influence the image quality of the camera in aerial environment. Analyze the various environmental conditions on the impact of camera's image quality. For different types of camera, put forward the corresponding convergence compensation method, and provides a reference value to the development of the aerial camera.

articleTitle: A non-uniform regularization image reconstruction algorithm for electrical capacitance tomography
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An non-uniform regularization algorithm for electrical capacitance tomography is presented, and the regularization matrix of the new algorithm is constructed using a combination of an identity matrix and inhomogeneous weighted Laplacian operator related to the gradient magnitude of the sensitivity. Simulation experimentations have been performed to verify that the new regularization algorithm is capable of reconstructing superior image quality over the standard Tikhonov regularization.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of a BF561-based binocular image acquisition system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to achieve binocular image acquisition, such a binocular system is designed, both on hardware and software. The system consists of an upper computer and a lower computer, while the lower computer is divided into two subsystems. Based on BF561 microprocessor, the subsystem of the lower computer acquires image data from MT9V032 and transmits them to the upper computer through USB. With their cooperation, the two subsystems expose image simultaneously and send them to the upper computer alternately. In this way binocular acquisition is fulfilled. The upper computer sends out instructions to the lower computer and receives image data. It also processes these data according to specific applications. Tests show the whole system works well and can be put into practical use.

articleTitle: An improved chaos immune genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In the paper we present an improving immune genetic algorithm based on chaos theory. The over-spread character and randomness of chaos can be used to initialize population and improve the searching speed, and the initial value sensitivity of chaos can be used to enlarge the searching space. To avoid the local optimization, the algorithm renews population and enhances the diversity of population by using density calculation of immune theory and adjusting new chaos sequence. To increase precision after the overlapping and mutation, the chaos also is adopted to carry on the local optimization nearby the optimal solution. The experimental results show that the immune genetic algorithm based on chaos theory can search the result of the optimization and evidently improve the convergent speed and astringency.

articleTitle: Mechanism research on the electrical discharge WED machining of engineering ceramics materials
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: We make an experimental research of WEDM on boron carbide engineering ceramics, aiming at the target that how to improve the machining efficiency of engineering ceramics materials. The principle of electrical discharge machining on engineering ceramics materials is introduced. We also discuss how is the speed of engineering ceramics WEDM influenced by electrical parameter, by the research of WEDM processing on boron carbide engineering ceramics. This research has great significance to further deepen basic theory of EDM technology and to promote the use of this technology in practical life.

articleTitle: A new decapsulating the frame method for DVB-S2 based on RM code
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The structure of the Physical Layer Frame (PLHFRAME) is flexible for DVB-S2 system. At the receiver, it is critical for decapsulating the frame design. By further analyzing the structure of the PLHFRAME, we find some useful properties and also introduce some optimizations into the algorithm. The algorithm is based on a first order Reed-Muller (RM) code to achieve decapsulating the frame. The design scheme has implemented on Xilinx Virtex xc4vlx25 FPGA. Hardware test results show that the new scheme can be achieved under large carrier frequency offset (as large as 5MHz at 25MSps) and low SNR threshold of-2.5dB.

articleTitle: Mechanical behaviour of self-piercing riveted two-layer joints with different surface treatment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The self-piercing riveted (SPR) joints mechanical properties of coating on the behavior and quality between aluminum alloy and steel sheets was researched. NG5754 aluminum and cold rolled ST12 steel were used for this test. The Zinc-plated and E-coated were applied to the ST12 sheets. The test results showed that a coating on the surface of the ST12 sheets would affect the interlock quality in terms of interlock distance, head height and piercing material thickness. Analysis of interlock sections indicated that the SPR process needed various setting parameters for uncoated and coated sheets in order to achieve satisfied joints results. The research has also demonstrated that both Zinc-plated and E-coated affected the interlock strength and failure mechanism.

articleTitle: The characteristic of EMP electromagnetic power variation influence limit cycle in power systems in a weakly non-linear system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The article researched the parameters fluctuation of load and the angle oscillatory caused by mechanical power fluctuations, built a mathematics model of one machine infinity bus system. Using the direct average method, it also researched power angle characteristic by the amplitude of load variation and the mechanical power fluctuations. The simulation result shows that periodic disturbance about the mechanical power and may existence uniqueness of limit cycle. It may existence more than one limit cycles under periodic disturbance about parameters of electromagnetic power, and the sub-harmonic resonance may be observed. The above phenomena are all related to structure of nonlinear dynamic systems and the system's running states.

articleTitle: Research on vendor selection in serviced-oriented manufacturing enterprises based on FWNN
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To cope with complexity and new demands for vendor selection in service-oriented manufacturing enterprises, a strategy for vendor selection applying FWNN (fuzzy wavelet neural network) was presented in this paper. The strategy, which combines fuzzy theory with artificial neural network effectively, consists of two parts. The first part makes full use of fuzzy system, with strong competency in knowledge representation, to convert fuzzy input parameters into crisp parameters. And the artificial neural network was applied to overcome adverse effects resulting from vendor selection of non-liner and dynamic property in the second part. In addition, the simulation was made to check the performance of the algorithm based on FWNN. The simulation results indicate that this method can implement real-time dynamic evaluation and rapid selection under the service-oriented manufacturing environment.

articleTitle: Application of compass synchronizing clock in mobile phase-comparison
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper presents a method of simultaneous measurements of voltage/current for method of mobile phase-comparison in fault location of distribution network, using 1PPS and UTC in COMPASS. The COMPASS timing module selected is introduced briefly. A hardware and software platform based on ARM is designed for the testing and verification of 1PPS interface accuracy. The serial communication between COMPASS timing module and ARM9 is realized by a program coded with C# on the .NET Framework 3.5 platform, which can receive and abstract the information of UTC etc. Details of related experiments are given and the experimental results demonstrate that the method proposed in this paper is feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis of energy consumption of Hebei based on energy consumption coefficient of elasticity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Economic development needs massive energy. Energy consumption elasticity coefficient can directly reflect the relationship between economic development and energy-consumption. This paper analyzed historical data of the energy consumption elasticity from 1984 to 2009 of Hebei, made a gray prediction based on wavelet denoising, and got forecast data for the next decade. And the results showed that, energy consumption coefficient of elasticity of Hebei Province will maintain between 0.5 and 1 over the next decade, but revealed a slow upward trend. Finally, proposed some suggestions combined with the actual situation, so as to provide reference for decision-maker to reduce energy consumption in Hebei Province.

articleTitle: A dynamic threshold-based packet scheduling scheme for Qos sensitive applications
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: QoS sensitive applications have become increasingly popular. This paper presents end-to-end QoS control techniques to improve the network usage factor and the destination buffer utilization of the application. The data scheduling process of the QoS sensitive applications has been described. An analytical modeling of QoS performance has been put forward. End-to-end QoS evaluation metrics have been deduced, and a dynamic threshold-based packet scheduling scheme has been proposed. Simulation experiment has been performed and the results show that the proposed algorithm improves the end-to-end QoS performance of the QoS sensitive applications.

articleTitle: The visually interval algorithm for the problem of the constraint global optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper gave a visually interval algorithm for the global optimal solution to solve the problem of the constraint global optimization. This algorithm ensured that the problem cannot fall into the local optimal solution and improved the convergence speed through using local lipschitz constants. This paper proved the convergence of the algorithm, and numerical examples showed that the algorithm is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research of the design of the ERP application evaluation system based on the module method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to slove the current evaluation system's problems of fixed targets, the small scope and the lack of flexibility, this paper established a flexible framework of the evaluation system and introduced a method to filter out the most appropriate indicators. With the module method we constructed the framework of the evaluation system, the framework was composed by a certain number of independent modules and each module contained all the indicators related topics and was scalable. Within each module the entropy method was used to filter out the appropriate indicators to expand the evaluation system. Case study indicates that this is a practical application of highly effective evaluation system construction method, and makes it possible to build a flexible evaluation system for the specific enterprise.

articleTitle: Design of hub'flop amount measurement and detection system based on Freescale
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper describes the hub'flop amount measuring machine control system design and basic principle in detail. The whole control system uses MC9S12DP256 as the core of the device for measurement, control and data analysis, which can be used as the controller of the measuring instrument to control and communication with PC data transfer control. The peripheral interfaces are distributed according to the control system requirements and to achieve precise control of the stepper motor as well as the probe start and stop within a specified amount of pre-press up and down, horizontal movement through MC9S12DP256.

articleTitle: Adaptive redundant second generation wavelet packet in mine hoist reducer fault detection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The second generation wavelet is a new developed wavelet theory and it has been widely used in signal analysis and processing. This paper analyzes the constructor of adaptive redundant second generation wavelet packet and applies it into mine hoist reducer fault detection. Combining with fault mechanism of reducer, adaptive redundant second generation wavelet packet detected the fault style and fault reasons of reducer effectively, so it is better and efficient.

articleTitle: The XML filtration based on hash table and stream index
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to skip the invalid elements of the XML document,we proposed a new XML filtering method based on hash table and stream index.The hash table stores the location information of the elements, in order to judge the relations of the elements; the stream index locates the elements accurately, in order to skip the invalid elements quickly. The experimental results showed that our method had a good filtering performance,which could improve the efficiency obviously.

articleTitle: Self-adaption wavelet packet based on improved threshold algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Wavelet threshold de-noising algorithm is an effective method to remove noise in test signals. Based on the analysis of features presented by useful signals and noise signals in the working process of working bearings, a self-adaption of optimal decomposition level algorithm based on improved threshold wavelet packet to remove related white noise test is proposed. This algorithm can adaptively select the optimal decomposition levels that wavelet transforms according to the features and SNR of noise signals, so as to realize the best de-noising effect. It turns out from the engineering test that this algorithm can fully separate the useful information from the signals.

articleTitle: The research on adaptive measurement of angular acceleration for photoelectric servo turntable
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper proposes a new measurement method of angular acceleration for photoelectric servo turntable. Piezoelectric angular acceleration sensor is used to measure angular acceleration directly, Adaptive FIR filter based on LMS algorithm is established on DSP, by which angular acceleration signal can be filtered and corrected errors adaptively, then angular acceleration signals can be measured adaptively. This method avoids measurement errors and calculation noise by computing angular acceleration indirectly, thus improving measurement precision and making measurement results better than traditional methods. The gotten angular acceleration can be sent to servo control mechanism as feed forward control signals to improve control effects of servo turntable significantly.

articleTitle: The research on the furnace roller speed self-tuning PID control system of normalizing furnace
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For the computer control system of the normalizeing furnace for the medium steel plate, the paper mentions its subsystem, roll way control, and proposes a algorithm used on it. This algorithm is based on the self-adjusting artificial neural network to optimize the PID parameter. By adopting the algorithm, the roll way control system of normalizing furnace worked stably. In addition, it can significantly increase the performance of the products and production efficiency.

articleTitle: Dependability analysis of SSE based on parametric estimation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Software Security Evaluation (SSE) is an important activity for information security assurance. While the exiting SSE is very lack of dependability information for evaluation conclusion. In this paper, confidence measure was chosen as the indicator of dependability, and a quantitative analysis method based on parametric estimation theory was proposed. First, SSE conclusion was modeled as a stochastic variable conforms to the normal distribution. Second, confidence measure computing equation by big samples was given based on traditional mathematical statistics. Finally, to improve the practicability of the analysis method, the small samples situation was considered, and the confidence measure computing method was present based on Bayes statistics. This dependability analysis method is suit for SSE system which conclusion is explicit value. And it can bring confidence information of SSE to all the stakeholders of the target software for scientific decisions.

articleTitle: Structure of online judge system mode based on CDIO project design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on CDIO engineering teaching idea, the essay constructs online judge system model of software project design in network teaching platform with software testing technology. The essay solves the problem of automatically generated black-box test cases with genetic algorithm and structure test of abnormal operation program with the method of key points matching, improving learning efficiency of students.

articleTitle: Rule-based multi-constraint transit signal priority control strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to carry out the purpose of transit signal priority, by giving priority to transit, while not increasing negative impact on social vehicles, and improving operability, efficiency and effectiveness of the strategy, a rule-based multi-constraint transit signal priority control strategy is designed. The strategy consists of seven constraints, in order to solve conflicts between constraints maximum red times are set to ensure the benefits of non-priority vehicles. And two basic rules are designed for priority phase and non-priority phase, which can improve the effectiveness of transit through intersection. It is conducted from the results of VISSIM simulation that: under low, medium and high load of traffic volumes, there are nearly no differences of average delay per vehicle and person delay between two control strategies, while compared to actuated control strategy, the bus stopped delay of rule-based multi-constraint TSP control strategy are significantly reduced by 35%, 21% and 24%.

articleTitle: Transformer failure diagnosis based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A BP network model for transformer fault diagnosis is established based on the MATLAB environment in this paper. A large number of data samples are collected and tested, L_M algorithm is used for training samples and simulation in network model. The actual output is gained and made comparative study with the expected output. Finally, it confirms that this network model has a high accuracy and can be used for transformer fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research of the maximum transmission pile driving force of pile clamping mechanism under pile driving
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For being convenient for the design, improvement and use of pile clamping mechanism of hydraulic static pile driver, the static forces of pile clamping mechanism and prefabricated pile were researched and analyzed under pile driving; the contact between prefabricated pile and pile clamping jaws under pile driving was investigated. The equation of the maximum transmission pile driving force of pile clamping mechanism of hydraulic static pile driver was obtained. After studying and analyzing the equation, it was revealed that the maximum transmission pile driving force of pile clamping mechanism of hydraulic static pile driver is augmenting under pile driving by adding the distribution number of pile clamping mechanism in each layer, the number of contact surfaces between prefabricated pile and pile clamping jaws, static friction coefficient between upper, nether pile clamping jaw and prefabricated pile and oil pressure of pile clamping cylinder.

articleTitle: The application and development of Internet of Things with its solutions of restrictive factors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To solve the bottleneck of the development of Internet of Things, this paper offers a brief introduction of the concept and working principles of Internet of Things, reviewing its origin, its latest development both home and broad and its latest application domestically. By analyzing such five major problems of restricting its development as the core technology, industry standards, information security, communication protocol and IP address, the paper puts forward the corresponding solutions.

articleTitle: Properties of spin squeezing in the quantum kicked tops model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, by using QKT model, we give the changing relation between chaotic coefficient k and spin squeezing coefficient of two different definitions by numerical simulation calculation. The results show that the regular regions are stronger than chaotic ones in the classical phase space, the spin squeezed behavior is very strong, and the chaotic regions are stronger than regular ones in the classical phase space, the spin squeezed behavior is very weak, which indicate the spin squeezing is very sensitive to the corresponding classical chaos. Through the comparison we also know that the spin squeezing coefficient defined by Wineland is more sensitive to the classical chaos than the one by Kitagawa and Ueda, so the quantum chaos can be described by spin squeezing.

articleTitle: Conceptual analysis of military knowledge based on service-ontology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper introduce a concept analysis method based on ontology, and applied to the construction of military knowledge. Using the method we establish an ontological structure and concept between the military knowledge and communication, in order to eliminate differences between military knowledge. The conceptual analysis of knowledge can be constructed to the knowledge operability can be realized and knowledge refinement can be achieved. Moreover, the contradictive and redundant knowledge can be found. Knowledge interconnectivity also can check consistency and completeness of knowledge base. According to the characteristics of the military domain knowledge and semantic interoperability methods. The paper puts forward Semantic Tree and Relation Degree, and description logic is given with the mapping ontology language. Finally completed the analysis of the military concept of domain knowledge and reasoning process, also provides the corresponding algorithm.

articleTitle: Effects of running parameters on blowing performance of impeller blower
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to reduce the power consumption of impeller blower and increase its blowing distance, effects of impeller's rotational speeds and blade's slanted angles on the power consumption and blowing distance of impeller blower were studied on an impeller blower test bench, which was developed as the test machine for studying blowing performance of impeller blowers. Results suggested that when impeller's external diameter was Φ700mm, its optimal rotational speed was within a range between 800 and HOOr/min. Radial blade consumed minimum power while blade with a backward slanted angle of 10° could achieved the longest blowing distance. This study could provide a basis for parameter optimization for impeller blowers.

articleTitle: The complete convergence of ρ−-mixing random variables array
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Let {X<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nk</inf>; 1≤ k ≤n, n ≥ 1} be an array of rowwise ρ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>-mixing random variables. The concept of complete convergence was proposed firstly by Hsu and Robbins, since the complete convergence stronger than many convergences, a lot of scholars have been paying attention to it's limit properties. Because ρ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>-mixing sequence is a class of mixing sequence with wide applications, such as in finance, stock, electron, hydrology, the corresponding limit properties are worth studying. In this paper, we discuss the complete convergence of ρ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>-mixing random variables array by moment inequality under some suitable conditions.

articleTitle: Adaptive morphological wavelet filter used in gravimeter signal processing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to suppress the strong noise, an adaptive morphological wavelet filter algorithm based on the morphological wavelet algorithm is applied in the high precise gravimeter signal processing. The preliminary work of the algorithm is to remove impulse signals of gravimeter signals with morphology filter. Then an adaptive thresh of wavelet transform filter it again. Finally, the reconstructed gravimeter signals without noise is obtained. Results of emulations show that the de-noising performance of the adaptive morphological wavelet filter algorithm are better than those of the classical wavelet filter algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the third party supplier of reverse logistics selection under low-carbon economic society
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With the coining of Low-carbon Economic Society, recycling waste electronic products becomes an urgent problem to be solved. In this thesis, we take the electronic industry as example, structure the evaluation index system of the third party enterprise of reverse logistics selection; present the fuzzy clustering analysis method to solve the problems of third party supplier of reverse logistics selection; and confirmed the feasibility and practicability of this method through empirical researches.

articleTitle: The design of the multimedia courseware combined with live-action and animation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The multimedia courseware combined with live action and animation has some the features combined with lively animation and reality of actual films, and has a high application value in the actual teaching. This paper summarizes the characteristics and advantages of the multimedia courseware combined with real and animation for aid teaching, based on the analysis of real and animated multimedia courseware, bringing forward the design principles and implementation methods for the courseware through learning and practices.

articleTitle: Analysis of dynamic characteristics and control techniques applied to permanent-magnet direct drive generator based on double time coordinate
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The dynamic operating characteristics of direct drive permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) were researched. A method of non-linear slope pre-charge for DC-bus voltage is proposed on purpose of protecting power electronic devices. By further analyzing, some problems of conventional control strategy for grid connection are pointed out, and a novel analysis method named double-time coordinate system is proposed, based on which the corresponding control strategy is presented to suppress the gear twisting moment and reduce the impact of grid connected. Simulation and experimental results prove that the proposed theoretical analysis method and control strategy is effective under the platform PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Optimization design of the cascade system of dual-turbine hydrodynamic torque converter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The three-dimensional numerical simulation and analysis of the flow field in the dual-turbine hydrodynamic torque converter was implemented with CFD, more details of the internal flow field in the hydraulic torque converter was analyzed and the angle of blade inlet and outlet of each working wheel was optimized. The non-steady-state solver has been used in the transient analysis of the internal flow in the dual-turbine hydrodynamic torque converter, and the sliding-mesh theory is used to make various components with the different rotary speed be united and calculated.

articleTitle: Simulation of SCI/RT data bus
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The Scalable Coherent interface for real time (SCI/RT) TRAIN protocol was analyzed. Then a simulation model was built based on the OPNET™ software. The functions of model had been described. A 16 nodes ringlet had been simulated and the results prove the correctness of simulation model.

articleTitle: A study on the control system of the vehicle steering stability
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A new compound controller is proposed to improve vehicle handing and stability by integrated control of direct yaw-moment control and active front steer. A vehicle model with the disturbances is founded.The new active front steer and yaw-moment control strategy based on robust adaptive control theory and the force distribution strategy suitable for complex conditions are designed. Control performance with steering input and mutation of road condition are investigated by simulation,and the results are compared with those with PID control. It is verified that the controller is effective on improving vehicle handing and stability.

articleTitle: Study of energy media control protocol of wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, MAC protocols are important for sensor nodes to access a shared radio channel to communicate with neighbors. A transmission energy control protocol is proposed to efficiently utilize the battery energy through a single channel by collision avoidance manner. The protocol can save transmission energy of most messages by setting an upper limit on the nodes' transmission energy through the strengths of received signal, thus increasing the overall network throughput. In the protocol it is not necessary for nodes to know global knowledge of the network. Its performance is compared with the SMAC protocol through simulations. The results show that battery life of sensor nodes can be prolonged by efficiently adjusting the minimum required transmission energy for different message. Moreover, the network bandwidth utilization is increased. It is especially useful for networks with high workloads and high number of message transmissions with collision.

articleTitle: Hops adaptive algorithm for TCP vegas in mobile ad hoc network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: TCP Vegas congestion algorithm was designed for wired networks, but has poor performance when used in mobile ad hoc network. This paper analyses the impact of hops changing in mobile ad hoc network on the performance of TCP Vegas, and presents a new algorithm named TCP Vegas-HA (TCP Vegas - Hops Adaptive) to improve the performance of TCP Vegas in mobile ad hoc network. As the minimum round-trip time (baseRTT) cannot be accurately measured in mobile ad hoc network, a new measurement method using the empirical value is proposed. Simulation results show that the algorithm has good adaptability with route buffers changing while hops varies, and can effectively increase the TCP Vegas throughput in mobile ad hoc network.

articleTitle: A decision tree generation algorithm based on maximum similarity
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Node splitting is good or bad depends on the measure method of the impurity. We propose a new decision tree feature selection strategy based on maximum similarity, called fsms. First, splitting the dataset into subset according to each attribute value, calculating the sum of average similarity of each subset, then selecting the attribute with the maximum similarity as the best splitting attribute. Experimental results show, After tested in multiple test dataset, The decision tree constructed by the algorithm is better than Some classic algorithms such as id3,c4.5 in The classification precision, and less affected by the size of dataset.

articleTitle: The composite function block with structure self thermal insulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The technical structure of a composite function block with self thermal insulation is introduced. Block-thermal insulation layer-protective layer trinity is achieved through setting tie bars within the block. The block not only collects multiple functions to one body, such as load carrying/maintenance, thermal insulation, drainage and exhaust, anti-shedding and anti-crack for surface layer etc. But also it collects both safety and durability to one body. The kind of block has many characteristics such as maintenance-free, strong compound function and so on. The block can greatly avoid quality defects of the wall block building non-structural cracks though structure measures, and has been confirmed by the pilot building.

articleTitle: Experimental research on optimizing the layout of electronic components in closed electronic equipment with heat pipe
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Heat pipe heat exchanger is a kind of efficient heat recovery. There is a great development on system research of electronic equipment, because of its high heat transfer efficiency, small temperature drop, simple structure, easy to control and no energy dissipation characteristics. In this paper, SINDA/FLUINT which is a professional thermal analysis software researched performance of the heat pipe heat exchanger, established test-bed to test the heat exchanger performance of heat pipe, compared with the simulation results and measured data, depth analysis the use of heat pipe on cooling problem of electronics industry to provide a theoretical basis for large-scale application of heat pipe technology.

articleTitle: An improved destripe noises method for TDI-CCD images
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The new destriping method using lifting wavelet transform by means of the improved threshold function is presented in this letter. It can overcome the deficiency of the hard and soft threshold function. As compared with the known threshold functions, the quality of the denoised images using the improved threshold function is much better. The results based on several image quality indexes present that the destriped images are not only visually more plausible but also suitable for analysis. Also it is reasonable in computer time and storage space to use the lifting wavelet transform.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of in-pipe robot accelerated life
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper presents an accelerated life testing method to solve the problem of in-pipe robot reliability in quantitative analysis. By established inverse power law probability density function model based on Weibull distribution, the results of accelerated life testing can be used to extrapolate reliability features of in-pipe robot under the normal condition, especially for single or rare prototype. The experimental results are in agreement with theoretical analysis, this forecast the mean time between the failures of the in-pipe robot and avoid its lost caused by online failure.

articleTitle: WebQuest-based college English course design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: WebQuest is a web-assisted, inquiry-based and topic-specialized learning platform. In order to make full use of it, basing on its advantages, the paper makes an in-depth research into its characteristics, illustrates its design goals and design strategy, setting forth a model design of a WebQuest-based college English course. It includes an introduction module design, a task module design, a process module design, a resource module design, an evaluation module design and a summary module design.

articleTitle: The numerical simulation of the flow field on toilet of environmental protection and energy saving for the long-distance train
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The commercial computer fluid dynamics software package FLUENT was used to simulate the flow field of the new toilet system. The mesh model of the flow field was built with the GAMBIT. With the numerical simulation of the flow field on air intakes and flushing system, the pressure and velocity vector cloud diagram have been given. The information would be very useful in experimental investigation. The study has offered the significant theoretic reference to optimize the toilet system.

articleTitle: Development of database grid service based on GDT
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To make mass distributed heterogeneous data resources in all areas share and manage easier. The database grid service is proposed. It devotes integrating database into Grid environment with grid service. A deep research was taken on the grid service development tools GDT(Grid Development Tools) and GT4(Globus Toolkit V4.0) which is a services container. A integrated development environment was built with GDT, GT4 and Eclipse. Then the database grid service was developed with the integrated development environment. And it realized the operation and management of distributed heterogeneous data resources. GDT was used for developing database grid service in this paper, it makes the code easier to write. Database grid service provides users with a unified interface to access to distributed heterogeneous databases resources.

articleTitle: Strong stability of linear forms with identical distributed pairwise NQD random variables sequences
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: We study the strong stability of linear forms of pairwise negatively quadrant dependent (NQD) identically distributed random variables sequence under some suitable conditions. We get a new result of strong stability of linear forms by the truncation in random variables, Borel-Cantelli lemma, the properties of pairwise NQD random variables sequence, and the law of large numbers of pairwise NQD random variables sequence under some suitable conditions. The results obtained extend and improve the corresponding theorem for independent identically distributed random variables sequence.

articleTitle: Prospect and state on power system low frequency oscillation and the prospect
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: From the four aspects of low frequency oscillation principle, analytical methods, affecting factors, and control policy, the author summaries the study status of low frequency oscillation and analyses the progress research in the field. According to the actual power system in the new characteristics of low frequency oscillation appear, and puts forward the mechanism of low frequency oscillation problem, namely: low frequency oscillation research needs to solve problems. In addition to this, combining with the accomplishment in others fields, such as: control subject, Structural power subject, electronic technology etc, the paper is concerned about new thinking about analytical methods and control policy for low frequency oscillation, such as: modal analysis method, synchronized phasor measurement technique, energy storage technique.

articleTitle: Network side PWM converter voltage regulator control method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Wind energy as a clean and renewable energy has got the rapid development and it is one of the most important energy. In this paper, proposed the fuzzy control methods. That is through the fuzzy control method research, combined with direct-drive wind power system and the inverters characteristics in wind power system and using fuzzy control strategy to improve the system adaptability and fast in the network side of the system. This paper firstly introduced general fuzzy control method, secondly using fuzzy PI regulation to control voltage regulator loop and analysis the principle catachrestic of the fuzzy controller. Finally we simulate the practice. Simulation results show that the control system performance has been improved by using the method.

articleTitle: Study on auto maintenance and frame based on car networking technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Development of car networking technology will cause significant changes on auto maintenance industry mode. This paper not only summarizes the overall architecture and technical features of the car networking and establishes the vehicle maintenance structures with diagram under the conditions of car networking technology in typical case form From maintenance and repair, maintenance processes is discussed In the form of a typical case under the conditions of car networking technology Features were summarized with the pattern of vehicle maintenance and repair. Finally, this paper puts forward several key issues which need solving in auto maintenance services.

articleTitle: The microstructure and performance of Cr3C2/Fe/Al composite coating
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The Cr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Fe/Al composite coating on 20g steel substrate was prepared by arc spraying method. The microstructure and hot-corrosion resistance at 650°C were investigated by means of XRD, SEM and etc. The results show that the coating exhibits the typical lamellar structure with great combinability. The porosity of coating is 8.6%. With the increasing of temperature, the hot-corrosion rate of coating all increased. The film of Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and Cr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> were formed after the hot-corrosion, which prevented the coating from further corrosion. The hot-corrosion resistance of coating is superior. The coating makes an effective contribution to the protection of the four tubes' heat corrosion.

articleTitle: Research on sensitive data encryption based on B/S network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Currently B/S network architecture is of distributed characteristic and vast data information is stored in the secure database server, however, the secure database service based on data encryption technology in such network environment cannot effectively balance data processing and data privacy protection. Therefore, to overcome the foresaid problem, a new privacy protection method of secure database service based on B/S network has been put forward in this paper. By introducing the automatic testing technology of quasi-sign attribute set, part sensitive attributes are encrypted and the quasi-sign attribute set are decomposed to achieve vertical decomposition of data; distributed query processing is realized by the query decomposition of encrypted data. The experiment results indicate that this method can balance the contradiction between query and privacy protection better.

articleTitle: Harmonic detecting method based on improved average current
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The improved detecting method of harmonic current is put forward based on the instantaneous reactive power theory. In this method, the harmonic current is detected by average current. At the same time the method has the characteristics of simple structure, strong real-time and good dynamic response. In the paper, the proposed method is used to carry out MATLAB simulation for real example. The results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A real-time visualization method based on parametric surface and IHS model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Approaches for a visualization system are presented to generate surface structure of visible object. In scientific visualization, the visualized model, which has surface of a terrain-like shape, is usually presumed derived from data field of gird points defined by orthogonal division and data acquisition. Parametric surface and Central difference technology are employed in tessellating the curved surface and generating view-dependent multi-resolution models, which has excellent performance in real-time applications. Besides, pseudo-color algorithm can be implemented in real-time processing, which won't remarkably decrease the performance of generating graphics and images, since the data used for calculating color value has been generated in graphic processing. The systematical approach also adapts to data acquired in realistic scene, i.e., in virtual reality. Compared with previous methods, the systematic approaches presented here provide good flexibility in different applications. It works well in real-time application which involves graphic and image processing while providing good visual quality.

articleTitle: Imaging control of airborne area CCD mapping camera
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Digital mapping camera is an important tool for modern airborne photogrammetry. Monochromic area CCD which is full frame transfer is selected as image sensor in this paper. Electronic shutter is utilized to eliminate the opening delay of mechanical shutter which will affect the precision of exterior orientation elements acquisition. The equation for calculation displacement of principal point is proposed for TDI forward image motion compensation to compensate principal point shift. Imaging pose control system is designed in order to meet the need for airborne stereo mapping.

articleTitle: The stability design and realization of airborne platform based on TMS320F2812
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Airborne electro-optical stable platform can isolate movement and vibration of the airframe, stabilizes the optic axis of the photoelectic detector, realize the observation and tracking for the object. It has comprehensive application value in army and cicil field. Most of present airborne platforms are analogic control system, digital control system can improve the system general performance, digital control is the development direction of platform systems. In view of the requirements of isolating disturbances and stabilizing optical axis of high-precision photoelectric guidance system, a three-axis stabilized platform system centering on the rate gyro was designed. The disturbance-isolation theory of the stabilized platform was analyzed and the control structure including multiple closed-loops was designed. At last a controller of the servo system based on TMS320F2812 DSP has been designed. Experiment results meet the technical index and precision requirement, and illustrate the practicability and effectiveness of the scheme.

articleTitle: Improvement of heating system for hot pressure mould
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Existing heating system of hot press mould was analyzed to state its defects existing in production. On this basis, feasibility of improved scheme was introduced. Heating processes for improved and unimproved heating system were simulated with the application of MSC.Marc software. Temperature fields of mould were obtained. The results show that heating device with inner electrical iron cores can decrease heat loss, cut down preheating time, improve security of heating system and improve working environment, bringing more benefits to enterprises.

articleTitle: Analysis of supply chain system stability based on network structure entropy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: We introduce the concept of network structure entropy to describe the ordering and stability of supply chain system, and simulate the evolutionary path of the network structure by matlab and pajak. We analyze the effect of the topology type, the network scale, and the connectivity probability between different nodes on the stability of supply chain system, and try to optimize the system stability from the perspective of network structure.

articleTitle: Application of wireless communication technology in the construction of intelligent community wireless network system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: At present community intelligent system in China has such problems as serious waste and high failure rate. Above problems can be solved by the application of ZigBee technology. All relatively independent subsystems which are connected by RS485 bus in the current intelligent are accessed to network system platform which is built by using Zigbee technology and is based on RS485 interface. As to each system of intelligent community, the function of subsystem is realized by wireless network connection. There is no wiring in intelligent community system, which not only reduces the cost but also avoids the influence of thunder and lightning. The signal transmission is stable. Application of this technology fills the blank of intelligent community wireless network connection in China.

articleTitle: Design of gas information collection and control system based on GPRS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A system of collection and control for gas information based on GPRS is designed for the purpose of gas safe in this paper. The design of data acquisition and control system hardware and software, design of network security data transmission and the software design of the control center are researched mainly by the paper. The remote monitoring and control to gas pipelines and gas storage facilities at places such as gas leakage can be realized by using the system. The innovation is the real-time information gathering of gas can be implanted.

articleTitle: A self-healing algorithm of cellular-type WSN based on mobile node
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In the WSN(Wireless Sensor Networks, WSN), part of the node failure will affect the normal operation of the entire network. In this article, we design a self-healing algorithm of cellular-type WSN through improvements of Flooding algorithm based on the frequency and distance, combining with cellular structure. The algorithm can send the failure information of the node in time and quickly organizes part of nodes into an equilateral triangle mode, which leads to the network self-healing. And the network self-healing guarantees the normal work of network. Finally, we use NS2 (Network Simulator, version 2) software to simulate and demonstrate the effectiveness of algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation on TPMS based on neural network PID control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper Tire Pressure Monitor System based on Anti-lock Braking System was studied, and neural network PID algorithm was proposed. A simulation model was originally developed so that the significance of testing on different roads could be tested simultaneously. The results achieved through simulation showed the feasibility of researching TPMS indirectly as well as fuzzy self-adjusting control.

articleTitle: The study of long-term load forecasting based on method combination innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Long-term load forecasting is the guarantee of sustaining the safety and stable of the electricity system, therefore, it is the most important foundation to establish correct and effective load forecasting model .Based on the existing grey prediction ,trend prediction and second exponential smoothing method, innovative idea is introduced in this paper. Through empirical research, it can be concluded that this method has higher research value.

articleTitle: The trusted computing environment construction based on JTSS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Trusted computing technology is the mainstream technology for information security.lt has technical extension for asymmetric computing technology and password protection technology as the foundation,to allow information security technology development from passive defense turned to active defense direction. Security strategy from the nets facilities to internal system security, and security deepening of the concrete application scheme. Trusted computing platform is the basis of "Trusted computing".Illegal users unable to change the internal data, thus ensuring security to identity authentication and data encryption. This paper through the open-source TMP Emulator and IAIK jTSS constructed trusted computing platform. For the following experiment provides trusted environment.

articleTitle: The effect analysis of reinforcement on the chloride concentration distributing in concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The reinforcement affecting the chloride concentration distributing in concrete is analyzed based numerical simulation method. The results show the reinforcement alters the pathway for chloride transporting and in turn causes the chloride concentration to accumulate faster in the region adjacent to the side of the reinforcement closest to the exposed surface. Ignoring the effect of reinforcement can lead to substantial over estimation in predicting the service life of RC structures. The smaller diameter and the bigger reinforcement spacing are beneficial to the corrosion initiation service life of RC structures. The analyzed results can provide theoretical guidance for the structural design based on durability.

articleTitle: Research on background motion estimation and compensation in image sequences
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In the dynamic image sequence, there exists the camera's movement when we are capturing, so when we analyze the image sequences, we must do the global motion estimation and compensation at first. Adopting the feature matching method, we make use of the feature points to estimate the motion vector in this article. These points are picked up by the improved Minimum Intensity Change algorithm, and use the Adaptive Rood Pattern Search to find out the matching points of each feature point, then combine with the Random Sample Consensus algorithm and least square method to estimate the affine transformation parameters of the background motion model, use the bilinear interpolation to realize the technology of the background motion compensation at last. Finally, we do the experiments to verify the method used in this paper and analyze its feasibility.

articleTitle: Based on the spectrum of long-period fiber grating in liquid level measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate an effective method to measure the liquid level using long period fiber grating (LPFG). First it theoretically analyzes the change rule of LPFG resonant wavelength and coupling efficiency with the surroundings fluctuating. Then the method of wavelength demodulation using long-period fiber grating to measure liquid level is proposed. LPFG, Broad band source and optical spectrum analyzer set a experimental platform. The result shows that the resonance wavelength shifts while LPFG immersed in liquid vary, and it is linear to the length of LPFG in liquid. Moreover, the method of transmission power demodulation is discussed. In contrast, the former is linear, repeatability, reliable, straight-forward, high accuracy, but certainly not the latter. The former experimental data indicates that the method can work well with high accuracy which can reach up to 0.3 mm.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization for oil-gas separator of automotive air conditioning compressor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In most of air conditioning system, the lubricant oil is mixed together with refrigerant to lubricate automotive air conditioning compressor, it is expected that the small quantity of lubricant oil should be separated from the gas mixture as far as possible, in order that it can lubricate better. The application of 'cyclone separation theory' is a fine method to improve separation efficiency. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is one of the branches of fluid mechanics that uses numerical methods and algorithms to solve and analyze problems that involve fluid flows.
