publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: There are obvious differences between video and data frame transmission in WLAN, for the video streams need to provide people with consequent and distinct scene. Thus we should concern with the transmission delay and throughput for the video frame. In transmission, the long video frame would be segmented, and then fill into the SDU. Different frame rate and size lead to different MAC layer transmission performance such as delay and throughput. In this paper, a precise scheme is proposed to analysis the video transmission performance in IEEE 802.11a WLAN. With different frame rate, the relationship between frame size and video numbers has been conducted, and video throughput has been preciously calculated.

articleTitle: A maintainable model of materialized view based on data warehouse
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on operator SPJ (Select-Project-Join) and the technology of self-maintainable view, this paper proposes a new maintainable model of materialized view; the proposed model contains two processes: the monitoring process and maintenance process, the first process is used to monitor the changes of basic tables; while the second process will automatically update the materialized view by auxiliary view, the results show that it can make the materialized view self-maintainable and reduce the storage space.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of two new DLL discriminator algorithms
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For the code tracking loop, two new code phase discriminator algorithms based on DLL structure were proposed. The performances of the two algorithms were studied by using theoretical method and experimental method with analog IF signal data and actual IF signal data respectively. The experimental results indicate that both the two algorithms discriminate and track the code phase offset effectively. At the same time, it points out their own application environment, which is very useful for the design and implementation of GPS signal tracking loop.

articleTitle: Development of machine vision positioning system based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To resolve the localization problem of Industrial robot vision position product line, a fast and accurate algorithm of machine vision positioning is proposed based on radial basis function (RBF) neural network combined with improved Canny operator. This algorithm extracts the image feature edge with Canny Operator as a feature vector, learn the target image features, get RBF classifier and use it on the target location of the background image. Simulation results show that this method is applicable to the situation of high speed and precision of on-line machine vision position.

articleTitle: CPLD control and design of video processor SAA7111
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A new control technique of CPLD is presented. The new method successful initializes the video processor SAA7111. And the key technologies such as the structure of SAA7111, the communication protocol and realization are discussed in detail, together with the partial key procedure provided. The procedure is run in QUARTERS II,compiled ,debugged and simulated,the conclusion is that the procedure meets designing requirements. The design makes use of CPLD to analog for two transmission lines of I2C , completes control of enhanced video microprocessor SAA7111 through I2C bus.The method is more simple, flexible, lower resource occupied and portability compared with traditional CPLD way.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control of grinding force in ultrasonic aided ceramic grinding process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Grinding method is an effective way to process hard and brittle materials, such as ceramics. However, it is necessary to control the grinding force to achieve the desired surface quality and dimensional precision of ceramics parts. In this paper, we present the study results of the influence of machining parameters on the grinding force and its influence on machining performance such as machining speed and surface roughness. To improve machining efficiency and surface quality, the grinding process is aided with ultrasonic vibration. To control the grinding force, the fuzzy control strategy is used in this study. The effect of grinding force control on stability is studied. It has been found that the machining process is more stable with ultrasonic vibration than that without it. Ultrasonic vibration enhances machining speed and surface quality.

articleTitle: GPS technics with DR/MM arithmetic and its application on automobile positioning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Traditional GPS positioning technics works unsteadily on the occasion of insufficient satellite signal, it can be modified and supplied by DR/MM arithmetic. The theory of DR/MM arithmetic, the structure of GPS positioning system, the element of user's terminal and its software flow chart are described respectively, and the function of the entire system is introduced. Practice proves that DR/MM arithmetic can remedy GPS signal perfectly.

articleTitle: On active disturbance rejection control technology of precision giant magnetostrictive actuator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Introduce the structure and working principle of precision giant magnetostrictive actuator and establish the actuator system object transfer function model so as to design a suitable active disturbance rejection controller (ADRC). According to the model analysis, regard the actuator system as a first-order inertia object with dead time to construct second-order ADRC, use MATLAB for parameter tuning and put the parameters into the controller to conduct simulation experiment on the actuator system objects. Simulation results show that the ADRC constructed has good control effect and strong anti-jamming ability and the parameters have strong robustness.

articleTitle: Improved image registration based on SIFT features
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: SIFT (Scale-invariant feature detection) feature has been applied on image registration. However, how to achieve an ideal matching result and reduce the matching time are the most important steps that we study in our work. The original SIFT algorithm is famous for its abundant feature points, but the final keypoints are so excessive that the matching speed is very slow at the next step of searching for homonymy point-pairs. In this paper, we analyze the performance of SIFT and conquer its deficiencies applying RANSAC arithmetic and Least Squares Method in order to reach a perfect robustness and precision. Experiments with real-world scenes demonstrate that the method can reach a better precision and robustness, which outperforms previously proposed schemes. Compared with conventional localization algorithm, this method makes the precision more stable, which reaches 0.01 pixel, and also reduce the time of image registration.

articleTitle: The data mining of TCM syndrome diagnostic criteria by the R_Apriori algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: As the association rules mining algorithm, Apriori algorithm is gotten a lot of application used for its easy use. However, it often encountered some problem as low mining efficiency, too many invalid rules acquired and the rules of pattern mining disorder. In this paper, an algorithm called R_Apriori which improved from Apriori algorithm is designed for above problems. It is necessary to build syndrome diagnosis criteria of Traditional Chinese Medical for solution it's non-scientificalness of experience medical. With treatment on the elderly virus pneumonia, a series of process including initial null handle, subtraction operation, reducing data dimension. By data mining based on R_Apriori algorithm, syndrome diagnostic criteria of bacterial pneumonia in the elderly were defined. The method of establishment TCM diagnosis criteria has worthy of promotion.

articleTitle: Development on rehabilitation instrument of genu varum and genu valgum based on biomechanics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Aiming at flaws of patient's pain and high expense caused by surgical treatment of genu varum and genu valgum, this paper puts forward a new method based on biomechamics and cartilage-derived growth theory to cure genu varum and genu valgum, in which different kinds of the external force are imposed on knee to stimulate the histiocytic growth of different parts of patient's knee, and develops a prototype and does experiments. The results show that patients have little anguish, low expense, without operation and make obvious effect after they has been cured from three to six months.

articleTitle: Design of high-performance transconductance error amplifier for DC-DC converter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A high-performance transconductance error amplifier is presented for DC-DC converters. The amplifier designed in this paper is composed of OVA (Operational Voltage Amplifier) and OFA (Operational Floating Amplifier). The OVA is designed as cascode structure and provides a high voltage gain, while the OFA is designed to enhance the transconductance and improve driving capability of the error amplifier. The performance of the error amplifier presented is improved effectively. Using SMIC 0.35 μm CMOS process technology to stimulate the designed circuits, the results show that the transconductance error amplifier achieved an open loop voltage gain of 57 dB and a transconductance of 191 μS.

articleTitle: A robust instantaneous frequency estimation of rotating machinery
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The problem of estimating and tracking the fundamental frequency of a periodic signal is formulated in short Fourier transform and viterbi algorithm (STFT_VA) is proposed. An improvement to peak search is proposed, which can avoid strong non-order components or noises disturbing to the peak search work. Compare with traditional methods of order tracking instantaneous frequency estimation (IFE) based on order tracking is simplified in application an only software depended. The method is tested on a multichannel vibration measurement from the rotating machinery .From the measurements the running speed of the engine is successfully estimated during the run-up/down experiment.

articleTitle: The development of electronically controlled engine monitoring system based on VB
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The Human Machine Interface of engine monitoring system will be embedded in PC, the engine's running parameters could be acquisition, display and online adjustment in a real time by the serial communication. In this paper, an electronically controlled engine monitoring system has been designed by VB6.0, using the MSComm ActiveX of VB6.0 to achieve serial communication between PC and single-chip computer in the windows environment. Through the judgment of the flag, achieved the visual PC's parameters are corresponding to the single-chip computer's. Experiments show that the system can better improve the efficiency of the engine parameters matching, obtaining the best control parameter values of different engine operating conditions.

articleTitle: The application of Multiquadric function in surface reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper proposed a new experimental method about Multiquadric function interpolation with scattered data points for surface reconstruction. Through the comparison of experiments and error analysis, we get some values of scale parameter in the Multiquadric function for good reconstruction quality. Then the studies using point cloud data sets of squirrel have been done with the conclusion.

articleTitle: Shape of object recognition based on RS-ANN for mobile robot
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: When studying mobile robot to recognize shape of object in dynamic surroundings, we proposed a hybrid recognition algorithm based on the combination of rough set theory and BP neural network. RS has the capability for intelligent data analysis, and BP network can approach most problems accurately and exactly, the algorithm put respective advantages of two theories to use. Firstly, information table which was formed by training sample set was reduced by RS in order to find minimal decision regulations, and then the regulations confirmed the structure of ANN and recognized the shape by BP neural network. At the same time, the reduction of RS enhanced the efficiency of training sample set, and simplified the scale of neural network. Experimental results showed that the algorithm here had the better performance in exactness and speediness when compared with the only BP network.

articleTitle: An information service model of digital energy meter based on IEC 61850
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: IEC 61850 standard is uniformly a kind of international communication standard in the field of the substation automation system. The digital substation based on IEC 61850 is an inevitable trend. In order to realize the unification of the whole substation data exchange ways, in this paper, an information service model of digital energy meter will be abstracted in the light of IEC 61850 and is described with substation configuration language (SCL).

articleTitle: Surgical planning and simulation study of orthognathic surgery based on occlusal contact
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The objective of this study was to present a novel method to make a preoperative effect of surgery based on occlusal contact. This method could make preoperative prediction for the orthognathic surgery. The three dimensional model including maxillary and mandible was reconstructed by CT data, then the finite element model of occlusion was rebuilt after simplified articular disc, The stress contour areas of the dental surface was obtained by simulations implemented by finite element software. After transforming the regional distribution of stress into the form of bite points, the predicting system of surgery based on occlusal points was set up. It is helpful for the surgeon make medical treatment program. This method assures both facial appearance change effect and the number of occlusal point, so the method has a certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Remote data acquisition system based on fiber transmission
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Making advantage of the optical fiber's characteristics such as high real-time, high reliability, one remote data acquisition system based on the optical fiber conveying data is designed and achieved. A special convertor is applied for the transformation of the opto-electrical signal, in order to alter the IEEE1394 interface to the interface of a single-mode optical fiber. This technique makes the long range data acquisition available by real time collecting, transmission, data analysis and so on. A practical application case by adopting this remote data acquisition system successfully proves that it is a feasible method of using optical fiber transmission to solve the problem in long range signal conveying.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of access and control method for NetMagic
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Network innovation is encountering great challenge, while conventional close environment of network can not meet the need of network innovation. NetMagic designed by National University of Defense and Technology is a new open and reprogrammable switch platform towards the innovation of NGI (Next Generation Internet) architecture. NetMagic can support rapid implementation and deployment of new protocols and packet processing mechanisms efficiently. We present an Ethernet-based remote access and control method for NetMagic, define NetMagic access and control protocol (NMAC protocol for short) for interaction between Controller and NetMagic, introduce the basic interactive model, present the design both in software and hardware, and finally verify the method and analyze the performance.

articleTitle: Research on the application of image fusion and second-generation bandelet transform in image denoising
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Effectively geometric representation of images is a significant image denoising tool. In order to obtain a clearer image, we used second-generation bandelet bases to establish the geometric stream represents of images, and combined with the image fusion technology to improve the quality of images. Though the adaptive threshold and global threshold of numerous experiments, and finding a optimal wavelet function to use image fusion operation. This is the innovation of the paper. Therefore, using bandelet and image fusion improve the quality of images. The result of the paper is better than the traditional denoising method, wavelet denoising and bandelet denoising.

articleTitle: Improvement algorithm of reducing the calculation error of reservoir flood dispatching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Period water balance principle is often used in reservoir flood dispatching calculation and iteration is the main algorithm. However, this method's cumulative error is very large and can not be eliminated because of precision control and other reasons. In this paper, the author improves the conventional iterative algorithm and proposes cumulative water balance flood dispatching algorithm, which can reduce the accumulated calculation error, improve the accuracy effectively, and can provide reliable information for reservoir flood dispatching operation.

articleTitle: On the study of auto form design based on customer perceptive intention
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The study of customer perceptive intention guarantee s the success of the development of auto form design. This thesis tries to understand the characteristics of perceptive intention and studies the thinking structure of customer perceptive intention. I t analyzes the relationship between the customer perceptive intention and the forms and studies the customer perceptive intention through examples. The thesis finds out the common features and the specific features of the intention. It realizes the customer perceptive process and sensory analysis results so as to lay the foundation for the further study on the emotional design technology o f auto forms.

articleTitle: Dynamics simulation analysis on guiding mechanism for cable climbing robot
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a method using mechanical dynamic analysis software ADAMS to build a simulation model of guiding mechanism for cable climbing robot. By means of this model and simulation, the influences of many factors, including operation attitude angles, support stiffness, preload, dimension of supporting wheels, to the offset of robot body in working status are obtained. The method presented in this paper can provide a basis for cable climbing robot mechanism optimizing design.

articleTitle: Research on real-time location-tracking of underground mine locomotive based on wireless mobile video
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: By the image processing and pattern recognition technology, the average background method and the Hausdorff distance method was used to video frames captured by the wireless mobile camera installed on the head of underground mine locomotive, mobile target was tracked in real-time to achieve the locomotive forward, backward and stop, judge its running track and location, calculate the recent short-range average speed of the locomotive, which provide timely and accurate reference for the production scheduling of coal mine locomotive, it is important to strengthen the mine safety and to improve the transport efficiency and enterprise information.

articleTitle: Research on portable detecting system of barrel crack for vehicle-mounted howitzer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: As its characteristics of the vehicle-mounted howitzer, the barrel during firing is more prone to erosion which caused by wear and tear crack. For real-time accurate grasping barrel defect information, the research on the testing System for barrel crackle based on eddy current Sensor is studied. The system contains of oscillator, probe, filter enlarge, GPS position, display modular and other circuit. When the probe detect pipe crackle, circuit become mutated signals (sensitive signal), and the sensitive segments circuit amplification, filtering processing after output, drive buzzer alarm and multi-display output. The main function such as real-time testing, position & store, alarm & display will be put into practice. Therefore, it will satisfy forecast and testing practicality.

articleTitle: Research on the application of colored Petri net to fault diagnosis of diesel engine control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A method of modeling and diagnosing a discrete event system is proposed based on the colored Petri net. According to the special character of the fault diagnosis model, a new kind of encoding method, which is binary coding, is presented in detail. By using the given binary coding, the dimensions of the incidence matrix and state equation are reduced, and the operations for running a colored Petri net is easier. The given model is applied to analyzing and diagnosing a certain kind of diesel engine control system. The simulation results indicate that the problem of modeling this kind of system in a mathematic method is solved, a new and effective method is proposed to analyze and diagnose this type of system.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of the multi-wheel steering control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The vehicle handling directional stability has been more and more important, experiments for steering wheel corner step input response, steering oil tank response property, steady state turning and steering angle of all steering wheels were conducted in this paper, the experimental results show that multi-wheel steering system can fulfill its function very well and reach target angle, it provides a new method for researching for the vehicle handling directional stability.

articleTitle: Comparative studies of visual stimuli features affect the stimulus recognize
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The experimental methods of psychology provides a basis of computer vision simulation,because it can reveal the law of human visual information processing. The shape and color are important features of stimulations, which are very crucial for the identification of stimulations. This study is based on the experimental psychology and BP neural networks, use experimental methods of reaction time measurements and feature extraction methods of the BP neural network, by the experiment of identifying three groups of geometric images of the same color in different shapes ,the same shape in different colors and shape and color are both different, and attempt to explore the relationships of affect of the stimulus recognition between shape features and color features of stimulations in the visual information process. Comparing and analyzing the experimental results getting from the experimental psychology methods, we can find that: in the image feature recognition, recognizing the shape feature is faster than the color feature.And the same experimental results obtained by BP neural network simulation.

articleTitle: Variational method of scattering by inhomogeneous anisotropic layers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, we studied the problem of scattering of time harmonic acoustic waves by an inhomogeneous anisotropic layers above a sound soft rough surface. We proved first, via variational methods, the well-posedness of this problem when the wave number is small enough for the non-absorbing case, and obtained a stability estimate about solution, which exhibits the explicit dependence of bound on the wave number and the geometry of the domain. Then we analyzed the absorbing case and showed the well-posedness by means of a priori estimate of solutions based on the non-absorbing results.

articleTitle: Alarm sequences forecasting based on sparse Bayesian in communication networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Learning to predict communication faults from alarm sequences is an important, real-world problem in communication networks. There are various methods from the areas of statistics and data mining for this purpose. In order to improve predictive efficiency, we propose a prediction with Sparse Bayesian Method (PSBM) in this paper. Furthermore, we also provide the mathematical formulation of the approach. Compared with Support Vector Machine (SVM) method, the new predictive algorithm not only has the same performance of prediction, but also has more accuracy with fewer predictive errors. In particular, our experimental results show that PSBM has only 70% number errors of SVM in the same test environment.

articleTitle: Development on the DDE based report of supervisory computer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper mainly deals with the data exchange by DDE technology between the higher engine system and site equipment. The system reads the data to Excel with realtime reports, or stores data to Access database, then generates history reports in flexible way with different inquire conditions. The role of communications protocol in monitoring and other applications is briefly introduced. By using VB programming, the powerful online statistics and the drawing function of Excel, we realized the output of realtime report and the storage of historical data based on DDE technology, which met the needs of history reports for different users.

articleTitle: Development of FPGA-based arithmetic module in CNC system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Many complex computational problems have to be overcome in the Computer Numerical Control (CNC) system, such as tool compensation calculation, contour interpolation, speed decomposition, position control and so on. If all the functions are accomplished by software, the corresponding execution time will affect the velocity of the CNC system. This paper has put forward a scheme of software hardening technique based on FPGA (Flied Programmable Gate Array), and developed an independent arithmetic calculating module for CNC system to improve the feed-rate of machine tool. VHSIC Hardware Description Language (VHDL) is adopted in Quartus II 9.0 development environment, based on FPGA chip of Altera company CYCLONE II series. Several algorithm operation processes relating to complex calculation are introduced in detail, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication and division operation of floating-point numbers. The simulation results prove that the proposed design methods of the arithmetic module are feasible and reasonable, which can also enhance the portability and applicability of floating-point calculating module in CNC system.

articleTitle: Bi-iteration subspace tracking using instrumental variable
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an approximated power method to track the signal subspace. Using rank-one update model, the signal subspace can be obtained by finding the least square solutions of two unconstrained weight functions. As introduced in instrumental variable (IV), this bi-iteration algorithm can track signals corrupted by colored noise. Especially the tracking results are orthonormalized to get better performances. Some DOA simulations are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Ipv6 multicast implementation and security solutions base on .Net platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Since transferred large amounts of data to the same group by multicast, to overcome the unicast transmission with a sharp increase in the number of users consume network bandwidth, reducing the service level issues. Therefore, multicast communication in large scale has an incomparable superiority. Meanwhile, with the lack of Ipv4 addresses, Ipv6 will be replaced around the corner. Therefore, based on Ipv6 protocol multicast communication software will soon begin to flourish; with the attendant security issues will be well received. Articles from these questions, it implemented based on. Net platform Ipv6 multicast communication, and gives a secure communication scheme.

articleTitle: Study on image real-time interpretation based on particle filter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to satisfy to the real-time requirement of image interpretation system in photoelectric measurement equipments, a kind of hardware acceleration system with MIMD distributed multi-processor architecture based on SOPC technology is designed. The particle filter algorithm is proposed to process image interpretation for state estimation problem of nonlinear and non-Gaussian system. This algorithm does not involve conventional linearization transform, and has approximated the posterior probability density by a set of discrete particles. Therefore the approximate optimum result is educed. It has a high accuracy and a rapid convergence. Experimental results show that the algorithm be adequate to real time, accuracy and robustness, meets the requirement of image interpretation and possesses practical significance for engineering applications.

articleTitle: Velocity-testing of high-speed motion object in special environment based on electromagnetic sensor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to the speed-test principle of high-speed motion object, a method has been proposed which uses electromagnetic sensor. On the basis of the test requirements, analyzing the principle of electromagnetic induction, and designing an electromagnetic sensor which can meet the requirement. The magnetic dipole model of magnetic projectile is established in the process of analyzing to analyze the electromotive force produced by induction coil when crossing the electromagnetic sensor in the test tube and the changing of motion object caused by the volume changing of gas. At last verifying the feasibility of electromagnetic sensor by means of simulated and real experiment, and analyzing factors influencing the precision of testing.

articleTitle: Research of high performance on PMSM servo system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper introduces the basic principles of space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) and SVPWM algorithm. According to the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) servo system, basing on the analysis of PMSM mathematical model and the principle of vector control, it builds a permanent magnet synchronous motor vector control system simulation model and carries out the simulation analysis. According to the detection of permanent magnet synchronous motor rotor initial position, it brings out the tiny displacement type proposed detection method. The simulation result shows the feasibility, high reliability and effectiveness of control methods, so it has important significance in achieving high precision control of permanent magnet synchronous motor.

articleTitle: Comparison between AEKF and EKF about homing UAV under passive guidance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Measuring the relative distance, relative speed and target acceleration under knowing only angular information is called a "passive track" problem to target. Because of the noise in measuring result, it is necessary to describe a "passive track" problem by nonlinear random system. The paper compares AEKF with EKF. According to certain hypotheses, we can get statistic results of estimation errors of EKF and AEKF separately by Monte-Carlo simulation. As a result, under the same conditions, real-time estimations with AEKF obviously exceed the ones with EKF during passive guidance of homing UAV.

articleTitle: The research of moving object detection based on complex background
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The complex background environment of the target detection has a great challenge. In this paper, a target detection method that based on the uncertainty of feature extraction and the distinction between the goals for the neighborhood is proposed. The method is based on Gaussian mixture model for background subtraction combined with edge detection. It uses Gaussian model for the background image model, and adopts background updating method, improves the stability and reliability of the algorithm. Experiments show that the method of illumination, background motion, foreground and background of each other has a strong adaptability.

articleTitle: The algorithm study of data warehouse based on dynamic plan recognition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper is an algorithm study of data warehouse based on dynamic plan recognition, integrating pattern recognition and data mining logically. Focused on the issue of establishing data warehouse in data mining study, the study also considered the current situation of researches into dynamic plan recognition.

articleTitle: Predictive model of Mn-Si alloy smelting energy consumption based on genetic neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To avoid the BP (Back-Propagation) Network's disadvantages of low training speed, prone to trapping in a local optimum and poor capability of global search, this paper establishes the model of manual neural network energy prediction system based on generic algorithm with the research on the Mn-Si alloy smelting of a steel company, by optimizing the initialized weights and threshold of neural network with GA. After the test of the program complied by MATLAB language and the comparison with pure BP algorithm, the results show that the methods suggested by this paper improve both the accuracy of predicting and the rate of convergence.

articleTitle: The design of plugging isolation process near launcher or receiver
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of oil and gas pipelines, the plugging technology which is used to increase security of pipe repairing has been starting. This article raises a new process to plug pipeline near launcher or receiver, based on the latest development of pipeline plugging technology. This process is used to change valve or maintain pipeline near launcher or receiver, is the deep application for pipeline high-pressure intelligent isolation. The whole process can be divided into four modules which is can be design separately, then can be controlled by hydraulic system.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect of transmitting beam on the BER performance of FSO communication system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Most existing researches of FSO system are based on the assumption of plane wave or spherical wave, while the actual transmitting beam of FSO system is Gaussian beam, so the study of the effect of different transmitting beam on the performance of FSO system is important. Starting from the aperture averaging effect, without considering the impact of the turbulent inner and outer scale, the effect of turbulent strength on the aperture averaging effect is analyzed under the Gaussian beam condition, it's shown that aperture averaging effect get more obvious by increasing the turbulent strength. And then, under the weak turbulent condition, the effect of transmitting beam on the improvement of BER performance by aperture averaging effect is simulated analyzed. The results showed that Gaussian-beam wave has apparent impact on BER performance, and saturation is reached firstly, followed by spherical wave. Plane wave is relatively gentle.

articleTitle: Image segmentation algorithm based on feature fusion and cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to make balance between the effect and time consumption of image segmentation, an image segmentation algorithm based on feature fusion and cluster is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the segmentation granularity is obtained adaptively according to the coarseness of image; secondly, different features are extracted, multi features are fused and classified by K-means clustering, and the image can be segmented quickly. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm can segment image quickly, and the segmentation effect is good, which has verified the validity.

articleTitle: Nibble: An effective k-anonymization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: K-Anonymity technique is a useful way to protect privacy in information sharing. This paper presents a practical framework for implementing one type of k-anonymization, based on which a greedy algorithm named Nibble for producing approximately minimal generalizations is introduced. Experiments show that Nibble often reflects the multivariate distribution of the microdata more faithfully than the multidimensional partitioning approaches, as measured both by the generally accepted quality metrics and our proposed information loss metric: average number of alternative values.

articleTitle: FPGA-based energy spectrum measurement system design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This article proposes FPGA-based method of data acquisition and processing of the energy spectrum which reduces the dead time, improving the pulse through rate effectively without dealing with pulse shaping. The measurement of γ-ray energy spectrum of 137Cs proves that the method is effective. At the same time, the advantages of FPGA in high speed data processing are reflected.

articleTitle: Supplier selection method based on group decision making problems with alternative preference information in form of ordinal interval
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to the group decision making problems with alternative preference information in form of ordinal interval, the method of set pair analysis is offered in this paper. First, a description of the decision making problems with alternative preference information in form of ordinal interval is given by the author, and he analyzes the imperfections of the existing Borda method and the method of ideal-point shortage. Second, set pair analysis method is introduced in the problem , correlate is used to re-express the preference information, and then a new ideal point based on the contact number distance calculations is put forward by the author. Last, the feasibility and availability of the method given in the paper is illustrated by a supplier's calculation example.

articleTitle: High-precision time-domain convolution in harmonic detection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, a time-frequency filter is designed, which can detect the frequency, amplitude and phase of any order harmonics and interharmonics in signal by means of time domain convolution. Negative half-axis frequency is restrained with Hilbert transform. The theory analysis are carried to this method and the calculate formula are concluded, the spectral leakage and the barrier domino effect are shun, the non-integer order wave are eluded, which are engendered in Fourier domain. Experiment simulation results show that time-frequency filtering convolution function can be designed and realized neatly and be real-time implemented conveniently in engineering application; the influences of fundamental frequency fluctuation on harmonic analysis are restrained by using the approach presented in this paper ; the calculating frequencies with many order harmonics and interharmonics are nicety, the amplitudes and the initial phases are detected in high-accurately.

articleTitle: The application of dual-parameter drive ratio regulation on mechanical continuously variable transmission
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The regulation law used in the drive ratio-changing process of certain type of present mechanical continuously variable transmission was presented and its operation performance studied. The disadvantage of this type of transmission was analyzed followed by proposing a dual parameter drive ratio regulation law. The vehicle equipped with mechanical CVT (continuous variable transmission) with dual-parameter regulation law applied was modeled and simulated under MATLAB/Simulink environment. After comparative analysis, the application of dual parameter regulation law on mechanical CVT was practicable and improvement of vehicle performance resulted from this approach was proved. The dual parameter regulation law presented in this paper could help to optimize vehicle performance, improve drive comfort and develop vehicle energy-saving technology.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of springback base on formability index for auto panel surface
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to emerge the traditional measurement's shortage of auto body panel, we proposed the method based on formability index. According to the above mentioned programs and the springback defect diagnosis, we developed a CAE module for the springback defect analysis based on VC++ environment, and solved the problems which the traditional sheet metal forming CAE software can not accurately predict. And then a forming process of U-beam is simulated by applying the proposed method which shows the method we proposed is accurate, and then we introduced some methods to optimize the adjustment amount of metal flow and the stamping dies for springback. Some suggestions are given by investigating the adjustment amount and modification of the stamping die.

articleTitle: Lightweight web framework oriented on page flow component
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to improve software developing and reduce development costs, we brought up the concept of Page Flow Component and explained component model, definition language and operation mechanism. Page Flow assumed business process by the control of transfer between pages, and is responsible for business logic calls of business logic layer. Based on Page Flow Component reuse we design a Lightweight Web Framework Based on Page Flow Component Oriented. The application results show that the framework can also maintaining and enhance the process of requirement change.

articleTitle: An efficient moving query method in mobile computing environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The indexing method for grouping the moving objects with Grid (GG TPR-tree) has great efficiency to manage a great capacity of moving objects within a limited area, but it only could meet a part of requirements for moving query if the GG TPR-tree was used solely. In this paper, we summary the existing query technology and its shortage. And then, In order to put forward the universal method to response moving query, through analyzing the mobile mode of the moving objects , we improve an efficient moving query method in which mobile objects are separated and grouped according to kinds of query for moving objects in the space. Using the kinds of queries, the double R-tree and double indexing structure is developed base on the GG TPR-tree indexing structure to meet the requirements for the indexing maintenance and query of moving objects.

articleTitle: Uncoiler indirect tensile control system research based on the active disturbances rejection controller
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For hot-rolling production of normal work and whether uncoiler open-book effect is directly related to the production and hot product quality to this problem. This paper proposed using active disturbance rejection control mechanism design of uncoiler indirect tensile control system.Theoretical analysis and simulation results prove the correctness and effectiveness of the program.

articleTitle: Research on the value control of norm force machine based on fuzzy control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Through the analysis of kinematics model on Dead Weight Force Standard Machine (DWM), the mechanics model and the transfer function of system exchange weight (load a weight and unload another weight) are set up, and it is affirmed that the accuracy of weights and the performance of the control system are the main influencing factors of the accuracy of norm force machine(NFM). New solutions are posed through the study of the functions of fuzzy control about the force value control, and the results indicate that the theory analyses of the mechanics principle about the exchange weight and control method of the force standard machine are correct and effectual.

articleTitle: A new bionic assisted driving mechanism of ruins rescue robot
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To develop a robot system which can implement search and rescue work, an assisted driving mechanism which can automatically pull flexible cable of rescue robot into ruins is researched. The system is formed by two parts. The driving part is designed by principle of friction wheel to drive the rescue robot. The supporting part is formed by planar four-bar linkage which can be opened and tightened. Through theoretical analysis and prototype experiments, it is showed that the mechanism can assist the flexible cable of rescue robot inserting into ruins.

articleTitle: Ordering heuristics for Singleton Arc Consistency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The use of consistency techniques is the main feature of any Constraint Satisfaction Problems(CSPs)solver. Arc Consistency (AC) applied to preprocessing can reduce the search space by removing the values which are arc inconsistent. Singleton Arc Consistency (SAC) is a stronger level of consistency than AC. Arc consistency technique with heuristic strategy has been proved to be an efficient technique to improve the efficiency of algorithms. In this paper, we first study the well-known SAC-3 algorithm indetail, and propose two algorithms with heuristic strategies for the drawbacks in SAC-3, SAC-3-FFPand SAC-3-MINIsup. Then, we give the correctness proof and complexity analysis. In the end, we implement the two algorithms in some random CSPs and benchmarks during the preprocessing step. Experimental results show that the two algorithms perform better than SAC-3 for most test cases.

articleTitle: Algorithm improvement of information hiding technologies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The author analyzed the information hiding technologies and summarized it. He first researched basic standards and commonly used technology of information hiding, from which he put forward an algorithm improvement of information hiding technologies. This kind of technology characterizes its huge amount, better universality, higher safety of information hiding.

articleTitle: A medical image registration techniques based on improved artificial immune algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Medical image registration is a process to match and superimpose two or more images of the same scene taken from different times, different imaging devices, or different perspectives. The drawback of traditional image registration algorithm is a large number of operations and slow convergence speed. In this paper, in order to improve the convergence speed on medical image registration algorithms, the initialization groups was optimized with an improved artificial immune algorithm and in order to make the algorithm more stable, the similarity of the standard was tested with the normalized measure. Those would improve the ability of global optimization solution. Furthermore the feasibility of the improved algorithm was verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A non-capacitance dielectric material and its application in the global characterization of high-speed power delivery networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, the mechanism of how the local characteristic of the high-speed power delivery network conceal its global characteristic is demonstrated. A simple and novel method which can remove the effect of the local characteristic is developed by introducing an ideal non capacitance dielectric material. With the proposed method, the high-speed global characteristic of the power delivery network can be estimated more accurately by general network parameters. The validity of the proposed method is verified by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Research on managing private key of PKI users
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To guarantee the security of the private keys of PKI users, a scheme of accessing and storing the private key is proposed in this paper. The trustee-boxes storing the private key are introduced to meet the roaming users accessing to the private key in the cross-regions; Making use of the characteristics of threshold technology, the divided private key slices are encrypted and stored into the n trustee-boxes, and the whole private key is restructured as long as k trustee-boxes are effective. By cross-certificating with the strengthen servers a user is verified as a legal user when it accesses its own private key. The secure performance of storing and accessing private keys is improved in the scheme. At the same time, the legal users are authenticated by system.

articleTitle: Research on a new type of multi-link variable compression ratio engine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper researched an all new designed multi link and variable compression ratio single cylinder engine. Compare the kinematics function with the new design with the prototype 250 engine and the traditional multi-link and variable compression ratio mechanism by using the virtual simulation software MSC-Adams. The contrast result suggested that the new design had higher combustion efficiency and charging efficiency than the prototype engine, however, because of the molar increase with the multi-link design, the balance of the new engine became worse. Compared with the traditional multi-link and variable compression ratio mechanism, the new engine had compact styling and lower designed costs. And the new engine could adjust the compression ratio more widely and had the better kinematics than the traditional VCR design.

articleTitle: Research on site testing for logistics centre of Jilin province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Reasonable site testing can guarantee the balance development of logistics system and relieve traffic congestions of cities, so as to promote the sustainable development of social economy. By analyzing and comparing several widely used site testing methods, such as Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), Cluster Algorithm, Centre of gravity method and Genetic Algorithm (GA), the paper chose the best method for site testing of logistics center of Jilin province, which was the Centre of gravity method. Then compute the initial coordinate of logistics center, finally, we got the precise location of logistics center of Jilin province by iterative.

articleTitle: Research on optimal algorithms in mobile real-time broadcast environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Data Broadcast is an effective method to solve the serious asymmetric bandwidth of the uplink and downlink in mobile real-time environment. This paper analyzes UFO algorithm and improves UFO from server sending data broadcast and mobile clients receiving data broadcast, then advances SBS algorithm and CRS algorithm. Besides, theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the 2 algorithms could effectively reduce data items' accessing time, so that reduce transactions' dead rate because of missing deadline, the capability is excellent anyway.

articleTitle: Synthetic evaluation indices system of low-carbon cities and its application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: It is an important and urgent issue in the construction of low-carbon cities to establish a set of evaluation indices system of low-carbon cities. Firstly, this paper introduces the concept of low-carbon cities as well as the investigative status of low-carbon cities both at home and abroad, and then it puts forward the construction principles of evaluation indices system for low-carbon cities, setting up a set of synthetic evaluation indices system of low-carbon cities involved in four areas include eco-environmental quality of cities, development of economy and society, management systems of cities and construction of primary infrastructure. Finally, it verifies the indices system by taking Shanghai as an example. Hopefully, this indices system will play certain guiding role to the construction of low-carbon cities.

articleTitle: Study on a new adjustable hydraulic positioning system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A typical on-off hydraulic system's mathematical model was established, and digital simulation was also conducted by bond graph method. On this basis, a hydraulic adjustable positioning system was exploited. Through the simulation and experiments, it shows that the system can not only realize the position control but also has the fast start and saves energy, and so on. At present, the adjustable positioning hydraulic system has been applied in a transfer model of continuous casting and rolling mechanic manipulator in a Chinese steel plant.

articleTitle: Research of color image lossless compression algorithm based on DWT-YCOCG-SPIHT-CABAC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, an optimized algorithm which combines improved SPIHT algorithm and segmented CABAC algorithm is presented to realize color images lossless compression. At the same time, wavelet transform is used to remove spatial redundancy, and YCoCg spectrum transformation is used to effectively remove spectrum redundancy. Experiment results show that the algorithm in this paper can effectively improve image lossless compression ratio, which is 32.62% higher than ZIP lossless compression ratio on average.

articleTitle: Dual watermarking scheme based on dynamic feature set
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper presents a dual watermarking scheme of digital images based on the dynamic feature points. In our dynamic feature watermarking scheme, the watermarking energy distributes on the dynamic feature set extracted by the key-decided orthogonal vector operator, and a dual watermark that is formed embedding copyright watermark into another child watermark consisting of features selected from the digital images is embedded into the circumjacent area of feature points through Chaotic sequence. Experimental resuts and theoretic analyses show that the scheme can stand against several attacks, especially interpretation attack (IBM attack).

articleTitle: The whole dynamic decoupling AC variable-frequency velocity modulation system of asymchronous machine with Adaptive Inverse Control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The feedback linearization theory of non-linear control can realize dynamic decoupling and linearization of AC Variable-frequency velocity modulation system, but the time varying of machine parameter will affect accurate decoupling of feedback linearization variable-frequency velocity modulation system. This paper applies disturbance rejection loop of Adaptive Inverse Control to dynamic decoupling variable frequency velocity modulation system for the first time. It eliminates the influence of the machine time-varying parameter, and fulfills the whole dynamic decoupling and linearization.

articleTitle: Fuzzy adaptive energy-saving technology for static hydraulic grader
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Differing from the traditional mechanical and hydrokinetic-mechanical graders and basing on the power transmission principles of static hydraulic grader, this paper describes the mechanism that the reasonable matching optimization of the operating point of component parts can reduce significantly the fuel consumption of the whole machine, brings forward the fuzzy energy-saving method for the static hydraulic grader. Taking the grader gears as the control basis, the corresponding engine speed together with the displacement parameters of the hydraulic pump and hydraulic motor are outputted by the fuzzy adaptive controlling method and thus enable the grader transmission system adapt to the frequent changes of external load while fulfill the energy-saving target. A prototype is developed to test the abovementioned energy-saving method in the light and heavy load conditions, and the test result shows that the energy-saving method proposed here in this paper can save energy for more than 10% than the traditional transmission system and thus a good energy-saving effect is achieved.

articleTitle: Bisecting grid-based SVM ensemble
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to the fact that the bootstrap in SVM ensemble learning can't generate the committee classifiers with big differences,SVM ensemble using bisecting grid-based method is proposed(GBSVME).By hierarchically bisecting each grid into two volume-equal new grids,this approach use a new criterion to measure the significance among all grids. Then,using a random method to select some important grids to be further bisected.Therefore,the proposed approach can divide all data into some grids,and use all the grids as the input for training committee SVMs.Two experimental results show that the performance of GBSVME is better than that of mang other ensemble algorithms.

articleTitle: Heat engine coupling analysis on caliper disc brake
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A heat engine coupling analysis with the method of three-dimensional finite element model of a specialized caliper disc brake is built. In addition, working condition analysis of an emergency brake has also been completed to get the temperature rise, the stress level and their distribution regularity. What's more, possible failure causes are also added as well. The results demonstrate that analysis results is basically in line with the real working condition, which can be a definite guidance to design the caliper disc brake.

articleTitle: 3 Dimensional finite element analysis of vehicle permanent magnet motor's rotor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on the traditional method which only considered inertia force and boundary contact force upon PM motor'rotor, this paper calculates the complex coupling effects of electromagnetic force and the mentioned force by three-dimensional finite-element analyzing, gets more accurate result of 3D stress distribution of the rotor under the electromagnetic-structural coupling effects, brings new ideas for analyzing the PM motor, provides more scientific, effective methods and references for PM motor's further structural analysis.

articleTitle: Simulation modeling study of complex particle in equal radius ball-filling method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Within the modeling design in discrete element method, there is always the modeling problem of complex particle which can not meet the needs of design requirements through approximation modeling of CAD primitive. This paper will explore a method to design an algorithm by filling equal radius balls inside the complex particle along their outer boundary and use simple geometrical shape in modeling instead of complex particle using the method of filling balls in arbitrarily complex space and the algorithm of neighborhood search, based on saving computer initial configuration of memory. This method simplifies the computational process of simulation analysis with discrete element method.

articleTitle: Cross-layer design for channel assignment with connectivity maintenance in wireless mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To improve the throughput of wireless networks and support real-time multimedia applications in multi radio multi-channel wireless mesh networks, we use the cross-layer design to develop a solution for the joint channel assignment and QoS routing problem. In this paper, we propose the channel assignment keeping the topology connectivity and present a QoS routing algorithm which selects from candidate paths considering the interference of links. In case the link load is relatively heavy and the bandwidth requirement is unsatisfied on a particular routing path, most past approaches block the connection request. Unlike previous methods, we present a novel channel assignment. Simulation results show that compared with the centralized tabu-based algorithm, the proposed algorithm achieves better performance in terms of the increase in number of radios and nodes. Also the novel channel assignment improves the bandwidth values.

articleTitle: A new storage scheme for streaming media server cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: We report on the design, implementation of a non equal scheme in streaming media data storage. According to the characteristics of the streaming media and considering the human beings usage, our scheme combines n-way mirroring and erasure-coding together to storage streaming media data. It is make good tradeoffs between system fault tolerance and sufficient quality of service streams. The system has the optimal storage efficiency and the remarkably fault-tolerant capability. At last the design of the non-equal streaming media data cluster storage system is introduced in detail, and an intensive performance evaluation study on it is performed.

articleTitle: Design of laser carrier communication transmitter based on combined modulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A design of laser carrier transmitter schemes using the combined polarization modulation, PPM and WSK as the modulating method is presented, which permits to obtain a well balance between channel capacity and photon efficiency. A good capability improvement is achieved by employing the circle polarized laser beam. Preliminary results involving combined modulation schemes are introduced and the modulation parameters are confirmed by experiment. An electronics design on laser carrier communication transmitter is also proposed at full length.

articleTitle: Research on military traffic and transportation path optimization based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on the fuzzy programming, this paper puts forward fuzzy time optimal path concerning military traffic and transportation by building fuzzy chance-constraint programming and fuzzy dependent-chance programming. The methods based on genetic algorithm are designed and the problems of necessity node and prohibition node are also dealt with. Finally, an example shows that this algorithm is simple, effective and easy to be realized to provide useful information for military traffic and transportation path optimization.

articleTitle: Improved difference method in numerical simulation of linear seepage flow
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In Finite difference method, time step-size adaptation must take decreasing calculating error and time consuming in long time simulation in consideration. Based on finite difference method, a new improved difference method was proposed to solve linear seepage flow: Firstly by Laplace transform time variable was eliminated and Laplace mathematics model was proposed, then the mathematics model was solved by finite difference method, finally the wellbore pressure or production was obtained by numerical Inversion algorithm. The calculating results show that, the calculating error of improved difference method is smaller than finite difference method, though it has high time consuming in each step calculating, the improved difference method has more advantage in long time simulation because calculating any moment simulation doesn't rely on other moment calculating results.

articleTitle: A semantic web based personalized learning service for programming course in e-learning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Many researches are concentrating on personalized strategies of e-learning, and many new strategies are put forward. This paper also tries to support a personalized strategy customized for programming course. Considering the demands for improvements later or application with new strategies, the realization should be flexible with new strategies. We designed a model for personalized learning. It included an information model and a process model. The model has great adaptability for strategy and strategy combination. Many strategies from other researches can also map and embed into the model. Based on the model, the strategy for programming course was designed, and a personalized service was provided. The service can adapt to the change of strategies, not only to a rule's change, but also to the change of entire strategy plan.

articleTitle: From maxi-min margin machine classification to regression
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The maxi-min margin machine (M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>) algorithm, contrast to the traditional support vector machine (SVM) algorithm, gives a more robust solution and gets better generalization performance. In this paper we extend the M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> classification algorithm to deal with regression problem, and propose a novel regression method. This method inherits the characteristics of M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> such as good robustness and generalization performance. In this paper we discuss the linear and nonlinear case of the proposed method, and experimental results indicate its effectiveness and better robustness and generalization performance compared with the traditional SVR algorithm.

articleTitle: Development situation and trend of domestic and international aerial mapping camera
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In the modern military affairs, especially in the complex field, the acquirement of real-time battlefield information and intelligence is getting more and more important, most of this work is completed by aerial reconnaissance or aerial mapping equipment. Aerial mapping camera, with time-sensitive and flexible features, is playing an increasingly important role in modern warfare. With the development of technology, aerial mapping camera has also gone through several generations, gradually from film-based type to transmission type. The theory and composition of domestic and international typical aerial mapping camera is introduced from the development situation and trend in this paper. Finally, with the domestic research status, the development trend of aerial mapping camera is proposed.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of web application based on Ajax
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In the Brower/Server-based enterprise application system, a new web design approach based on Ajax technology is brought forth. Ajax and N-layer architecture are integrated in the development of college educational administration system, which results in better efficiency and maintainability. And particular realization method employing Ajax technology is presented for the generation tree module of the system infrastructure.

articleTitle: Study on t-test method to find linear systematic error
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The advantages and shortcomings of three methods to find linear systematic error were analyzed. Malikov criterion is the most common method, but it often produced wrong judgment in application. The invalidation reason of Malikov criterion was analyzed, and then the t-test method was developed to find linear systematic error. The t test method can exactly judge whether there is linear systematic error in measure data list according to the consistency of the anterior and posterior half measure data.

articleTitle: The application of template matching arithmetic on Strap-down North Seeking System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of self-determination directional of theodolite, equipment based on dynamically tuned gyroscope is proposed. The principle of the Multi-position Strap-down North Seeking System is introduced. Mathematical model of the system is discussed. The factors that influence the precision are analyzed. In order to fit the curve of sampling data, back-propagation neural network arithmetic is used in data processing. As templates, curve model is saved at database of the VC++ software. The template matching arithmetic advanced the measure precision of this system. The measure time of the system is shortened within 1 minute, so it can save time for theodolite.

articleTitle: A ring construction algorithm for solving VRP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This article in-depth analysis of vehicle routing problem, comparing advantages and disadvantages of relevant optimization algorithms application used in vehicle routing problem, put forward a ring construction algorithm, under the premise of vehicle constraints, aim at minimizing the distribution routings, in demand points distribution, search border points and connect them to be a periphery circle encircle all the points, then the distribution center as the center point, connecting the center points with the border points respectively and forming a network structure through all points , then cut the redundant connections by pruning approach, according to stowage to adjust the overload routings and form distribution routings finally, by experiment comparison, showing that this algorithm can be competitive with other algorithms in terms of the result quality and the solving speed.

articleTitle: The development and application of a testing system of reaction time based on mesopic vision
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper indicates a self-developed testing system of reaction time based on the theory of mesopic vision. The system is supposed to simulate the actual effects of tunnel lighting with varies of light sources, which could be attributed to mesopic visual environment. By adopting lights of different brightness, projecting designated graphs on the screen and capturing reaction time with a button, the effect of lighting condition to the human body can be obtained. The system equips with software, in which diverse projects can be created and also all the parameters and data can be put into a chart for later research. By providing theories and sequential experiments, the paper introduces hardware and software composition of the developed system. It is proved by facts that this system could throw light in the field of mesopic vision.

articleTitle: A new measurement system based on photoelectric colorimetry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Photoelectric colorimetry is often used in the monitoring instrumentation in power plants. It has major shortcomings as follows: the high requirement for the stability of the light source; the impact of long-running light window scaling, corrosion and components aging on the measurement accuracy; the affects of dosing accuracy, temperature fluctuations and cross-contamination on measurement results. This article describes a new type of photoelectric colorimeter measuring system. Its adaptive light control method can solve the above problems and improve the measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of music player based on Android
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper gives our researching work on how to design a music player based on Android OS. The music player, which uses the front-back end architecture, is divided into the part of music playback and the part of player interface and music list. Besides the playback functions, the music player can also do music rating by user preferences, showing the previous and next music name with corresponding information and operating controller into a panel. The music player runs stably and conveniently during testing.

articleTitle: Sensorlesse variable structure adaptive speed control of an induction motor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm for speed controlled of the induction motor under sensorless. According to the Lyapunov stability theory, applying the vector analysis method, through the stator current and the rotor flux are calculated then rotor speed is estimated. In order to overcome the uncertainty of system parameters and the external load disturbance, the sliding mode surface is designed based on robustness requirements.
