Variable structure adaptive control to track motor speed is fulfilled finally. The simulation result shows that the control scheme is effective.

articleTitle: The design of chisel-edge ruling tool for diffraction gratings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The process of parameters design on chisel-edge ruling tool of diffraction grating, which is inefficient and highly costive, needs plenty ruling experience came from a series of ruling test to optimize and design it. In order to reduce the choosing range of experiential design parameters on chisel-edge grating ruling tool, to improve efficiency, and to reduce costs, this paper summarize the experimental results of several gratings ruling process for the experiential design on parameters of chisel-edge ruling tool. Provide the specific parameters choosing range as follows: that the blaze angle and directional angle difference in less than 3°, the bottom angle and apex angle difference in less than 5°. Apex angle larger than the groove bottom angle in conventional grating, while apex angle smaller than the bottom angle in echelle grating, and the directional angle smaller than blaze angle in both condition.

articleTitle: Design of monitoring microsystem used for complicated ammunitions in storage and transportation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on some analysis of the request of detecting complicated ammunition, this paper puts forward a monitoring microsystem composed of MEMS sensors, S3C2440 single-chip micro-controller, display/alarm unit, power supply unit, memorizer, a piece of real time clock recording chip and so on. The monitoring microsystem is designed to set in ammunition package which can provide the customer with the data to evaluate the capability of the complicated ammunition or analysis the accident. Some key problems in the microsystem design like automatic gain control circuit and power consumption are discussed, some methods to solve them are also put forward.

articleTitle: Research of wind power project risk assessment based on Hierarchy-grey Analytic Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Global environmental problems have become increasingly prominent. Wind power as a clean and renewable energy, becomes various countries gradually in the pet who seeks in the energy alternative process. Wind power in the global range have developed rapidly, but it should realize that wind power project is also a risk in the process of development can not be avoided. This article needle wind power projects characteristic, Hierarchy-grey Analytic Method is proposed based on the wind project risk assessment methods. Through carries on the empirical analysis to some wind electricity project to draw the conclusion. Then carries on the wind electricity project for the enterprise the risk management to provide the basis.

articleTitle: The quadratic property of the L-MBFGS methods for training neural networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the use of limited memory modified BFGS method (L-MBFGS) to improve the efficiency of training algorithms for feedforward neural networks. The quadratic termination property of L-MBFGS algorithm is given which is an important quasi-Newton property.

articleTitle: Application of immune genetic algorithm based on autocorrelation theory in GPS ambiguity solution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Abstract-The complex autocorrelation in the combinatorial optimization process of genetic algorithm usually makes it difficult to find a good solution. In this paper an optimization algorithm based on the autocorrelation theory is proposed to simulate the natural process of the population change, which includes the following steps: (1) initialization of the populations; (2) Computation of the fitness of the population and the individual; (3) immumegenetic manipulation; (4) and autocorrelation-based population adjustment. The natural mechanism of population change caused by the autocorrelation of individuals is simulated in a parallel way, therefore the algorithm can produce and update the good optimum until the best on appears. The experimental result shows that the proposed algorithm can find the better optimum and more intelligent than the common IGA at the same time.

articleTitle: Simulation of evacuation based on Multi-Agent and cellular automaton
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: On the basis of analysis of traditional discrete cellular automata and Agent-based models, a simulation model has been improved and optimized. The model combines method of the traditional discrete cellular model's investigation on the surrounding environment with the idea of describing individual behavior by the Agent model. Fully considering the escaping individuals' difference and taking into account the respective sense, the adjacent persons' behavior, the person density and the environment simulates, reflect the process of evacuation accurately. By the crowd evacuation model simulation of a supermarket, the outcome of the simulation is explicitly analyzed and studied, which proved the rationality and applicability of the model.

articleTitle: Study about single-pole adaptive reclosure of transmission based on sample entropy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Using ATP / EMTP to simulate the single-phase ground fault on transmission line, then use the empirical mode decomposition (EMD) to decompose the fault phase voltage signal, and calculate sample entropy values of the intrinsic mode function (IMF) to determine it's transient or permanent faults. When it is transient faults that the line can implement the successful adaptive Reclosing. Through a large number of line fault simulations show the effectiveness and practicality of the method.

articleTitle: Rotation and scaling invariant feature lines for image matching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Image matching has been one of the most fundamental issues computer vision over the decades. In this paper we propose a novel method based on making use of feature lines in order to achieve more robust image matching. The feature lines have the properties of rotation and scaling invariance, coined RIFLT(Rotation invariant feature line transform). Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method. Compare with the famous powerful algorithm ‘Scale Invariant Feature Transform(SIFT)’, the proposed method is more insensitive to noise. And for certain sequence of images, which contain clear lines, the proposed method is more efficiency. Using the feature lines obtained by our method, it is possible to matching two scene images with different rotation angles, scale and light distort.

articleTitle: Influence of solid-solution treatment on corrosion performance of cast AM50 magnesium alloy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: It was investigated by quenching the AM50 magnesium alloy test samples in water after T4 treating (420°C) for 24 h. Then both kinds of the test bars were immersed in 3.5 wt.% NaCl saturation Mg (OH)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> aqueous solution for 0, 24 and 72 h. Then tensile tests were taken. The microstructure of the samples was analyzed by scanning electronic microscope and X-ray diffraction. The results show that though solid-solution treatment improved the corrosion residual strength of the cast AM50 magnesium alloy for 24h, the deeper corrosion pits developed on the heat-treatment samples on 72h caused more drop of the strength compare to the untreated samples. The solid-solution treatment and the extreme depth theoretical of corrosion pits effect together to the corrosion residual strength.

articleTitle: Criteria for nonsingular H-matrix
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: H -matrix, as a power tool in mathematics, plays an important role in some application fields such as computations and computing methods. However, it is very difficult to determine the matrix to be H-matrix. By using α diagonally dominant matrix, we give some new sufficient conditions to judge nonsingular H -matrix and thus we extend the criteria standard of nonsingular H-matrix.

articleTitle: Achieving monitoring of buildings' fresh wind system by applying configuration software
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: CARE is a Microsoft Windows-style application, which takes advantage of the features of the menu toolbar, dialog box, and click programming.By selecting Graphic elements in the control system to generate control strategies and switching logic. CARE configuration software of HONEYWELL Company provides a very good utility for engineering designers. In this paper, configuration software of HONEYWELL Company was used for a new air-conditional system monitoring to buildings.

articleTitle: The data analysis on superheated steam control of natural circulation boiler
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: By studying the superheated steam boiler control system of the natural circulation, PID is difficult to solve the disturbing factors and lag time delay problem that burning process system caused, this paper extrapolates the predict data processing algorithms control strategy for the first time and combines with internal model control to further improve the effect of predictive control to solve the dynamic performance and stability deterioration issues that a variety of confounding factors and interaction of the system and the lag time delay caused. Through the pressure, temperature, flow of superheated steam analysis of the simulation data results show that the effectiveness of the control strategy what is combination of prediction extrapolation and the internal model control, the results of natural circulation boiler control system on the stable operation have important practical value.

articleTitle: Program architecture analysis and design for robotic sand core handling manufacturing cell
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A robotic cast sand core handling manufacturing cell is composed of two ABB IRB 6600 robotic manipulators and two Loramendi modeling machines. The application Program architecture is anatomized and the program is written in RAPID Language. The program has teach-by-show mode, production mode, and calibration mode. The flow charts for each mode are presented. The effectiveness is shown by the commissioning results.

articleTitle: A novel method for linking reviews with database objects
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a method for linking reviews with database objects problem in data integration, where each object has a set of attributes. To this end, we propose a method based on 2-layer Conditional Random Fields (CRF). First, we show how to apply Semi-Markov CRF to effectively exploit a variety of entity-level features available in integrated data, thereby significantly reducing the dependence on manually labeled training data. Based on the identified entities of the first stage, we link entity reviews with database objects using CRF. Experiments in multiple domains show that our method can substantially superior to traditional tf-idf based methods as well as a recent language model-based method for the review matching problem.

articleTitle: The design of FIR filter based on APA Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In a given performance requirements, Frequency sampling FIR filter design's goal is as far as possible approximate the ideal filter to reduce the approximation error. Genetic algorithms is a mimic biological evolution global optimization search algorithm, which has strong global search ability and has been successfully applied to a variety of optimization problems, in this paper the frequency sampling FIR filter design method is also an optimization problem in essence. In this paper, the GA's parameters was improved based on the procedure of evolutionary so that to prevent premature and improve the speed of convergence, the improved genetic algorithm(APA Genetic Algorithms) was applied in the frequency sampling FIR filter design. Simulation results show that, in the same design requirements, the AGAPA method of design the low- and high-pass FIR is much more advantages than the traditional method and the reference look-up table.

articleTitle: Linked IPS on Octeon multi-core processor for new generation network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Traditional single-CPU based NIDS/NIPS are more and more difficult to deploy in the new generation network because of their less processing power. To meet the requirements of high-speed, high performance and high efficiency for NIDS/NIPS in the new generation network, the scheme of linked IPS based on Octeon multi-core processor is proposed, furthermore, the new intrusion characteristics occurring in IPv6 network are also considered. Matching rules in rule library for intrusion detection, and using the new protocol analysis and flow-based detection techniques, the multiple parallel executions including the executions on control plane and data plane are distributed on multiple cores of Octeon. Adopting the mechanism of named blocks to communicate between multiple cores, and by means of the feedbacks from the cores running data plane code to the control plane core, the system has realized the high-speed linking among the flow processing, protocol analysis and the control module.

articleTitle: Particle swarm optimization with a novel mutation operator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Particle swarm optimization (PSO) is a recently proposed intelligent algorithm which is motivated by swarm intelligence. PSO has been shown to perform well on many benchmark and real-world optimization problems, it easily falls into local optima when solving complex multimodal problems. This paper aims to enhance the performance of PSO in complex optimization problems and proposes an improved PSO variant by incorporating a novel mutation operator. Experimental studies on some well-known benchmark problems show that our approach achieves promising results.

articleTitle: SMC with disturbance observer for high performance PMSM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper develops a sliding mode-based observer for load torque and parameters variations control of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drives. A sliding mode control scheme combined with an observer is useful as a means to depress chattering and the robustness is increased. It is demonstrated that the robustness of an PMSM is improved by using the proposed observer and that the robustness is more enhanced by varying the controller parameters according to the value of the estimate of the disturbance. This paper also presents a detailed comparison of SMC controller with observer for PMSM. The observer designs the implementation aspects, and a comparative study on the extensive experimental results are given.

articleTitle: Flight control system design for a small size unmanned helicopter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, the flight control system for a small size unmanned helicopter is discussed. The system is mainly used as a platform for the research of autonomous flight controller. So the modularity and expansibility is preferred. Firstly, the hardware of the system are designed based on DSP and FPGA. Then the function modules of FPGA is provided, which are designed to ensure the system's expansibility. Finally, the software scheme of the flight controller is presented. This system is very lightweight and low cost. Besides, it provided exoteric system interface for further development.

articleTitle: Influence of tubes on flow and temperature fields within water-collecting box
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The water-collecting box (WCB) of conventional submarine exhaust system can prevent the reversed flow. The gas within the WCB is divided by the clapboard and a sheaf of pipes into several sections, which can get an effective heat transfer with the internal wall. After the heat transfer, the temperature of exhaust gas decreases a little. Several numerical models with different structure were established and based on which the internal flow and temperature fields were obtained. The influence of the turning style, the length and the lay of pipes on the cooling performance and resistance characteristic was analyzed. The results show that the bended pipe can reduce the exhaust resistance than the folded pipe; the L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-larger-than-L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> structure can reduce the exhaust resistance, enhance the cooling effect as well; the cooling effect of the L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-equal-2L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> model is most excellent which also makes the least resistance.

articleTitle: Study on Chinese college students' beliefs and attitude towards Autonomous Language Learning in computer-assisted language learning environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This study attempts to explore Chinese students' beliefs and attitude towards Autonomous Language Learning (ALL) and ALL under Computer Assisted language learning (CALL) environment and the difference in attitude and beliefs towards ALL under CALL environment between good language learners (GL) and poor language learners (PL). The author designed the questionnaire composed by two parts - ALL Belief and ALL Belief under CALL environment. 100 valid questionnaires were adopted. The results of questionnaire and CET4 scores were analyzed by SPSS 13.0. Descriptive statistics was obtained to see the overall patterns of students' attitude and belief towards ALL and ALL under CALL environment. A T-test is performed to examine the difference in attitude and belief between GL and PL. The major findings are: 1) most students are optimistic about the ALL and ALL under CALL environment 2) No significant difference of learners' attitude and beliefs towards CALL between GL and PL.

articleTitle: The research of multi-modality control strategy of arc furnace electrode regulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: During the electric arc furnace work process, electrode arc lengths show strong random disturbs and lead to performance deterioration such as power consumption, product quality and electric network. Using a single control strategy can not satisfy the requirements of different work conditions. This paper bases on the experiences of experts, puts forward division measures of multi modality control strategy for different requirements to adjust to the smelting temperatures and power of different stages in steel making process. It identifies the feature motion state of the electric arc furnace on line, and then selects the optimal controller in different phases to deal with the problem. In this paper, multi-modality division, program implementation and algorithm model used in control strategy provide a theoretical basis and model reference for the optimal design of electric arc furnaces electrode regulator system.

articleTitle: Fast computation method for route calculation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a speedup method for the optimal route calculation on large size road networks by pre processing and pre-computing. A hierarchical network structure is constructed by separating a large network into several sub networks. The boundary nodes partitioned the original network are new nodes in the higher level network. The new road sections on the multilevel network are decided by pre-computing the shortest path between the boundary nodes of each sub-network. A clustering method based on genetic algorithm is proposed. By the proposed method, the number of boundary nodes and road sections between boundary nodes of each sub-network can be reduced greatly. Then, the computational time for route calculation on this hierarchical network can be deceased sharply. Experimental results show that the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Rotor bar fault feature extraction of induction motor base on FFT and MUSIC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, the rotor broken-bar faults feature component are difficult to detect because it always hides behind the strong supply frequency component in the spectrum of the stator current .So a method is put forward that uses FFT algorithm to pre-estimate the frequencies of a signal then uses MUSIC (Multiple Signal Classification) algorithm to complete the frequency search. This method overcomes spectral leakage and fence effect of FFT and shortens peak search time of MUSIC. Simulation results show that fault characteristic components can be obtained accurately through the method presented even with small samples.

articleTitle: Study for spray characteristic of an internal-mixing air atomizing nozzle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The spray characteristic of the internal-mixing atomizing nozzle with 8 jet orifices is investigated by Fluent. 1 jet orifice and adjacent 3 jet orifices are performed respectively as simplified model to do the numerical simulation of unsteady turbulent flow. To predict droplets atomization in the flow field, Continuous Phase is set by standard turbulent model and Discrete Phase Model (DPM) is applied with unsteady flowing in the software. The simulation results of 1 jet orifice model present the influence of Sauter Mean Diameter (SMD) when pressure and axial length change, discuss the trend of droplet size distribution as pressure arises and prove its rationality according to comparing with the simulation results of the 3 orifices model. Numerical prediction results correspond to experimental value well.

articleTitle: Active disturbance rejection control of D-STATCOM under unbalanced voltage conditions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To improve the voltage quality of the power supply is an important function of the D-STATCOM. A novel voltage control strategy based on active-disturbance rejection control under unbalance voltage conditions is proposed in this paper. The active-disturbance rejection control for D-STATCOM is proposed to overcome the difficulty result from the nonlinear, multivariable and coupling characteristics of D-STATCOM and the uncertainty parameters of the model of D-STATCOM along with the uncertainty disturbance in the engineer application. The magnitude and unbalance degree of the voltage of Point of Common Coupling (PCC) can meet the national voltage supply standard through the use of controller structure with superposition of positive-negative voltage control loop. Furthermore the controller has excellent performance for example good adaptive and robust when the parameters changes and the disturbance occur. Under MATLAB/Simulink environment, the model of D-STATCOM system is built and the simulation result is given. The simulation results verified the correct and effectiveness of the control strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A product-set pricing approach based on price sequence matrix
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Under electronic commerce circumstance, it is very urgent for modern enterprise to solve the problem how to meet customer's individual demand. The availability of data on consumer profiles has opened new possibilities for companies to increase their revenue via data mining techniques. We study algorithms for the product-set pricing problem, where, given consumer preferences among products and the costs of production, the goal is to set prices of product-set, so as to maximize the overall revenue of the company. A price sequence matrix method is proposed to solve product-set pricing model, and an application to case study shows that the give method is effective.

articleTitle: A study on battery management system for blade electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Blade electric vehicles (BEVs) use batteries, by which the performance and security of the BEVs is determined, as its only source of energy. However, there are so many cells, connected in series-parallel combination to match the load requirement, needed to be monitored and controlled that making it a great challenge to manage all the cells timely and efficiently. Thus, a modularized and distributed battery management system (BMS), which can timely sample the parameters of all the cells, is proposed in this paper. In this proposed BMS, each module could work independently sampling data of each cell in its sub-module, and communicate with the main control MCU. The BUS, between each independent sub-module and the MOS controller, can sharply shorten the time that responding to any accident and improve the reliability of the BMS. Finally, test on the BEV battery shows that this proposed system is efficient and reliable.

articleTitle: The improved quantum genetic algorithm applied in the intelligent fault diagnosis of neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Aiming at the defects of BP neural network, analyzed the disadvantages of the genetic algorithm and the common quantum genetic algorithm. Used the diversity of population and the rapidity of convergence of the real-number coded double chain quantum genetic algorithm which was combined with BP neural network to modify the weights and thresholds of the neural network, and the modified neural network was applied in the intelligent fault diagnosis of bearing. The results of simulation and prediction of the example showed that this method is good effect.

Author Keywords: Real-number coded double-chain quantum genetic algorithm

articleTitle: The application of computational experiments in water conservancy investment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With artificial systems, computational experiments and parallel execution, the ideas of computational experiments in social sciences are put forward for the challenges of methodological study in the complex socio-economic systems, then the basic concepts, model structures, and wide ranges of applications of computational experiments are presented. To water conservancy investment system, for example, based on computational experiments, three major issues about the agent models, experiments and decision-making are discussed, and the social experiment platforms are designed to run in parallel with the real investment system to provide the experimental environment with the evaluation, verification and amendment for the complex results.

articleTitle: Simulation technology applied in the substation construction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Virtual simulation technology is applied to complex substation construction, the process is the dynamic simulation of the substation construction process. Finally, combining sound and text to explain the simulation process, it provides the information about the substation construction for builders. More important, it can be used to train the new employees for the substation construction. It can also guide the construction process of the builders.

articleTitle: Cross-high-spectrum ESPRIT algorithm and DSP realization on power harmonics detection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Harmonic wave is harmful to electric power system and equipment. In this paper a harmonic parameter estimation method based on ESPRIT (Estimating Signal Parameter via Rotational Invariance Techniques; ESPRIT) method is proposed. This method is able to depress noise and has better differentiation capability and estimation precision and stability. Design based on DSP of the harmonic detection test device. Computer simulation results show the effectiveness and superiority of the algorithm.

articleTitle: An overview of theory and techniques for reducing ring oscillator supply voltage sensitivity in mixed-signal SoC
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Ring oscillators, as extensively used building blocks in today's mixed-signal system on chip (SoC), have to face with the situation that its jitter and phase noise performance are seriously deteriorated by on-chip digital switching supply noise. Theory of supply noise induced jitter has been presented. A comparative study of different kinds of architecture and multi-dimensional design considerations is provided. With optimization design and proper noise compensation, the supply noise-induced sensitivity and the rms jitter of ring oscillator-based phase-locked loop can be lower than 0.1%-carrier frequency/1% Vdd and 5ps respectively. These approaches can be summarized as: isolation, regulation, compensation, calibration and self enhanced. Advantages and drawbacks of these techniques are analyzed which can provide more choice and illumination for different kinds of applications.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of intranet search engine system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With the development of internet technology, the information in the website increases sharply. In view of the problem of the user's great desire for intranet information retrieval and the inefficiency of the intranet information retrieval service provided by web search engines, in this paper, we study the architecture, key technologies and implementation of the intranet search engine system. We designed and implemented an intranet search engine system based on Lucene. The system contains information gathering module, indexing module, searching module and system interface module, which can index and search many document formats, such as html, word, excel, pdf and so on. Experiments show that the system has a good indexing and retrieval efficiency and performance, which can provide intranet information retrieval service for users effectively.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of Flash intermediate conversion layer in embedded system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: NAND Flash is widely used as the storage media in embedded systems. In order to apply FAT file system in embedded systems which take NAND Flash as its storage media, we design and implement the Flash intermediate conversion layer (ICL) based on an analysis of the characteristics of the Flash. In the Flash intermediate conversion layer, the ability of bad block management is improved by dynamically increasing reserved blocks; the data writing procedure is also improved, which consequently spares the use of exchange block management modules, reduces copy times, and improves the writing speed; The critical data storage area is designed to improve the storage reliability and loading speed of data. The result of applying it to the USB1.0 and USB2.0 storage devices shows that the intermediate conversion layer provides sound support of the FAT file system and increases the access speed of storage devices.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of an adaptive automated trust negotiation system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Automated trust negotiation (ATN) is used to establish trust between strangers on Internet. We have propose an adaptive automated trust negotiation (AATN) model, which can adjust negotiation strategies and access control policies according to trust evaluation dynamically. In this paper, we analyze and design an AATN system based on AATN model. We improve the adaptive negotiation policy, analyze and design an access control policy language and a consistency checker. The theoretical analysis and test results reveal that the completeness of the consistency checker is good, and AATN system can take both efficiency and security into account by using the adaptive negotiation strategy.

articleTitle: The hardware construction and algorithm design of control system in small unmanned gyroplane
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The flight control system is the core of small unmanned gyroplane, in this paper, micro controller AT91M55800A chosen from ARM7 series is used to construct the control platform. In order to improve the stability and robustness of small unmanned gyroplane, this paper puts forward a kind of PID controller which based on improved Differential Evolution Algorithm so that the gyroplane can finally achieve the optimal control.

articleTitle: Research on the detection information intelligent fusion of oil equipment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: By analyzing the character of oil equipment detection, the intelligent fusion model of detection information of oil equipment has been established. The feature-level fusion algorithm based on fuzzy neural network and expert system has been proposed, in which the expert system has been embedded into fuzzy neural network so that it could choose the membership function and adjust the network structure. The improved PSO algorithm has been adopted to train fuzzy neural network and prune fuzzy rules. Evidence theory has been applied to achieve the decision-making level fusion. Then, the results of feature-level fusion have been taken as the evidences to construct the frame of discernment. On the basis of the generalized evidence combination rule, the conflict evidence combination rule based on the weighted averaging method is proposed, and the prior knowledge in expert system has been utilized to adjust the evidence weights. The research results show that the process of detection information fusion has abilities of adapting and self-learning. This research has significant importance on reliability of improving oil equipment.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of power line carrier intelligent home appliance control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An intelligent home appliance control system, composed of intelligent socket and concentrator is proposed and investigated in this paper. The real time control of the appliance is realized through the intelligent socket by electrical power metering, alarm signal detection and control of the state of electrical switches. A concentrator is employed to achieve the control of appliances and real-time monitoring by receiving and processing dates (the electric quantity measurement data, the alarm signal data and long-range wireless communication data). Result shows that the system fulfills the design requirements of condition monitoring and home security and alarm functions. Thus, the intelligent control of the home appliance can be achieved.

articleTitle: Gait recognition based on embedded Hidden Markov models
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, a gait silhouette or feature cycle is divided into several temporally adjacent clusters. Each cluster is calculated and gets several adjacent PFDEI binary images. Embedded Hidden Markov mode (EHMM) is built to describe the relationship among the PFDEI. In every PFDEI state we divided several substate to describe the PFDEI image. Frame difference image is good chosen to describe substate. Sparse representation is applied to analyze binary image to learning its parameters.

articleTitle: Research on reasonable arrangement of ophthalmology sickbeds in hospital based on queuing theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This question refers to a united system including 3 kinds of mathematical models with different functions. In the first place,the model controlling number of service counter so as to reduce customers' average waiting time and promote integrated use rate of service counters under the premise that customers arrive and comply win Poisson distribution and accept service according to the index distribution through optimal design, MATLAB image fitting and relevant parameters of dynamic regulation; different weight parameters are set according to priority and different proportions in the queue of patients, which are gained from analytic hierarchy process (AHP). The priority formula k is p = Σ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i=1</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup>, λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> This method is tested and verified by an example in consideration of waiting time and visiting sequence of patients dynamically changed by length of the queue. Finally, the mathematical model combined with fixed sickbeds and flow sickbeds is established with reasonable and flexible calculation method in question of sickbed allocation.

articleTitle: Design of asynchronous motors energy saving controller base on BP-NN-PID control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, the principle of energy-saving by regulating the stator voltage of asynchronous motors and the relationships between the slip and the efficiency/power factor are analyzed, based on which the control principles of optimal slip rotating speed with maximum efficiency, minimum current, minimum input power and maximum power factor are investigated in detail, and than the PID controller that the parameter turned by BP neural network is designed, the result of experiment revealing that the essential of these control.

articleTitle: Research on virtual testing of hand pressure distribution for handle grasp
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This essay sets up a virtual test method of hand grasp pressure distribution based on CAE analysis. The hand surface is partitioned, makes the grasp analysis fit the ergonomic. Degrees of freedom of hand grasp are analyzed. The motion model of hand for handle grasp is established. Geometric models of the hand muscles, bones, and joints are defined. The finite element model of hand for pressure analysis of hand grasp is established by ABAQUS. After the calculation of hand grasping an elliptic cylindrical handle, the result of pressure distribution on the hand surface is obtained. It shows that the virtual test method is effective, can get access of pressure distribution on hand surface. This test approach has good research values and prospects of application for ergonomics evaluation.

articleTitle: Plan recognition algorithm of data extraction in cloud computing environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Aiming at the status quo that it is easy to have efficiency bottle neck when dealing with the problem of a large scale in traditional plan chart, combined with the massiveness of data set in cloud computing environment, the paper makes some improvements to the chart plan technology. Data information in the cloud computing environment is dynamically extracted and used. Heuristic function is used to do the optimization sorting to different data information expansion branches. Data information expansion branches of little execution hope and even some unreasonable branches are exterminated to improve the execution efficiency of the system. It is proved by experiment that the algorithm put forward in this paper is feasible and highly efficient.

articleTitle: Log analysis for embedded real-time operating system based on state machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Testing is critical for testers to verify embedded real-time operating system's (RTOS) design and find run time problem. Current testing methods for RTOS are mainly based on manual measurement. These methods are inefficient and error-prone. State machine based log analysis need a state machine model for the operation at first. Then drive by system log messages, the state machine can under test itself and find out problems when the operation do not meet the specification. We apply this method in RTOS testing and conclude that the state machine based log analysis is helpful for us to test RTOS quickly and efficiently.

articleTitle: Design, application and maintenance of HTR-10 full digital safety I&C system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The safety instrumentation and control (I&C) system of the 10MW High Temperature Gas-cooled Reactor (HTR-10) is the key system referred to the safety of the reactor. It is designed based on the advanced digital control techniques. This article introduced its architecture, configuration, design feature and engineering application in commissioning and operation of HTR-10. This article also summaries the experiences in routine test and maintenance. Engineering applications and maintenance practices effectively validate its security, stability and reliability.

Author Keywords: nuclear safety instrumentation and control system

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the gas-liquid-liquid flow in aluminium reduction cells
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Flow field in aluminum reduction cells is very important for the heat transfer, the mass transfer and the moment transfer. The gas-liquid-liquid flow in aluminum reduction cells was studied numerically by ANSYS and CFX. The study indicates that the anode bubbles present as a shallow layer. The bath-metal interface deformation of gas liquid-liquid three-phase flow model is larger than that of liquid-liquid two-phase flow model. The velocity magnitude and circulation flow direction of bath flow in the channels are affected by the anode bubbles. The anode bubbles play a major role in bath flow of the channels' domain only. The Lorentz force plays a major role in bath flow of other domain. The conclusion indicates that the gas-liquid-liquid three-phase model is necessary for the numerical simulation of flow field in aluminum reduction cells and the three-phase model provides basis for further optimization.

articleTitle: Linear regressive forecasting parallel control strategy of the ship power station
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A quick synchronization parallel control strategy for multi-paralleled generators based on linear regressive forecasting algorithm is presented in this paper. The proposed controller consists of a speed regulator of diesel engine and an Air Circuit Breaker (ACB) of synchronous generator. The task of the speed regulator is to automatically adjust frequency and load; ACB is used to control the generator either to work in the ship power system or trip off. Regressive forecasting algorithm is applied to estimate the closing time of a paralleled synchronous generator. The main contribution of this paper is to give some insights into closing instruction of ACB. In this way, to overcome the shortcomings of the parallel method of phase difference, the proposed control strategy is evaluated via power station onboard and the result shows that the accuracy of ACB closing is improved.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of servo system on multi-position north-seeker
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to balance the veracity and the fast-speed of Multi-position north-seeker, the relation between the position-number and north-seeker error is analyzed. The double loop servo system is designed. The servo system applied the method of indexing localization, designed 90 positions on the round of the turntable, and used the integral separated PID control method. Each point adjusted position and speed of real time. The time of turning is less than 0.2s and position error is less than 5'. The designed system realized not only orient fast, but also non-overshoot. The result indicated that the servo system ensured the gyroscope's stability and validity of the measuring value. The system is the safeguard for the north-seeker getting high-precision results.

articleTitle: Study on expansion and non-expansion of UKF
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: It is usually accepted that UKF can be used in the form of state non-expansion when noise is additive, in order to prove it incorrect, we made use of scaled symmetric set unscented transformation to deduce and explain the difference in the situation of complicated additive noise model, theory deduction results indicated there were differences between expansion and non-expansion UKF algorithms while state estimation, and there was no difference while parameter estimation. Finally, simulation results testify that theory deduction is correct, the conclusion can be the reference for UKF application.

articleTitle: Researches on wind turbine's drive system based on the fuzzy PID control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to transmission characteristic of the wind turbine, this paper proposed a method that based on parameter self-adjustable fuzzy PID controller that is designed to control hydrodynamic transmission component, when variable speed wind passes the new style wind turbine transmission system we can get the motor input power and rotate speed, then the design of the new style wind turbine transmission system is verified rational and correct; experience show that this method is to be identified effectively.

articleTitle: Scheme design and evaluation of anti-outburst remote control rig
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Three remote control schemes of anti-outburst rig which used in coal mine were designed, they are remote control by converter, remote control by multi-speed motor and remote control by hydraulic. For the uncertainty of evaluation index and its weight in the evaluation process, evaluation index were reduced by principal component analysis, weight was eliminated by information entropy, the final score obtained by weighted multiplication method. Finally, evaluation index system of remote control scheme for anti-outburst rig was established, three schemes were evaluated by principal component analysis and information entropy method, and remote control by multi-speed motor was the best solution.

articleTitle: Enclosure method for reconstruction of 2-D cracks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the reconstruction of cracks which are segments in a planar conductoran inverse geometry problem of Laplace equation. The singular behavior at the tip of cracks is investigated. Enclosure method is proposed to detect surface cracks and interior cracks. Also we developed an algorithm to locate cracks with an angle.

articleTitle: Algebraic properties of the category of double quantale modules and its direct limit
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper is to apply the methods of category theory to investigate double quantale modules properties, the definition of a double quantale module and some relative concepts were introduced. Based on which, some properties of the double quantale module, and the structure of the free double quantale modules generated by a set were obtained. It was proved that the category of double quantale modules is algebraic. Also, the structure of direct limit of the category of double quantale modules was given.

articleTitle: Application of the combinatorial relaxation algorithm in index reduction method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The mathematical modeling and simulation usually gets a high-index differential-algebraic equation (DAE) system. The structural index reduction algorithms can reduce high index DAE to low-index DAE. In order to solve the failure of the structural index reduction algorithms in some cases, the authors firstly analyze the combinatorial relaxation algorithm. Then some key algorithms in the implementation of the combinatorial relaxation algorithm are analyzed. Finally, the result of an example shows that the combinatorial relaxation algorithm is an effective way to improve the stability and suitability of the index reduction algorithm based on structural index in DAE.

articleTitle: Development on high frequency centrifugal deicing vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper devises a new deicing vehicle, which deices ice by the kinetic energy generated by centrifugal force. Because the time that deicing part act on ice is very short, the working theory of it is different from that of traditional mechanism that the petrous hits on the petrous. It has resolved the problem that the surface of road is destroyed by traditional deicing vehicle by fitting a set of self-adaptive mechanism on itself. The vehicle can deice ice highly efficiently in more complicated road surface. Experimental result shows that the vehicle has characters of highly efficiently deicing ice and more well adaptability.

articleTitle: Mechanical characteristics analysis on PAM with elongation and torsion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Design and analysis on the new type of Pneumatic Artificial Muscle (PAM) with elongation and torsion is presented. The PAM we developed can not only elongate but also twist about its axis when supplied the air pressure. We establish the theoretical models of axial elongation using strain-energy function; analyze the twist performance applying the Moore integral; discuss the influences of wire diameter, active coils and helix angle of spring on the elongation and torsion angle. The Experimental data verified the theoretical model which provides a theoretical basis to make the flexible rotary joint and robot hand using this type PMA.

articleTitle: Ring pole assignment and variance-constrained synthetical control for random constant system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: By using the Moore-Penrose inverse and the singular value decomposition theory, in this paper, the author designed controllers make the eigenvalues of the closed -loop system located in a ring of the unit circle, and the variance of each steady state compose to the given constraint. And author derives the existing sufficient and necessary conditions and the expression of solution by a modified algebraic Lyapunov matrix equation. The corresponding numerical example explains this method designed in practical engineering control system possible.

articleTitle: Consistency of estimators under nonparametric regression model for ANA sequences
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Consider the moment consistency and strong consistency of the weighted kernel estimator of unknown function under regression model. By the moment inequality, C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> inequality, Borel-Cantelli lemma, we get new moment consistency and strong consistency theorems of weighted kernel estimators of nonparametric regression functions for ANA sequences errors under some suitable conditions. The results obtained extend and improve the corresponding theorem for independent identically distributed random variables sequence.

articleTitle: Development of the automatic flame and layered cutting machine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Contrary to low level of efficiency and automatic on flame and layered cutting machine at present, we designed a new flame and layered cutting machine with automatic and efficient. After test and verify, discovered the machine have a great improve on efficiency, which replaced the traditional veneer cut, and could cut layered steel plate once. This paper mainly introduced the structure of the product, working principle and application characteristics.

articleTitle: Order tracking based on Gabor and Viterbi algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The study proposes an improved Gabor order tracking technique based on Viterbi algorithm (V_GOT) to cope with close orders and crossing orders that cannot be effectively separated by using the original Gabor order tracking scheme. The dual function of the Gabor elementary function can effect the precision of tracked orders. In the paper, its influence on the computed Gabor expansion coefficients is investigated. For applying V_GOT in practical works, the separation and extraction of close orders components of vibration signals measured from an aircraft engine test is illustrated.

articleTitle: Precision fertilizer sharing system based on Oracle database
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Yield in a given field may vary in space depending on a combination of factors such as nutrient availability, soil moisture, rooting depth, pest pressure and others. In order to enhance the yield of agricultural production, the maize sharing fertilizer expert system based on oracle database was developed. During designing the system, the author collected clearly some materials for the system and communicated with domain experts about knowledge of maize fertilizer. The sharing system was based B/S. Considering the characteristic of operational research, the author have designed six function modules, which have not been isolated one another, but have integrated to all modules. Every function includes some sub function modules.

articleTitle: Intelligent construction of DSS model based on integration of neural network and expert system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: As concerning the problems of intelligent construction existed in the decision support system (DSS) model, one construction plan and one system structure of intelligent construction of DSS model based on integration of neural network (NN) and expert system (ES) are presented. On the basis of separating the literal description and the data description, ES was applied to select the model type. On the basis of considering the characters of ES and NN in the knowledge acquisition and reasoning, the system structure model of DSS intelligent construction was given based on NN. Through the example of intelligent construction of auto regression and move average (ARMA) model, the experiment result can show that the method is proved feasible and effective for dealing with the model construction problem integrated with language and data description.

articleTitle: Implementation of embedded system platform based on μC/OS-II and S3C44B0X microprocessor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: At present, many of the small and medium-sized enterprises are still using the low-end singlechip to develop products, the completed function is limited and the code is not portability. A new development scheme is transplanting embedded operating system into specific microprocessor to accomplish more powerful functions. μC/OS-II, as a kind of open source code and small real-time operating system, has been widely used in medical treatment, industrial control, testing instruments fields of products development. What'more, S3C44B0X microprocessor performs efficiently and the cost is low. The paper discusses a new method of the transplant and implementation of embedded system platform based on RTOS μC/OS-II and S3C44B0X microprocessor. Transplanted condition and main modules of μC/OS-II are put forward concretely. In addition, key problems confronting in the implementation are discussed and relevant low-level hardware functions which need to be programmed are analyzed in detail. The experimental results verify the stability of the system of the transplantation.

articleTitle: Experimental study of output and ripple voltage from a high frequency voltage multiplying rectifier under PWM rectangle waves
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The formulas of output and ripple voltage from voltage multiplying rectifier are found in reference. The formulas are deduced on the condition of continuous simple harmonic waves. The corresponding formulas for input of pulse width modulating rectangle waves have not been found yet. In this study, pulse width modulating rectangle waves of high frequency are adopted as input of a voltage multiplying rectifier circuit, for validating the formulas. The effects of duty cycle parameter on the formulas were experimentally measured. Then new empirical formulas including duty cycle parameter are found. The applicability of new empirical formulas is also tested.

articleTitle: Comparison methods for high accuracy nano wood fiber strain measurement with the errors analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For measuring nano wood fiber strain, a whole range of perturbing factors on the primary converters and circuit elements degrade the metrological characteristics. An approach to the design of measuring circuit, based to the principle of double-channel parametric measurement, is proposed to improving the accuracy of the measured result. Three measuring circuits based on the principle are designed, and errors of conversion functions of them are analyzed, which shows the approach is effective to solve the problem of the measuring strain, and it is worthwhile for other measuring circuits.

articleTitle: Formal analysis and verification on a secure microkernel
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: CASMonitor, short for CAS Virtual Monitor, is a secure, high-assurance hypervisor prototype, which aims to level B3 or higher of TCSEC standard. This paper combines the B Method and Model Checking Technology to verify certain key problems of the CAS Monitor. To secure Os of B3 level, we use B language to construct formal models for the Security Policy Model and the Formal Top-Level Specification (FTLS). We then conduct Consistency verification on the ChineseWallPolicy model and the refined FTLS model and have found them to possess logical semantic.

articleTitle: Research for key technologies of internal instant messaging system development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This article describes the implementation in C# of a Client/Server pattern, and the design of an instant message application in LAN. It also included the discussion of the Socket mechanism, I/O streams with the implementation. The software features the core instant messaging core functions, video conference, and file transferring between peers. It is an effective service and also very suitable for the communication within corporations or between companies and clients.

articleTitle: Research on product innovation of imaging industry based on TRIZ theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Despite talk of "paperless" office concepts since as long ago as 1975, it appears in 2010 that printing is here to stay. Paper documents remain central for much of office life, and the printers within an organization are still critical to productivity. Due to the intense competition of imaging industry, each successful enterprise develops by means of exploring a unique business model which is suitable for its own. Based on the concept of TRIZ theory solving the complex management problems, this paper gives an analysis of the dimension and motivation for the innovation mode of imaging industry, and puts forward the point of view that integrity between hardware and software to form total solution of document management via the development of internet standard procedure, which provides a scientific basis for enterprises to accelerate the revolution steps of business model of imaging industry. The test results illustrate such method is better than traditional method, and it has good prospect.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of emergency evacuation information system based on the internet of things
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The emergency evacuation information system is the key of building emergency evacuation system. Through the relation analysis between the internet of things and the emergency evacuation information, this thesis brought out the design ideas about emergency evacuation information system based on the status of emergency evacuation management,, and explained the implementation strategy of the information system.

articleTitle: Research on modeling and application of test signal
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Aimed at the problems that the model of test signal was difficult to set and the measurement was hard to achieve in signal-oriented ATS, the way modeling test signal based on STD were introduced and the model of three-phase AC signal which had current limit attribute was built. Furthermore, the principle of intrinsic measurement and generic measurement which would be both used in the later test example was analyzed. At last not only the correctness of the three-phase AC signal model was verified, but also the application of test signals in signal-oriented ATS was showed by the test example.

articleTitle: Start-up characteristics of a capsule micro robot applied in intestine
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A new capsule robot prototype with function of radial clearance compensation driven by external rotating magnetic field is proposed, based on the established fluid dynamic model, fluid dynamic pressure and swimming speed of the robot with respect to the clearance between the inner pipe wall and the surface of the robot is analyzed. According to the phenomenon that axial propulsion reduces greatly by the increase of radial clearance between inner pipe wall and external surface of the robot, the startup characteristics is investigated. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the control on propulsion and swimming speed of the robot is realized by reducing the thickness of dynamic oil membrane through radial clearance self-compensation, and driving performance of the robot is modified greatly.

articleTitle: A study on tool assembly algorithm of stamping forming simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to the research of tool assembly of stamping forming simulation, three preconditions for effective automatic assembly algorithm were presented: consistent normal direction, distinct tool property and correct initial uniform normal direction. The automatic assembly algorithm, based on the background mesh projection, was also presented in this paper. Projected nodes of sheet and tools onto background mesh along the uniform normal direction, distributed them according to the coordinate information, calculated the minimum distance between tool nodes and sheet elements, and confirmed the distance that tools need to be moved. Ultimately, the correct assembly would be accomplished automatically. The algorithm eliminated the coupling relationship between stamping type and stamping direction, which improved the adaptability of the program and efficiency of the algorithm, and made the operation simpler. The practice in complex industry model proved the feasibility and efficiency of the new automatic assemble algorithm in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on the electric field of electrorotation effect using passive electrostatic human body detection system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Electrostatic human body detector is a detector which obtain target information through catching the electrostatic field of the target. It play an important role in the human body detection technology. This paper focused on using dielectrophoresis theory to detect the coupling heart electric field between the operator and the detected living human, while analyzing the electrorotation electric field about this problem. Firstly, we described the electrorotation effect which belongs to dielectrophoresis theory. Then, the double-human coupling heart electric field and the electrorotation four-pole electrode structure which generates measuring electric field were analysised. Finally, the Three dimensional finite element method was used to simulate and calculate the measuring electric field. Simulation result shows that electrorotation effect electric field and the conclusion is in accordance with the theory. The conclusion of this paper is the most significant studies of the passive electrostatic human body detection technique.

articleTitle: Blood cell image localized segmentation combining mean-shift and ELM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper locate leukocyte nucleus using mean-shift based on distribution characteristic of leukocyte nucleus in color space, then mark each leukocyte nucleus using Marking Algorithm based on matrix. Then the region of nucleus would be inflated in image in order to get a part of color information of cytoplasm around nucleus, by using entropy. A part of color of each cytoplasm and nucleus would comprise the positive training subset, and the rest do the negative training subset, A two-class ELM could be trained with the training set and generate a classification model. So several local models of ELM can be produced in the image in order to extract leukocyte one by one. The proposed algorithm need not tune the parameters, and it is better in segmentation effect, compared with SVM algorithm and the algorithm which extracts leukocytes entirely.

articleTitle: Study on digital forensics model based on data fusion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to standardize the procedure of digital forensics, on the basis of the deep research on existing computer forensic models, a digital forensic model based on data fusion is proposed, which carries out time constraint and legal restriction in linear course control and forensic supervision to the whole forensic process. The establishment of political-legal and judicial certificate authority departments will bring about the mutual trust and recognition not only among the related departments but also between them and the court during the entire evidentiary process. Finally, the model system submits the evidence chain and the chain of forensic supervision to the court, which improves the legal effect of electronic evidence.

articleTitle: Research on the AC servo system of CNC machine tools based on sliding mode variable structure theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The present paper mainly aims at the numerically-controlled machine tool AC servomechanism, i.e. the permanent magnetism synchronous motor AC servomechanism's main feature, the application slip form changes the structure control strategy, improved the convention control policy to satisfy the request which with difficulty the high performance permanent magnetism synchronous machine actuated, enhanced system's anti-jamming and robustness, tried hard to enhance overall system's performance.

articleTitle: An international comparative study on the developments of green logistics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Since the concept of green logistics was proposed in the early 1990s, the governments, the academia and the business community around the world have paid a lot of attention to the green logistics. Green logistics is based on the sustainable development, resource conservation and environment friendly. It can help us to deal with the relationship effectively between the logistics development and environmental protection, and make the economic interests, social interests and environmental interests unity. At present, the development of the green logistics in China is still relatively backward. In order to accelerate the development of the green logistics in China and improve its quality, this paper collected and collated some successful practices and experience of other countries by the methods of the literature analysis and summarizes. Combined with the national conditions of china, this paper proposed some suitable measures and recommendations, and they will have the actual significance to improve the logistics level.

articleTitle: Application of improved quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm in power network planning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to solve the conflicting objectives in power network planning, various evolutionary methods to multi-objective optimization have been developed, however, some studies of different methods are often restricted to the quantitatively and the approaches of Pareto front. In this paper the potential and effectiveness of Pareto front-based improved quantum particle swarm algorithm (IQPSO) for solving a real-world power system multi-objective optimization problem are comprehensively evaluated and discussed. IQPSO adopts the non-dominated storing relation method for solutions population and a new population diversity preserving strategy is used which is based on the turbulence pareto max-min distance, by using convergent factor K to accelerate the convergence rate of the particle who jump out the local optimal. Particularly, nondominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA) multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (MOEA) have been developed and successfully applied to the network planning problem, these methods have been examined and applied to the standard IEEE 33-bus test system. Compared to NSGA and MOEA methods, the results demonstrate the superiority of the IQPSO as a promising method to solve mulit-objective power network planning problem.

articleTitle: A data collecting and processing method in high-speed network based on cluster
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Through in-depth study cluster and network data processing rules and methods, a data collecting and processing method in high-speed network based on cluster is proposed in this paper. It realized network data distributed collecting by using multilayer structure of task scheduling centre, cluster management center, collecting agency. It realized network data processing by adopting data processing method based on the rules. In addition, It introduces data processing rules, cluster distribution strategy and management center choice mechanism in detail. The results of simulation experiment show that the method is suitable for large-scale network data collecting and processing, and can improve data collecting and processing speed very well.

articleTitle: Pixel depth approach to deformed CAPTCHA skeleton
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: CAPTCHA is a standard security technology that presents test to tell computers and humans apart. Nowadays the most widely deployed CAPTCHAs are text-based schemes, which rely on sophisticated distortion of text images aimed at rendering them unrecognizable to the state of the art of pattern recognition methods. Generally, the skeletonization of character is acknowledged as one of the most significant parts in character recognition. The skeleton which keeps the topology information as well as reduces the computational complexity is an excellent and robust structural feature to noise and deformation. In this paper, a depth-based approach is proposed in order to locate the skeleton point. In order to strike the balance between efficiency and robustness against distortion, three fault tolerance techniques have been applied in the extraction process. Then in the amendment stage, we use noise patterns to filter redundant points. Experiments are conducted and positive results are achieved, which shows that the depth-based skeletonization scheme is applicable to the widely used CAPTCHA images, and the skeleton is robust against rotated, distorted or conglutinated characters.

articleTitle: A fault diagnosis method based on AWA-SVM of complicated equipment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Owing to the diversity and uncertainty of the faults of complicated equipment, applying the Adaptive Wavelet Analysis to pick up the characteristics of the circuit measured and to get the feature vector of the signal is a effective way to match the characteristics of the wavelet's time frequency and the circuit's response time frequency. Combined with fault diagnosis of the support vector machine, it's feasible to overcome the difficulty caused by small-scaled samples, nonlinearity and multi-dimension. It has been testify effective and accurate in fault diagnosis of complicated equipment.

articleTitle: Research on key technology of Savant middleware in the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For Savant application problems in the Internet of Things, we improved architecture of the Savant system, and achieved connection methods between reader and enterprise application client with Savant middleware technology. In this method, one or more label or sensor data streams flow through readers, we achieved compressed data packets, tag data filtering, integration and calculation with Savant. Through the use of Savant middleware, we can lower the complexity of many to many connected maintenance problems and the cost of business operation.

articleTitle: The sample allocation plan of testability verification for mechatronics equipment based on integrated multi-factor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To settle the problem such as the low confidence level of the testability verification test conclusion resulting from the irrational sample allocation plan for mechatronics equipment, this paper proposes the sample allocation plan based on integrated multi-factor by analyzing some key factors that affect the confidence level of conclusion. The sample size of every UUT was counted by relative ratio of integrated multi-factor, which can optimize failure sampling structure and advance the representation of failure sampling set.
