Moreover, the single-step failure propagation algorithm was improved, and the algorithm can calculate failure propagation intensity more effectively. Finally, aimed at stabilization and tracking platform, this paper use the sample allocation plan based on integrated multi-factor to allocate samples. By analyzing the result, it proves that the plan can optimize failure sampling structure and improve the confidence level of the testability verification test conclusion.

Author Keywords: the relative ratio of integrated multi-factor

articleTitle: The design and research of permanent magnet synchronization electric machine vector control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper has designed a system to achieve space vector pulse width modification using DSP chip TMS320LF2407A, then showed a set of permanent magnet servo motor control system block diagram of the hardware and software design flow chart, adopting the space vector control strategy. The experimental result shows that the system has good performance and simple design, and it can meet the requirements of real-time control and practical strong, etc. The suitable for power in the small power and the exchange servers and have higher system dynamic performance and static performance.

articleTitle: The research and development of the portable picking device for pine cones
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to change the traditional way of hand picking up pine cones on the tree, this paper presents a new technology of pine cones collection and the key equipment research and development. Using this device, workers may directly pick up pine cones on the ground under the tree. This paper, founded on the system design, has a theory analysis and stability checking about the retractable lifting rods which are the key components of this device, verifying the stability and rationality of the picking device for pine cones. Based on these researches, this paper has developed the prototype of the portable picking device for pine cones. It has the characteristic of carrying easily, suiting for promotion in forest zone.

articleTitle: Design and realization of reed-solomon codec based on FPGA technique
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, we present a design and realization of RS(255, 223) codec targeted for an image transmission system. The low-complexity pipelined RS(255, 223) decoder with the Berlekamp-Massey (BM) linear feedback shift register (LFSR) algorithm used is able to operate at a clock frequency of 120MHz and has a data throughout rate of 960 Mb/s. Simulations displayed by Signal Tap II software which derives the actual signals run inside the Cyclone II FPGA manufactured by Altera certificate the analysis of each part of the codec. Also, the BER performance of RS(255, 223) simulated by Matlab is shown at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: The hardware design of multi-wheel steering electro-hydraulic proportion control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: On the demand for vehicle multi-wheel steering control system, its basic structure design was completed such as CPU choice, the signal collecting circuit of the steering wheel corner, oil tank displacement signal collection circuit and expanding circuit design of MCU, etc. The experiment results show that hardware design of multi-wheel steering electro-hydraulic proportion control is feasible.

articleTitle: Active disturbances rejection controller ADRC realization of beer fermentation temperature control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For beer fermentation temperature control system of high accuracy, the system inside and outside interference, the problem of strong randomness. According to ADRC can estimate by the expansion of state model parameter uncertainties and external load disturbances and nonlinear PID control theory, a realization ADRC beer fermentation temperature control system of new control structure to achieve beer fermentation temperature real-time dynamic control. The simulation results verify the rationality and effectiveness of the program.

articleTitle: Multi-objective evaluation model for aviation ammunition maintenance quality
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Aiming at the uncertain information in the multi objective assessment for aviation ammunition maintenance quality, the model adopts the deviation degree of the interval number to determine the attribute weight, and uses WAA operator to obtain the comprehensive attribute value of the scheme. According to the possibility matrix, it gains the sequencing vector, so as to get the assessment scheme. The final calculation cases show the feasibility & reliability of the model. Under the circumstance that the weight is unknown, the model carried out the assessment for many schemes. The multi-objective evaluation model can effectively solve complex problem for evaluation of aviation ammunition maintenance quality in uncertain condition, and can provide the scientific support for the aviation ammunition maintenance decision.

articleTitle: The research of video browsing technology based on the moving target
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This study is designed to achieve a video browsing technology which allows users to browse the moving target of interest by controlling the moving object in the video scene. This study included the following: first, the tracking accuracy needed to be improved; second, we needed to accelerate the tracking speed to ensure that users could view real-time changes of moving object; third, a user-friendly interactive interface was needed. In this study, we applied both the pyramid Lucas-Kanade optical flow algorithm and Camshift algorithm to track the moving target, and optimized both of them by using parallel processing algorithm. Experimental results show that Camshift algorithm can make up the insufficient of optical flow algorithm to a certain extent, and the optimized algorithms are able to achieve real-time browsing of high-definition video.

articleTitle: IBC system based on near-field electrostatic coupling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: IBC System is a wireless communication system that allows electronic devices on the human body to exchange digital information through near-field electrostatic coupling. Information is transmitted by modulating electric fields and electro statically coupling currents into the body. In this paper, we designed an intra-body communication system, which is based on near-field electrostatic coupling near human body. As the communication method in Personal Area Network, we analyze the principle of intra body communication, and expounded its virtues in using. According the strategy of intra-body communication, which we designed, we constructed a communication system in both hardware and software. In this system we experimented several functions of communication in PAN, and reached the anticipative result.

articleTitle: Research on resource sharing communication model in LAN based on P2P
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to facilitate resource sharing in LAN and save the Internet bandwidth, in this paper we proposed a data communication model based on P2P which support internal resource sharing in LAN. The design concept of the model is presented, and the working mechanism and state transition of the model is then described. At last, by analyzing the performance of the proposed algorithm, the results illustrate that the model can achieve remarkably higher resource sharing efficiency. At the same time, the bandwidth of external network as well as a lot of downloading time can be saved. The model we presented could provide theoretical basis for our further implementation of LAN resource sharing software.

articleTitle: A well-resolved condition for point targets in MUSIC imaging algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper we analyze the relationship between illumination vectors that compose the response matrix in MUSIC imaging algorithm. In particular, aiming at achieving a minimum distance of well-resolved scatterers, we put forward a well-resolved condition for point targets and show that the corresponding illumination vectors are approximately orthogonal. The condition also presents the impact of the distance between scatterers on the imaging results. Numerical experiments are presented to verify the condition.

articleTitle: A key technique based on MFC to develop structure mode reader of RFC document
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the data structure and the key algorithm to develop the structure mode reader of RFC document and gives the tree structure of RFC document and its sample picture in structure mode after a full research of the RFC document format and the class and the function of MFC.

articleTitle: Virtual simulation of fire escape system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To fetch up the deficiency of fire escape education and exercise in our country, a virtual simulation system of fire escape was designed and implemented in this study. From the practical application, according to the characters of the constructed virtual environment, use modeling technology based on graphics and image to make up a approximately real fire scene. The simulation results showed that the system has more interactivity, and its ability to participate in experience makes the simulation training system become an innovative disaster prevention and relief methods.

articleTitle: Research on the connection equipment of testing sensor about machinery
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With the development of mechanization rapidly, the higher requirement for the testing of machinery is raised. The capability, quality and regenerate period of new product are directly impacted by the advance of testing technology. In this paper, a connection equipment of sensor is designed for the requirement of testing method about the suspended structure, which is comprised of the testing sensor system with sensors together. And the information about the force and location is provided for the subsequent system. The testing result show satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: Development of a nonlinear control strategy for the DC power transferring system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper presents a detailed control strategy to a PWM bidirectional DC-DC transferring system designed for high voltage, high power applications. The objective is to realize precise bidirectional power flow control between two DC grids, where the half bridge topology is adopted for the connection between them. By using the averaging technique, the system's nonlinear average model is derived, based on which the nonlinear control algorithm is proposed, to realize the current control. The proposed circuit and control strategies are simulated using SimPowerSystems and a comprehensive synthesis of the control algorithms is conducted, from the viewpoint of rapidity, robustness and system cost. It is verified that the proposed nonlinear control algorithm has a fast response, competent disturbance rejection ability and low cost. Although the structure studied here is the half bridge bidirectional converter, however, the controller design methods and the relative conclusions can be promoted to any type of structure in power transferring systems.

articleTitle: Design and implement a B/S model monitoring system of Multi-layer Soil temperature based on WCDMA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With the development of precision agriculture, environmental monitoring is significant.This paper describes how to design and implement a Multi-layer Soil temperature monitoring system based on WCDMA network and WEB technical integration. This System includes WCDMA developing module,multi-layer temperature sensors and a B/S model monitoring system depolied on server.Via 3G network to setup a link with temperature sensors and data server; while wireless moisture sensors send data into web server,some functions such as analysing data are implement on server.The experiment result explains that the WCDMA has resolved the problem which is the slow rate of transmission, the short distance of sending and the small storage of the the server.WCDMA network is appled in precision agriculture widly.

articleTitle: On filters of pseudo MTL-algebras
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: We investigate the properties of filters in pseudo MTL-algebras and discuss the relations among several kinds of filters in pseudo MTL-algebras. By further investigating the structure of Boolean and normal filter of pseudo MTL-algebras, we give a positive answer to an open problem that in pseudo BL-algebras whether every Boolean filter is a normal filter.

articleTitle: The study of copper electrolysis rectifier system based on PSO algorithm to optimize PID parameters
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the PSO algorithm to optimize PID parameters for copper electrolytic system, research and analysis the development trend of high-power electrolytic devices at home and abroad. Based on the theoretical guidance, we use of particle swarm optimization (PSO) to design a new control method to optimize PID parameters, simulation results show the effectiveness of the algorithm and the superiority of the designed controller.

articleTitle: P Ajax-based technology platform for the University Educational Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This article mainly elaborates the method and the process which are using the object-oriented idea to develop the Aj ax-based technology platform for the University Educational Management. This system realizes the management about the university's organizational structure, student information, teacher information, student performance, student curriculum, teaching program, information dissemination, etc. And achieve the report printing function. Thanks to using the object-oriented technology and six patterns, the system reaches a modular, easy expansion and maintenance of the design requirements.

articleTitle: Technologies of geographical information services publication and discovery based on ontology and description logic
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of geographical information services publication and discovery, technologies of geographical information services publication and discovery based on ontology and description Logic were discussed. OWL-S ontology description model was used to improve semantic lacking in services description. Description logic was introduced as the top way of services matchmaking, and logical rules were considered to define the preconditions and effects of services. Then, more accurate and exact geographical information services matchmaking was realized based on services catalog matchmaking, services input and output matchmaking.

articleTitle: The impact of internal logistics information technology processes to service performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Currently, using information technology more efficiently in connection with firm strategies is one way to achieve the objectives of cost containment and improved service. Management literature has established the strategy-structure-process-performance (SSPP) paradigm as a means to assess direction of the relationships and their interactions. The objective of this research is to expand on the established paradigm by testing the relationships within the context of logistics information technology processes. And this paper will evaluate the generalizability of the SSPP framework and improve understanding of information technology's role in logistics.

articleTitle: The coarse north-finding based on double MCU control system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of coarse North-finding and shorten the time of coarse North-finding, this article puts forward the double MCU system. The system divided the functions into the A/D collection function, data display and the motor control function, and each part was controlled by a single chip. It introduced the features and advantages of the double single-chip microcomputer system, hardware design, the asynchronous serial communication between the two SCMs and software process. This system improves the accuracy of fitting, also shortens the time of North-finding. The repetitive experimental of the System indicates that the system has a good stability, the time of North-finding is controlled within 5 minute, the average of the precision is 11'25" and the standard deviation is 36".

articleTitle: Data acquisition system for energy management based on OPC protocol
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To resolve the data communication and interactive issue among different industrial configuration software, this paper adopts OPC technology. Through operating system and properly configuring DCOM components, this paper builds data communications platform which is a network of interconnected, stable operation, easy maintenance and security reliable. Energy measurement acquisition system is the basic business management analysis of data based on energy consumption. This paper uses OPC technology, successfully resolved between enterprises of different energy measurement equipment, data communication problems. The design of the energy data collection system is stable, reliable, and easy maintenance.

articleTitle: The research on the new ultra-precision polishing instrument of the internal surface in the elbow
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Ultra smooth surface polishing techniques are the important part in the ultra precision machining system. The new ultra-precision polishing instrument which fit for the precision polishing in the elbow's internal surface has been researched in this paper. The polishing instrument is a sphere which performs rotating-jet polishing and flexibly dragged by the string. The simulation analysis of the polishing instrument in the internal of the elbow has been simulated with the ANSYS11.0 finite element analysis software. The simulation result has proved that the polishing instrument can polish the internal surface of the elbow and achieve the purpose of the improving roughness of the internal surface in the elbow.

Author Keywords: the internal surface of the elbow

articleTitle: Research of wireless sensor network key distribution mechanism based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to the sensor network in the topology structure of Internet of Things, the sensor network was divided by hexagon method to optimize network random key pre-distribution protocol to improve the safety of Things. The optimal performance of sensor networks can be obtained, which is divided by the fitted respectively, after sub-network connectivity and the node with the key anti capture the relationship between the distribution images was shown by the experimental data. Experiments show that the scheme has a better key connectivity and capture of anti nodes.

articleTitle: Template based three dimensional parametric design of optical fiber dispenser
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on the analysis of geometrical characteristic, material composition and load characteristics of the optical fiber dispenser, a template based method to implement three dimensional parametric design of optical fiber dispenser was put forward. The template is created by interactive way firstly. Then a set of design parameters which completely control the shape and dimensions of optical fiber dispenser are selected, and relationships between control parameters and shape and dimension of the dispenser were established by program. Inputting a set of design parameters, a new dispenser can be designed automatically by program. Making use of PRO/E WILDFIRE, PRO/TOOLKIT and VC ++, an integrated parametric design system for optical fiber dispenser were successfully developed.

articleTitle: A music question answering system enhanced with dialogue management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The main challenge of question answering is that the lack of task structure prohibits the use of simplified assumptions as in task-oriented dialogue systems. This problem was tackled by integrating a dialogue management environment into a question answering system. Firstly, Wizard of Oz studies were conducted to discover how users describe their music information needs in contextual situations as well as single standalone questions. Subsequently, the system was constructed and enhanced with the ability to use the dialogue context and the Web to answer more extended questions about artists, songs, albums, tours, et cetera. Finally, the system was successfully tested on 120 dialogues with 10 users. The evaluation was reported on three variants of this system, and the results were promising with good levels of both task completion and user preferences.

articleTitle: Research on auto-filling hole based on mesh information of car body panel
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In terms of the feature of the Self-Piercing Riveting process program, the evaluating index system for the process is created. The weighting aggregate is created with the analytic hierarchy process.The correctness of the weighting aggregate is tested by test results, Selecting the right test program basede on the value of weighting aggregate and synthetical importance.

articleTitle: The application of new fresh air anti-freezing winter heating air conditioner
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: There exists a long time about freezing problems of fresh air heating and air conditioning in winter. Traditional solutions has design complexity and energy waste and serious family problems. Studying the phenomenon of coil freezing and developing TWK-FD series of new wind frost control unit can effectively solve the problem of winter frost into the fresh air. Through analysis of an application example, TWK — FD series with the original control unit can realize temperature, air conditioning system of low temperature hot water heating, new airflow control and so on many kinds of control ways, still can bring huge benefits of managing the sources of energy.

Author Keywords: TWK-FD series of new wind frost control unit

articleTitle: The design and research of the integration for heterogeneous database in campus card system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to the scientific development, standardized management, universities or colleges are exploring the construction of digital campus. However, in the pre-construction informationize process, the independent of one another. When a unified application platform will be constructed at a later stage, there have been a lot of heterogeneous data and heterogeneous databases. This paper analyzes the problems needing improvement and the matters deserving attention especially the heterogeneous distributed databases. For protecting the invest, we designed a heterogeneous databases integrated system basing on CORBA in this paper which solve the problems of heterogeneous data. Currently, the system has been applied in the campus card system.

articleTitle: Research on encryption technology based on J2ME socket network communication
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communication and Java technique, the wireless applications built on Java is of great promise. So it's important to pay more attention to their security. Based on the introduction of J2ME, this article also analyzes how to secure the new booming wireless application of J2ME, especially on small wireless device.This paper introduces communication technology on wireless networks based on the J2ME platform, deeply analyses the J2ME platform, and analyses the communication theory on programming interfaces of socket network; and then analyzes and compares several common encryption algorithms such as MD5, SHA1 and BASE64, etc. According to the performance and features of mobile phone network, I propose an encryption solution based on J2ME Socket protocol, realize this encryption program and give the source code of this encryption program in this paper.

articleTitle: Moving object segmentation based on background subtraction and fuzzy inference
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to improve the segmentation accuracy, reduce under-segmentation and over-segmentation, this paper proposes a new algorithm for detecting moving objects. The method is based on background subtraction algorithm and integrated with fuzzy inference for thresholding and background update. We use 7 fuzzy rules which can effectively model the membership of a pixel in a moving object during the fuzzy inference. The inference algorithm is both pixel-based and region-based. It properly segments the moving object from the stationary background. Moreover, the background model is updated by fuzzy logic with dynamic update rate over time to overcome the noise and illumination changes, which occurs frequently in complex natural environments. So the algorithm is suitable for a long run without losing accuracy. The experiment results show that our method is robust as well as fast in performance.

articleTitle: Forecasting monthly runoff using wavelet neural network model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: According to the nonlinear and the multi-time scale character of the Monthly runoff time series, the A Trous Algorithm was used to analyze the Monthly runoff time series of Panshitou Reservoir, Based on this result, the combination forecasting model was built by combining the wavelet analysis and artificial neural network, and the general steps and key algorithm of the model were proposed. This article in view of ordinary BP algorithm existence slow convergence, easy to immerging in partial minimum frequently, proposed one BP algorithm which based on Improved Conjugate Gradient Method. Using this model, simulate and forecast the monthly runoff, The results show that the model of combination wavelet analysis and artificial neural network has better capability of simulation for the process of monthly runoff, and the model used to predict with higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Investigation of cycle life of li-ion power battery pack based on LV-SVM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Take a certain lithium ion power battery pack as the research object, the experimental data shows that ambient temperature, discharge rate, number cycle and etc have great influence with cycle life of the power battery. This paper take capacity retention as characteristic index which is estimated by least square support vector machine (LV-SVM), experimental results show that the LV-SVM can estimate the variation regularity of capacity retention which varied with the cycle number of power battery pack, and has a high accuracy. The study of this paper takes an effective exploration for the entire vehicle matching and control strategy development of fuel electric vehicle.

articleTitle: A novel power converter of high voltage switched reluctance drive
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Due to the lack of withstand voltage of power electronic devices, and the voltage equalization among devices is hard to achieve when cascading the devices directly, the development of high-voltage switched reluctance drive has been blocked. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel high-voltage switched reluctance drive power converter structured by low-voltage power electronic devices. It introduces the composition and principles of the novel high-voltage switched reluctance drive power converter, describes its circuit and voltage superposition principle, and establishes the corresponding control strategy. It has been verified by experiments that the novel high voltage switched reluctance drive power converter could decrease the change rate of the motor winding voltage to reduce the threat against winding insulation, and make almost no harmonic pollution on the grid.

articleTitle: Regression-based modeling methods for solar radiant exposure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Solar radiant exposure is a vital parameter of solar radiation, which is used to estimate the photovoltaic power station output. The network of stations measuring the solar radiation data is sparse in many developing countries. In this paper nine years historical data for the year 2001-2009 from National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) Solar Radiation Research Laboratory (SRRL) are employed to produce and validate the radiant exposure models. Utilizing the regression analysis, the solar radiant exposure models on meteorological parameters such as sunshine duration, temperature and relative humidity are established. Validation proves that the models can calculate the solar radiant exposure efficiently.

articleTitle: A method of performances analysis to improve bus design
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The performances of the handling and stability and ride comfort have important influences on the bus design. To analyze them, the whole vehicle flexible model and road model are built by ADAMS software, and the performances of the original bus are simulated, the real vehicle tests are done to verify the simulation results. According to the universality design requirements of a bus enterprise, the universal program on the bus is proposed. The key parameters of the bus performances before and after universality design are evaluated. The values are reasonable by comparing. It concludes that the method of performances analysis is effective on the bus universality design and can save a lot of time and costs.

articleTitle: Research on enterprise application integration based on Web
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Along with the popularization of e-Commerce and the development of the business of the corporations, requirements of collaboration among supply systems of inter-corporations and inner-corporations become more and more popular. And traditional integration technologies of enterprise applications cannot adapt to the quick increment of the enterprise information system. The birth and development of Web provides a new integration technology for enterprise applications. At the same time, the IT infrastructure could provide a better service, let the enterprise, customer, partner, supplier and distributor attend commercial activity conveniently and get information what they want. This is the aim that every enterprise wants to reach. In order to attain this aim, they always use integration. Through this way all business entities would be related in together, share commercial data, and complete the commercial activity together. But tradition "point-to-point" integrated method unable to satisfy the enterprise's electronic commerce demand and cause high cost and low efficiency. An integration solution based on Web (face service construction) is put forward, which utilizes the open standard and protocol, from the global viewpoint, connect the enterprise's business process and IT infrastructure. Then a unified, standardized integration platform will be established.

articleTitle: Ship-mounted crane's heave compensation system based on hydrostatic secondary control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to expand work time window under high sea state, hydrostatic secondary control was proposed to winch system of ship-mounted crane to reduce influence of vessel motion. System models of passive and active heave compensation mode were simulated. Cascade control strategies based on conventional PID and fuzzy PID were used to active heave compensation (AHC) system. As a result, approximate 90 percent of vessel motion was eliminated for payload.

articleTitle: A personalized search engine research based on Bloom filter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Personalization of search engines is to achieve retrieval for different users with different interests. In this paper, we propose a personalized search engine based on Bloom filter. Bloom filter, an effective space data structure, is used in the research of personalized search. The user interest model based on Bloom filter contains one standard Bloom filter and multiple Counting Bloom filters, and the design of multi-level structure can accurately represent weights of interest keywords. According to this structure, the interest adjustment algorithm and the keywords matching algorithm are proposed at the same time. After experimental evaluation, the results indicate that this model has not only high space efficiency but high retrieval accuracy as well.

articleTitle: Research on transforming continuous-time system into discrete-time system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The most popular technique of transforming continuous-time system into discrete-time system is Euler substitution method or Tustin substitution method. In these methods, the relationship between the differential coefficient operator s and displacement operator z is fixed, and the transforming precision isn't high. So a non-standard substituted method based on different relationship between the differential coefficient operator s and displacement operator z is advanced, and a group of equation is deduced. The simulation indicated that non-standard substituted method which compared with the standard substituted method is more flexible and has high precision than Euler and Tustin method.

articleTitle: The monitoring expert system of colliery safety production
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the monitoring expert system of coal safety production is becoming a new topic in today's society. Because of the computer technology need and characteristics in the coal mining industry, this article's research object is the existing internet-based monitoring safety system of the coal mine production. The application of artificial intelligence and expert system technology in this system makes the issues such as intelligence, automation, standardization of monitoring the coal mine safety production possible. We set up the alarm for the corresponding diagnosis of the accident in accordance with the working principle of coal mine safety production monitoring system, and with the hope to raise the production efficiency and to reduce the occurrence of coal mine accidents.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of timetable system based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper we establish a new algorithm based on greedy method and Genetic Algorithms to solve course timetabling problem. Timetabling is a kind of problem in which events (classes, exams, courses, etc) have to be arranged into a number of timeslots such that conflicts in using a given set of resources are avoided. First, the greedy method is used to achieve automatic course arrangement and obtain a set of feasible initial solutions. And then, use Genetic Algorithms (GA) to optimize the initial solutions of course timetables by fitness function. The experiment results show the optimized course timetables are more reasonable.

articleTitle: The distortion correction of large view wide-angle lens for image mosaic based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For the distortion correction of wide-angle lens for image mosaic technique in the vehicle-mounted back draft image system, this paper presents a new method that applies multinomial curve fitting algorithm to calculate the distortion parameters with OpenCV software on the basis of the VC platform to finish the distortion correction on the basic of polar coordinates transform. Because the solution of distortion parameters is independent with the solution of other camera parameters, the calibration precision has been improved and the correction precision also has been raised. The method in this paper can be applied to real-time vehicle mounted back-draft image system. Finally, an example has been given in order to assess distortion correction precision, and the paper also calculates quantitatively the TV distortion of different filed view before and after correction of large view wide-angle lens, then we can observe the effect of correction by comparing the results of distortion correction.

articleTitle: Accelerating finding euler circuit on CPU-GPGPU heterogeneous architecture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: GPU (Graphic Processing Unit) provides a large computational performance at a very low price. Algorithms with regular data access map well to the SIMD architecture of current GPU, while irregular algorithms on discrete data structures like graphs are hard to map. In this paper, we transform the prior algorithm, design special data structures, and present an optimized CPU-GPU implementation for finding Euler circuit on a randomly generated Eulerian graph. It can deal with a graph of 4096 vertices and 1.7 million edges in about 1 second, which has a speed up of about 50 times over the best sequential CPU implementation.

articleTitle: Implementation of motion control technique for stepper motor translation stages in online detection system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In the process of microtarget assembling, the geometrical parameters of the microtarget need to be measured in real-time by the online detection system with four-axis linkage. So the moving performance and positioning accuracy of every motorized axis are crucial to the measurement. This paper proposed a new motion control technique for linear translation stages with stepper motor. The control algorithm was realized on field programmable gate array (FPGA) and digital signal processor (DSP), and met the high-efficiency and high-precision measurement requirements. An efficient and optimized speed control performance was achieved by using a method that was based on speed-difference driving and speed-table supplying, and a high-precision, closed-loop positioning control performance which has an error less than ±0.3μm was achieved by using a method that was based on position feedback, position window restriction and time-window restriction.

articleTitle: The key technology of distribution transformer and static var compensator integration system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Towards the reactive compensation feature of distribution network and integral substation, this paper proposed an integration structure of distribution transformer and STATCOM (DT-STATCOM). It use the surplus capacity of transformer to compensate the reactive power; by setting the connect voltage flexible, it extended the switching devices selection; the integration structure reduce the volume and cost of compensation device. Based on the structure of DT-STATCOM, this paper proposed two novel reactive current detection method across the transformer's ports. Then the paper designed the decision control system using multi-lateral information. Simulation result showed that, the DT-STATCOM system had significant effect on dynamic reactive power compensation, transformer voltage support and imbalance inhibition.

articleTitle: Optimization design of urban sewage source heat pump system with freezing latent heat collection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Accounting into the differences of heat load of the sewage emission and heat demand of the building, it is not able to satisfy the heating user only by the limited temperature difference sensible heat in many small trunk canals, a new heat pump system named urban sewage source heat pump system with freezing latent heat collection is proposed. In this system, the freezing latent heat is used as the heating source of the heat pump at peak heat load in winter as well as the sensible heat. Then the problem of the system design becomes one important issue, with the annual cost value as an evaluation criterion, it was optimized on the system design. The result shows that the new heat pump system is superior in the economy than the traditional chiller and heating network system.

articleTitle: Immune genetic algorithm for solving nonlinear equations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A steam conversion of hydrocarbon mass balance of the nonlinear equations of the immune genetic algorithm method is researched in this paper. The nonlinear equations is transformed into nonlinear optimization problems; The transformation process and implementation are discussed, this method is used to quickly and easily obtain the effective solution of the production technology. The production process used to solve practical problems, optimize production, increase economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of coal mine underground drainage pump monitoring and controlling system based on PLC and touch screen
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Coal mine underground drainage system undertakes the important task of draining all the inflow produced during the process of production in underground coalmine, hence it is important equipment in mine production. The design of monitoring and control system of underground drainage pump is thus particularly important. In this paper, according to the practical underground work situations of a mine, a set of monitoring and control system of underground drainage pump based on PLC of Siemens S7-200 series and 10-inch touch screen of Delta DOP-B series (HM1) was designed. This system adopts S7-200 series CPU224PLC and EM231A/D module as its core, collects the operation parameters of underground drainage pump and displays them, automatically controls the startup and shutdown of drainage pump, monitors the water mark of shaft sump, and gives alarms in case of too high water level. It operates reliably and has high cost performance, thus enjoying bright prospect for promotion.

articleTitle: Development and implement of the IP camera based on DM6437
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An IP camera based on Tl's DaVinci DSP-TMS320DM6437 is developed in this paper. An intelligent video surveillance system is established using the designed IP camera. The real-time capture of the video is implemented in the system as well as the compression coding of the video using H.264 and the transmission of the encoded video through network. In the section of network communication, the performance of DSP processor in three scenes is tested, which is convenient for developers to optimize.

articleTitle: A design of on-line intelligent lock of anti-maloperation system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This article firstly discusses the current situations of anti-misoperation system in power system. In order to meet the new requirements for the anti-maloperation anti-lock system in the development of new technologies and changes in the mode of management, the computer lock must have more new functions such as telemetry, remote transfer, remote control and so on, except for the original functions. In order to resolve these problems, we put forward a new design of the intelligent lock which is mainly based on the technology of wireless sensor network. Finally, we give the circuit diagram of the hardware components based on FREESCALE single chip and describe how to design the software. This type of intelligent lock could meet the new requirements for the anti-maloperation anti-lock system of the new operating mode.

articleTitle: The design of Prepayment Energy Meter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper design a Wireless Prepayment Energy Meter, which is used to measure single-phase energy with 50/60Hz rated frequency. It realizes the functions of prepayment management and load control that pay of energy first & use it afterwards, the data can be exchanged between Energy meters and Energy supplying department by RF cards. The information can be transmitted in a non-contact way. In this way, the purpose of automatic identification can be achieved. The paper describes hardware design firstly, then software designs.

articleTitle: Modeling passenger flow of rail station in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Construction of urban traffic has developed very fast in recent years. The attention to space for passengers is paid increasingly. The design of passing space depends on the understanding of behaviors of passengers. The paper presents the behaviors of behaviors of passenger from macroscopic and microscopic aspects in china. The relationship of passenger's flow-density, capacity and other factors affecting on passenger flow are discussed. Then, the decision and motion behaviors of microscopic model are also analyzed. The development of passenger flow model falls behind Occident. The paper further discusses the current development, deficiencies and trends of passenger flow model.

articleTitle: Research on the BOF steelmaking endpoint temperature prediction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: One aim of basic oxygen furnace (BOF) steelmaking endpoint control is the temperature control. For the majority of the china's small or medium BOF, sublance can not be used as a result of restrictions of production conditions, so, researching the BOF endpoint control without sublance has a significant application value. For the data's characteristics of nonlinearity and high noises in the field, a new algorithm combining the DBSCAN clustering algorithm with the RBF neural network algorithm was proposed. It was used to achieve effective treatment of the noises, furthermore, it will be applied to the prediction of endpoint temperature of BOF steelmaking. Simulation results show that the RBF neural network with DBSCAN has more advantages than the original RBF neural network in dealing with sample sets of high noises. The new RBF neural network has a higher hit rate, which improved the versatility and practicality of RBF neural network.

articleTitle: The remote terminal design and implementation of 1553B based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a remote terminal design of 1553B based on DSP (TMS320F2812) ,which is specially applicable to aviation airborne equipment. The bus of 1553B chip, structures of DSP and BU-61580 are simply introduced, also the hardware interface and software design between the DSP and agreement interface are illuminated.

articleTitle: A easy user interface of IR system over large scale deep web
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The Deep Web is characterized by its large scale, domain diversity, very high-quality content, and vast heterogeneous collections of structured data. Traditional data integration techniques are no longer valid in the face of such heterogeneity and scale, and the integrated interfaces can become too complicated for ordinary users to use. In this paper, we propose a novel keyword-based user interface system EasyUI for achieving web-scale data integration and easy to use for ordinary users. Dealing with heterogeneity on the web-scale presents many new challenges. We proposed new methods to address these challenges, i.e., indexing schemata terms, data values, and domains features of the Deep Web, processing user input, mapping the user query to domain that the user query most likely corresponds to, and translating the user query into candidate structured queries for the domain. Our experiments show that EasyUI performs effectively.

articleTitle: Dynamic performance of microturbine and fuel cell in a microgrid
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The concept of microgrid becomes increasingly important, in which renewable energy, distributed generation, and distributed storage systems can be integrated into the grid. This paper presents dynamic models of microturbine and fuel cells as distributed generators to study their dynamic behavior within a microgrid. In addition, The Buck-Boost converter and voltage source inverter are adopted as the electronic interface with its fixed controller to maintain the stability of systems. Dynamic models of microturbine and fuel cells are simulated using PSCAD/EMTDC software to demonstrate that they are capable of providing reliable power in both the grid connected and islanding modes of operation.

articleTitle: Application of active disturbance rejection controller for high precision servo system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Friction is a key factor that influences the low velocity performance of high precision servo systems. It usually causes the steady-state error of servo systems and results in the creeping phenomenon in low velocity motions. Friction is complicated nonlinear process with time-varying uncertainties. The traditional PID controller of servo systems with friction was not satisfactory in control precision and response time. In this paper,the model of servo system is obtained through open-loop U - Ω curve and the compensating voltage for friction torque is estimated so as to eliminate the friction disturbance via feedforward compensation.A new algorithm that combines the advantages of ADRC'(active disturbance rejection controller) and friction torque feedforward compensation is proposed Comparison experiments with the new ADRC technique and the common PID algorithm are carried out on the servo system. The result demonstrates that the improved ADRC technique could reduce steady-state error to only one third of the one using the PID algorithm.

articleTitle: The design of photovoltaic radar target simulator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this study we proposed a set of the design for the photovoltaic radar target simulator to test photovoltaic radar performance, specifically used for accurately testing photovoltaic radar's detecting, capturing the target and tracking the infrared targets. We focused on photovoltaic radar target simulator motion control parts and software's design, and then simplified the composition and principles of photovoltaic radar target simulator. We took advantage of SCM to control the brightness changes of infrared light, which can simulate the external environment, the motive components was controlled by motion control card and designed as two dimension plane, which can drive infrared target source to move broadly. Proved by the experiment, the entire system is stable and reliable.

articleTitle: The study of traction control system for Omni-directional electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Traction control system is studied based on the Omni-directional vehicle which is built by our research group. The research mainly involves two aspects, vehicle state estimation and vehicle traction control logic design. Extended Kalman Estimation relying on multiple degrees of freedom vehicle model is used to estimate vehicle longitudinal speed, lateral speed, side slip angle, and yaw rate. Traction control system calculates tire slip ratios of four wheels according to the estimated vehicle velocity, and then traction control logic is designed by PID control. Simulations based on Carsim and Matlab/Simulink show that vehicle state estimation algorithm estimates vehicle speed, side slip angle and yaw rate effectively, and traction control logic can prevent wheel from excessive spinning using by the estimated slip ratio to improve vehicle acceleration performance and directional stability.

articleTitle: Analysis of the roller-race contact deformation of cylindrical roller bering using a improved slice method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Since the slice method have the advantage of less computation quantity and being easier to use, it is often used to solve the deformation of contact between crowned roller and race in rolling elements bearing analysis. Due to the neglecting of relationship among the roller slices, this method often had a low calculation precision in some instances. The paper presented a revised force-deformation relationship of the contacted slice by analyzing of the error resource of traditional slice method. Thus an improved new slice method was obtained and was programmed into computer code. Calculating result showed the improved slice method can obtain a pressure distribution along the roller axis more reasonable than the traditional one, and its function is extended to analyze the edge effect of roller-race contact which the tradition one can't do. Calculations were conducted for several different crowned rollers in a relatively wider range of forces, and the result was compared with that of traditional slice method and the full numeric calculation. The evidence show that the method presented in this paper had a high precision while hadn't add too much computation quantity and it can be directly used in the dynamic analysis and simulation of roller bearing.

articleTitle: Time frequency analysis of multi-component non-stationary signal with filter bank decomposition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to acquire outer cross term free time frequency distribution of multi-component nonstationary signal, filter bank technique was used to decompose the signal being analyzed. With filter bank, the signal was decomposed as spectral components belong to different subbands, for each spectral component, divided it as different time segment signal in time domain and combined different time segment signal which belongs to different subbands according to time continuity, the independent major components of the signal were formed. The Wigner-Ville distribution of the multi-components signal was calculated, the Wigner-Ville distribution of the independent major components were superimposed as the time frequency distribution of multi-components signal. Contrast between the two distributions show the decomposition method is practical and give outer cross term free time frequency distribution.

articleTitle: Research on traction slip control algorithm for parallel hybrid cars
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Traction slip control algorithm and strategy for parallel hybrid vehicle are proposed in this paper. Based on the torque distribution strategy of parallel cars, the torque control strategy and algorithm and brake control strategy of TCS are designed. Under the environment of Matlab/Simulink, the vehicle model and TCS controller model of parallel Hybrid Electric vehicle are built. The simulation test is performed on the low μ road. The simulation results show that the control algorithm can prevent the driven wheels from spinning effectively.

articleTitle: The influence of parallel hybrid vehicle on synchronizer performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Compared with conventional vehicle, axis-fixed gear parallel hybrid vehicle adds a motor which is usually installed between clutch and transmission. This will lead to increase transmission the input shaft inertia, synchronization inertia, speed, and rotor speed difference, which will make the conventional synchronizer difficult to meet the synchronization requires of the hybrid vehicle. This paper builds a mathematical model of synchronous process based on the actual working conditions of synchronizer and then analyses it in detail. Its focus is the influence of the increased synchronization inertia on synchronization time and heat capacity. In order to improve the gear-shift quality, some optimization measures aiming at synchronizer structure, lubrication, friction material, and active synchronization control are proposed in this paper. It does some forward-looking work for the synchronizer design of hybrid vehicle.

articleTitle: Realization of a LSB Information Hiding algorithm based on lifting wavelet transform image
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper proposed LSB Information Hiding algorithm which can Lift wavelet transform image. Furthermore, made the objective evaluation of image quality by the peak signal to noise ratio and normalized cross correlation coefficient. Achieving the purpose of information hiding with the secret bits of information to replace the random noise, using the lowest plane embedding secret information to avoid noise and attacks, making use of redundancy to enhance the sound embedded in the way nature to be addressed. The results showed that the proposed algorithm has a very good hidden invisibility, good security and robustness for a lot of hidden attacks.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of CNC machine tools based on matter-element model and extensional evaluation method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: On the basis of matter-element and extension set in extension theory, the paper use the level, evaluation indexes and characteristics value on the reliability evaluation of CNC machine tools as a matter-element. Then we can determine the classical field, controlled field and the matter to be evaluated on the subsystem of the numerically-controlled machine tools. Finally we apply the matter-element and correlation function of extension set to establish the reliability matter-element evaluation model for CNC machine tools. Due to the range of correlation function is the whole real number field, the evaluation can make full use of information and reflect subsystems' reliability more comprehensively and effectively. So evaluation result is more objective and precise.

articleTitle: Study on equivalent circuit model of partial discharge in power transformers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the partial discharge mechanism of power transformers and on such a basis, establishes an equivalent circuit model. In this paper, we take the partial discharge source as the equivalent of a second order differential circuit composed by resistors, inductors and capacitors, and the moment that partial discharge happens as the moment to power up the circuit. In the process from transient state to steady one, the circuit current appears to decay exponentially, So does the partial discharge signal. This coincidence proves the validity of the equivalent circuit model.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of air compressor based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Because the air compressor has too many fault types, so it is often difficult to make the fault diagnosis of air compressor. For example, the detected variables are too many then it is difficult to take fault classification. The method of making use of RBF neural networks to achieve the fault diagnosis of air compressor is proposed in the paper. For the sample data is used to train RBF neural networks, thus the process of handling a large number of data detected is predigested. The RBF neural network is used to automatically identify the running states of air compressors. Simulation results show that the method that using RBF neural networks to achieve the fault diagnosis of air compressor is a feasible and very effective, and can achieve a higher diagnostic efficiency.

articleTitle: New visual angle of thinking mode transition in programming teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Through the knowledge about the reality, and in-depth research in Chinese traditional thinking mode and programming, a new visual angle of thinking mode transition in programming is put forward. This visual angle includes that thought transformation is carried out by using the viewpoints of associating and opposing, and with the thinking mode that explodes whole into parts. Combining the viewpoints of associating and opposing, real meaning of programming codes is restored, the internal relations of programming teaching and the reality are revealed, and basic direction to solve the problems in the process of programming teaching development is indicated in order to promote thinking mode of the students.

Author Keywords: the viewpoints of associating and oppoang

articleTitle: Research for service deployment based on MPLS L3 VPN technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In the present, building MPLS L3 VPN is based on inputting complicated commands manually to accomplish the configuration of network devices, thereby it is necessary to make use of network management system to configure devices and service in the private network effectively. In this paper, the model of network management system was roughly introduced, and the process of service deployment was described in detail, supporting various solutions of building network and routing protocols, to work out the problem generated by manual configuration. Test results were used to indicate its effectiveness and practicability.

articleTitle: A hybrid algorithm for mid-long term hydrothermal generation scheduling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper presents a deterministic model, which takes into account the final water storage and the effects of water head, for optimal mid-long term generation scheduling of a hydrothermal system. Considering its large scale mixed integer nonlinear structure, a hybrid algorithm based on Genetic Algorithm and decomposition algorithm is developed to solve it. The model is divided into thermal power dispatch and hydro power dispatch subproblems respectively by using reservoir volumes as genetic variables which consider the complex relationship between reservoirs. These two subproblems are independently solved according to their own characteristics. The simulation results reveal that comparing with GA the hybrid algorithm is an effective method with shorter computation time and higher precision.

articleTitle: Color image enhancement based on rough set and adaptive genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper combines rough set theory and adaptive genetic algorithm to enhance color image. First, regard the image as a knowledge system, and adopt classification method of rough set theory to combine image color attribute and noise attribute to classify the image, and then come into image boundary region and apply different enhancement algorithms to enhance the image. During rough set classification, use adaptive genetic algorithm to optimize threshold to obtain a best classification result. As image enhancement can be effectively carried out through practical application and verification, therefore, such algorithm has some certain application value.

articleTitle: Triangle matching combined with singular features in fingerprints
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Fingerprint matching process is identical to the generation of equivalent triangular frameworks with the minutiae at their vertices. Triangle descriptor is introduced to evaluate similarity of two triangles that integrates characteristic components of the minutiae triangle with global orientation field information. To reduce computational complexity of finding correspondent triangles, fingerprint image is separated into a series of circular areas utilizing the belief function of singular points. Seed triangles are searched in limited regions that are invariant to rotation and translation and robust to distortion of fingerprints. A set of experiments have been done on different database and the better performance has been achieved.

articleTitle: A CMOS dB-linear variable amplifier using curvematching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A CMOS dB-linear Variable Gain Amplifier (VGA) using Curvematching is presented. The CMOS dB-linear VGA provides a variable gain of 59 dB while maintaining -3 dB bandwidth greater than 86 MHz. Curvematching is proposed to obtain the dB-linear gain control characteristics based on a low-distortion source-degenerated differential amplifier structure. Nonideal effects on dB linearity are analyzed and the methods for improvement are suggested. The VGA is designed in a 0.13 μm CMOS technology and the post-simulation results demonstrate the good dB linearity, good property of total harmonic distortion and noise figure.

articleTitle: Double loop control for magnetic levitation vibrator based on auto-disturbance rejection
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new active magnetic levitation vibrator is studied, it is a mixed magnetic levitation system which is made up of permanent magnets and electromagnets, it can reach flexible damp vibration by using the mutual repulsive force between the magnets to provide levitating force. Based on the modeling of the system, According to the nonlinearity of magnetic levitation system of the vibrator, the existence of non-modeling dynamic and uncertainty, and the inaccurate characteristic of the model, we put forward that, with the auto-disturbance rejection controller as outer loop, PID controller as inner loop, to form double-loop feedback control scheme to achieve a stable levitation, damping and disturbance resistance. Comparative analysis by simulation and experiment research show that the magnetic levitation vibrator with this controlling scheme has good dynamic, static characteristic and strong disturbance resistance.

articleTitle: Research on the third party logistics supplier selection evaluation based on AHP and entropy
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Corporation own-running logistics are often inefficient, so more and more corporation choose outsource logistics, that is, corporation use the third-party logistics suppliers to provide logistics services. The third-party logistics can simplify the distribution sectors, transport reasonably, use and allocate rationally the existing resources, and avoid the problems of funds used, low transportation efficiency, complicated distribution sectors and urban pollution increase brought by the own-running logistics. The third-party logistics meet the requirements of low-carbon and environmental protection environment. In logistics outsourcing, the selection of the third party logistics providers is the most important part, only selecting the appropriate logistics providers, enterprises can improve their competitiveness. To select the appropriate logistics providers, an effective evaluation method is essential. This paper built the AHP / information entropy model, and used this model to evaluate the third-party logistics providers. This model evaluated the logistics providers by the combination of subjective and objective, and ensured enterprises to choose the third-party logistics provider more scientific and reasonable.

articleTitle: An improved algorithm of multiple pattern matching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Combined with the advantages of the BM algorithm, an improved, faster algorithm of multiple pattern matching is put forward based on the AQR algorithm. The proposed algorithm skips as many characters as possible by making full use of position information of the last failed matching to achieve a higher performance. The experiments and analysis show that the proposed algorithm has a better performance than the AQR algorithm, especially when characters occur repeatedly in the target text but its occurrence probability in pattern strings is small.

articleTitle: The development of rotation investigation wall-climbing robot
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a wall-climbing robot of investigation that uses the passive vibration of the negative pressure adsorption mode and the new type of round of foot-type alternating walking. It describes the working principle of the robot and its key structure, its main components were checked and the simulation analysis, and the component of the controllable system was illustrated.

articleTitle: Development of linear servo control system for CNC machine tool based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The linear servo systems have the advantages of high velocity, precise servo feeding, excellent stability and rapidly dynamic performance, which can be used as the most promising high-performance feeding system for CNC (Computer Numerical Control) machine tools. According to the index demands of CNC machine tool for linear feeding system, the corresponding control system based on DSP (Digital Signal Processor) is designed in detail. The system employs DSP-TMS320F2812 as the control core, and an Intelligent Power Module (IPM) as the power driven circuit. This paper will mainly focus on the hardware structure and software program of linear servo control system, and the debugging work and experimental process are also introduced. The satisfactory results demonstrate that the proposed linear servo control system is feasible and reasonable, which can be applied in the CNC machine tools.

articleTitle: An effective image shape feature detection and description method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To solve the problems of complexity and low robustness that exist in present image shape feature detection and description methods, a new image shape feature detection and description method is proposed. First, salient regions are detected using a method based on connected component. Then, a descriptor composed of Hu's moment invariants and eccentricity is used to descript the detected regions. Experiments show its effectiveness and robustness to translation, rotation and scaling.

articleTitle: Designing hardware-in-the-loop simulation system for missile with high level architecture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The hardware-in-the-loop simulation system is a necessary technique in the development of modern weapons. To improve the precision and real-time of the hardware-in-the-loop simulation system, the High Level architecture(HLA) is used to construct a new hardware-in-the-loop simulation system. Firstly, we give a brief introduction to HLA and apply HLA to the hardware-in-the-loop simulation system. A simulation support software developed according to the specifications of HLA interface, RTI provides a number of interconnected simulation services and serve as the basis for the HLA simulation system to do layer management and extensible distributed simulation. The whole simulation system is considered as a federation and distributed into several federations to carry out the distributed simulation. We reach the conclusion that the problems for the practical application of HLA to a large-scale interactive simulation system will be solved by enhancing the algorithm and performance of RTI software.

articleTitle: Research on dual-thumb pneumatic flexible robot hand
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper has a design and analysis on the dual thumb pneumatic flexible robot hand base on the active flexible bending joints we have developed. The flexible joint is composed of four elongation artificial muscles with parallel arrangement. The robot hand has five multi-actuated fingers each with three flexible joints. To improve the flexibility and stability of grasp, the other four fingers are orthogonal and symmetrical except the middle finger, which forms the dual thumb oriented grasp model. Furthermore, we study on the position and posture of fingers applying the parameterized homogeneous transformation to the large deformation and nonlinear problems of flexible joint; establish the mathematical models when the fingers bending, anti-stretching, abducent and adducent. The simulation and experiments verifies the model and the grasp capability of robot hand. The robot hand we developed has good flexibility and compliance, and easy to soft control, which provide a new way to solve the entire flexibility of robot hand.

articleTitle: Basic research on reverse logistics implemented by enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: As a new field of logistics management, reverse logistics does not attract the attention of the whole society and corporate, by learning foreign advanced management experience and the theory of reverse logistics, analyzing the necessity and urgency of developing reverse logistics of Chinese business and elaborating the factors that can influence the implementation of reverse logistics, how can businesses develop and improve the reverse logistics is summarized in the end of the article.

articleTitle: Static path planning of tracked mobile manipulator and simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Path planning of the robot is searching the best motion path with some appropriate algorithm under some certain constraint condition. Path planning is the foundation of motion control of the robots. Based on the kinematic modeling and optimized configuration of tracked mobile manipulator with 5+1 degrees of freedom, translate path planning problem into optimization problem. Set certain initial conditions and target end position, plan the path using genetic algorithm, and then simulate and analyze with Matlab. The innovation of this paper is that usage of the optimization criterion in allusion to the manipulator we research, solve the problem of path planning of manipulator with genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and realization of the intelligent temperature transmitter
