publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The analog input signals of intelligent temperature transmitter (ITT) are milli-voltage signals, AD7714 was selected was selected for small signal acquisition. The new technology of potential lifting was explored to ensure the stability and accuracy of sampling. The wiring technology of small signal was presented. ITT's switching power supply was designed to meet the requirements of security and isolation. The parameter calculation of high-frequency transformer was mainly researched. Constant current source circuit was designed to measure the voltage of resistance temperature detector (RTD). The method of transforming dividing table into flash memory was also presented. ITT can be connected with multi-type RTD, multi-type thermocouple and millivolt signal. The test error is about ±1°C in -200°C~850°C when Pt100 is used.

articleTitle: A new MPPT control strategy: Study of auto-adapted step size incremental conductance method based on segmented numerical approximation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: On analysis of the relation between dl/dV+I/V and V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">modify</sub> (the deviation between the instantaneous value of system output voltage and the value of maximum power point voltage) for PV systems, this paper proposed an auto-adapted step size incremental conductance MPPT method based on segmented numerical approximation. We built the PV system model with the solar cell block and the MPPT controller using Matlab/Simulink. Then, we used that model to emulate the tracking effectiveness of this algorithm when the illumination intensity changed sharply. The result verified that the proposed method can effectively improve the tracking speed and accuracy simultaneously. As compared with other more complex methods, such as the gradient iteration solution and intelligent control method, the proposed approach is simpler and easier to implement.

articleTitle: Nonlinear robust control for excitation systems base on the ESO-BackStepping method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper presents a new control method for excitation system. The extended state observer (ESO) is used to estimate the model error and the uncertain external disturbance of the excitation system, and dynamically to eliminate them. The controller of the excitation system, feedback by ESO, can easily be designed by the backstepping method. The ESO-Backstepping method is dynamically eliminating the nonlinear part of the system selectively, so that the calculating load of the ESO is light and the controller has both superior static, dynamic performance and strong robustness. The simulation result has proved it.

Author Keywords: nonlinear robust control for excitation system

articleTitle: Effect of substrate negative bias on GIDL current in LDD nMOSFET's
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The effect of substrate negative bias V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</sub> on the gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) current is studied. It is found that the negative V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</sub> leads GIDL current curve shifts upwards. The shift of GIDL current ΔI<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>/I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub> increases with increasing |V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</sub>|. The GIDL current at V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>=-0.2V (in the low field region) increases with increasing |V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</sub>| more largely than that at V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>=-1.2V (in the high field region).This is because that the negative V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</sub> results in the additional GIDL tunneling current in the lateral direction and it has the different effects on the low field region and high field region. It is also found that ΔI<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>/I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub> at V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>=0.8V is larger than that at V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>=0.4V under V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>=-1.2V and is smaller than that at V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>=0.4V under V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>= 0.2V. This ascribes the different roles of the GIDL vertical tunneling current and the GIDL lateral current induced by negative V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</sub> on the whole GIDL current.

articleTitle: A CMT congestion window updates mechanism based on TCP Westwood
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: TCP Westwood is an enhancement algorithm using the ACK estimated available bandwidth. CMT based on the SCTP use the radical Reno mechanism to update congestion window control and it leads to frequently retransmit the packets. Through the study of TCP Westwood, basing on CMT retransmission mechanism and cwnd update policy, this paper put forward a new policy, which can estimate the bandwidth, update the cwnd and transmit the data packets efficiently on bottleneck bandwidth. NS2 simulation showed the improvements of the throughput and packet loss rate.

articleTitle: An embedded real-time remote monitoring system based on B/S mode
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to achieve the purpose of cross-platform remote monitoring simply and conveniently, this paper has done a research on a remote real-time monitoring system accessed by browsers. A web server is established successfully in the embedded Linux operating system, which takes ARM-processor S3C2440 as the core of hardware. Users can monitor remote temperature, humidity and video information only by using a browser. The experiment results show that the system is stable, with quick responded humiture and fluent video, realizes the cross-platform operation, and possesses very good expansibility and certain practical value.

articleTitle: Almost sure central limit theorem on maxima and minima
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: We prove an almost sure central limit theorem on maxima and minimal: lim<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(n → ∞)</sub> 1/ log n Σ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup><sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k=1</sub> 1/k(l) (v<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">K</sub> <; m <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">K</sub> ≤ M <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">K</sub> ≤ μ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">K</sub>) = e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(T+η)</sup> a.s. as the Stationary Gaussian sequence with covariance r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> under the condition 1/n Σ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(k=1)</sub> |r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>| log l exp {γ|r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>|log k } ≪ (log log n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-(1+ε)</sup>.

articleTitle: Research and realization on CDIO teaching experimental system based on RFID technique of Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Along with development of technique of Internet of Things, RFID technique has been increasingly mature as well. In the thesis, RFID technique of Internet of Things is introduced into CDIO experimental teaching to establish a kind of new teaching model, which realizes deep integration of related techniques of interdiscipline in different fields. The key problem in the thesis is to exactly acquire the experiment process as the basis for experiment and design expandable experimental rules so that students can originate experiments independently and comprehensive talents with CDIO quality can be cultivated.

articleTitle: The recognition and applications of floating cars' driving behaviors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper classified drivers' driving behaviors into rotation of steering wheel, the stampede of clutch, brake and throttle, the shift of gear and some other primary driving behaviors. Concerning about the needs of practical application and considering the requirements of convenience, real time and accuracy fully, we researched how to measure these primary driving behaviors on the simulated driving platform constructed by ourselves. And then we discussed how to conclude floating cars' driving behaviors from these primary driving behaviors combining with velocity, location and direction information of floating cars. After that, we applied logical reasoning methods and D-S reasoning theory to describe city road traffic conditions based on recognizing floating cars' driving behaviors. We developed a cognitive system for floating cars' driving behaviors on this basis. This cognitive system has a significant impact on forecasting and solving city traffic problems.

articleTitle: A network intrusion detection method based on combined model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to make the detecting rate faster and improve the accuracy of network intrusion detection, this paper ameliorated a network intrusion detection method which was based on combining support vector machines and LVQ (Learning vector quantization) neural network algorithm. The method combines the popularizing capability of SVM and the learning capability of LVQ neural network. It overcame the shortcomings of traditional neural network algorithm, such as the slower learning speed and the larger possibility of falling into local minimum. Examples proved that this combined model had faster speed and higher rate of accuracy . What is more, it better resolved a series of detecting problems, such as nonlinearity, small-sample, high-dimension and local minimum.

articleTitle: Research in energy metering device of natural gas
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, a kind of method in natural gas energy measurement is improved based on traditional flow automatic metering system of natural gas, which combines with natural gas composition analysis software in order to measure natural gas energy. Then, it introduces the uncertainty and the traceability of natural gas.

articleTitle: Data processing method of multi-position strap-down north seeking system based on SVD
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With the aim to fit the sin wave curve of a multi position strap-down north seeking system and to calculate the real north angle accurately, the principles of the system and the algorithm of singular value decomposition(SVD) are introduced. The factors influencing the measuring precision are also analyzed. Then, the algorithm is adopted to fit curves. Experimental results indicate that the singular value decomposition is very precise, for its error sum is 1.1 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> μV, and the squared error is 2.8mV. Moreover, for phase angle measurement, measured six times in same direction, the squared error is 24" (1σ) . The method based on SVD can satisfy the system precision requirements of curve-fitting north seeking systems.

articleTitle: Study on a method of rapid transfer alignment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For the rapidity and accuracy which airborne INS transfer alignment requires, the paper analyzed different transfer alignment matching method, chose velocity plus attitude matching method, deduced system error model and measurement equation in detail. Finally, the paper designed a new Kalman filter for simulation with a classic trajectory. Simulation shows that, the estimation of the misalignment angles can reach the accuracy requirement in a short time, the design of simulation is accurate, and the velocity plus attitude matching method is efficient.

articleTitle: Fault tolerant control for spacecraft based on adaptive fast terminal sliding mode
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The paper propose a novel method for designing fault tolerant controller based on adaptive fast terminal sliding mode control to address the tracking control problem of spacecraft with unknown external disturbances and an uncertain inertia matrix. In this approach, a robust controller based on fast terminal sliding mode control scheme is designed in the absence of fault detection and diagnosis through adaptive approach which applied to estimate the fault minimum value of actuator fault. Through this approach, the closed-loop system globally asymptotically stability and fault tolerant control is achieved in the finite time while the disturbance is suppressed when actuaors fault occurred. Numerical simulations have demonstrated that the proposed approach could force the system to the equilibrium points in a fast convergence rate while improve the robustness and reliability with respect to common sliding mode method.

articleTitle: The U-boot transplantation based on S3C2440
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: U-boot, as a good Linux boot loader, has great power and fast updating speed, however, it has not yet provided the original support for the S3C2440 processor. This article, through transplanting files that are supported by the S3C2410 processor, makes it support the S3C2440 and goes successfully through tests by Mini2440 development board.

articleTitle: Energy strategy develop dominant decision-making based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The development of sustainable energy is national strategy's basis for sustainable development. Both China and the world are facing the problem that the current energy crisis restricts the economic development. Therefore, the implementation of energy strategy as a long-term effective method, it can fundamentally solve the energy bottleneck. Which kind of energy will be used as the dominant energy to develop in energy strategy, By AHP, the paper will quantitatively give the conclusions. Finally, it gives recommendations to a new energy-oriented energy strategy's implementation.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a WLAN intrusion detection and DoS attack analyze system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The characteristic of the IEEE802.11 protocol and the principle of the DoS attack against 802.11 WLAN is analyzed in this paper. a general system model for WLAN network intrusion detection and 802.11 DoS attack analysis based on the intelligent terminal is advanced. On the base of the research on using NDIS IMD to realize packet capturing and its developing process, a system of intrusion detection and DoS attack analysis was designed and implemented based on the PDA, it realized the platform mechanism of the detection and analysis function, and satisfied the need of mobility. Real-time well.

articleTitle: Software design of SD card reader and image processor based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: We designed a useful digital signal generating system which transforms BMP file stored in SD card into SDI output signal based on the FPGA hardware platform. This paper presents the software design method of the digital signal generating system. The function of NIOS II CPU will be achieved by making use of software design, includes SD card reading controller, BMP image format conversion and the DMA transmission of digital video component signal, which will be created by the tool NIOS II IDE. Combine the software function and the hardware platform, we can transform BMP format image to SDI signal, and stably display the image on the monitor.

articleTitle: Lossless hyper-spectral image compression based on XCJRCT, discrete wavelet transform and set partitioning in hierarchical trees coding
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper proposed a new algorithm using invertible matrix transformation XCJRCT to eliminate the spectral redundancy, as well as combining with lifting scheme discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and set partitioning in hierarchical trees (SPIHT) coding. The experiment results show that the capabilities of lossless image compression are far better than JPEG-LS, WinZip, ARJ, and DPCM. With Canal test image (Band Sequential) of Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) as an example data set, the average compression ratio increases about 43.09%, 38.17%, 36.08% 31.08% respectively compared with the above algorithms.

articleTitle: A MST-based and new GA supported distribution network planning
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: After Optimal distribution substation locating, distribution feeder line planning remains the main problem in distribution system planning. Therefore, a MST-based and new GA algorithm for distribution network optimal planning is presented. To reduce computational time and avoid infeasible solution, two new operators are introduced to ensure that all individuals are feasible solution. Meanwhile, an electricity distribution network structure and feeder cross-sectional area selection simultaneous optimization model is adopted to deal with the weight of the minimal-cost system tree. This Combinatorial coding guaranties the validity of solution towards globe optimum. Finally, The method is examined in one real MV distribution network example.

articleTitle: Application of virtual instrument in vehicle detection system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The application of LabView multithreading technology has realized the high-speed data collection based on CAN (Controller Area Network) Bus and the real-time online monitor for battery system based on Excel applying dynamic link library, operational control and many other technologies. Meanwhile, it provides the function of the historical data records, which offers important reference for the operation of electric vehicle.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a uniform wireless OPC DA Server
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on the study of the drawback of traditional wired automatic control system and current wireless remote monitoring system in dealing with remote-placed and wide-spread-placed controlled objects, this paper gives out a new architecture using mobile communication networks and OPC technology. It uses Mobile Agent and Mobile Agent Server to ensure the transparent data exchange between controlled objects and OPC server. And Driver Layer and Factory Method Pattern is exploited to make it feasible that one OPC Server serves for different kinds of controlled objects. Also, the system is released as a platform. And it makes the manufactures no longer caring about how far, how wide and in which form the controlled objects are organized.

articleTitle: Design of an intermittent escape apparatus used in high-rise buildings based on escapement mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: An intermittent impact type escape apparatus used in high-rise buildings based on the principle of escapement mechanism usually applied in clock for time controlling was designed in this paper. The escapement mechanism in escape apparatus can consume gravitational potential energy of body. Applied the modularized design method, mechanical system of the escape apparatus consisted of a transmission system and a control system. Advanced mechanical design software was used to design each module structure in detail. The transmission system was composed of a uniquely designed wirerope antislip mechanism and a reversing gear. The wirerope antiskid mechanism effectively increased friction between the wirerope and the winding drum in order to prevent the wirerope relative sliding along the winding drum. The reversing gear greatly improved rescue efficiency by continually using the apparatus. The control system completed escape wheel periodically "locked to released to rotated to locked" movement. The speed governing scheme realized intermittent movement of main drive chain and made body fall intermittently. It was very important to apply modular synchronous design to shorten the design and installation cycle of escape apparatus.

articleTitle: A novel scheduling method of bandwidth optimization of the CAN network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper we present a bandwidth optimization scheduling method based on CAN (Controller Area Network) network .We construct a CAN network structure that contains a BOM ( Bandwidth Optimize Manager), which is used to limit the bandwidth occupancy rate of part of control sub-systems, and implement dynamically allocation for network bandwidth resources in the CAN control system. By comparing the value of the weighted summation between the control performance and network transmission performance, BOM selects part of control sub-systems with better overall performance, and pre-estimates the amount of bandwidth allocation of meeting the lowest bound of system's real-time transmission by autoregressive model. Simulation results show that our method can effectively allocate the bandwidth and reduce bandwidth demand, and greatly improve the overall performance of the CAN system.

articleTitle: Research on image vectorization based on mathematical morphology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Image vectorization plays an important role in the digital image processing. Because the traditional linear vectorization methods have some shortcomings including processing data slowerly, being sensitive to noises and being easy to be distorted, this paper proposes an image vectorization method based on mathematical morphology. This method consists of the image edge detection method based on the four structural elements template, the morphological sequential homotypic skeleton abstraction method based on the eight structural elements template and the vectorization method based on the dynamic change of pace about Freeman's chain code. Examples have proved that this method can abstract high precision skeletons rapidly and attain high accuracy vector data measured by the arc segment. This method has many advantages, such as the faster processing rate, the higher accuracy and the less storage space. So it has certain feasibility and practicability in digital image vectorization.

articleTitle: A drive circuit of MOSFET for ultrasonic power
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper designs a drive circuit of MOSFET for ultrasonic power. The requirements of high-speed drive circuit of MOSFET are presented based on the turn-on and turn-off processes. The design and implementation process of MOSFET driver circuit which meets the requirements of operation frequency to 1 MHz, electrical-isolated, strong driving capability, are discussed in detail. And the feasibility of the drive circuit is proved.

articleTitle: An approach of slicing for Object-Oriented language with exception handling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Based on analyzing the feature and exception handling mechanism of Object-Oriented language, this document proposes a new Object-Oriented System Dependence Graph with exception handling (EOSDG), which makes some improvements on System Dependence Graph (SDG). When dealing with data and control dependence caused by the exception treatment, EOSDG can deal with the complex polymorphism of Object-Oriented language, such as polymorphic object and polymorphic object being as a parameter. Experiments show that when using the traditional slicing algorithm, more accurate slice can be returned.

articleTitle: Study on transition charging method of lithium-ion battery based on the multiple model adaptive control
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For Traditional constant current/voltage charging method could cause temperature rise phenomenon with large current charging in later period, so this paper use transition charging method between constant current period and constant voltage period to adapt to the chemical reaction rate in the battery. And for the poor adaptability of general PI controller, this paper use multiple model adaptive control methods to improve the adaptability of controller and efficiency. It also ensure the accuracy and battery performance.

articleTitle: Sliding mode variable structure optimized control for micro-air-vehicle attitude control systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Micro-Air-Vehicle (MAV) is small and light. So it is very easily affected by action of various disturbing and disturbing torque. The MAV is also nonlinear and variable coefficient, pure delay, inertia, cross-coupling etc. These characteristics make the control of the aircraft get more complicated.This thesis takes advantage of the characteristic of Genetic Algorithm (GA) optimization control, combined with the characteristic of the sliding mode variable structure method to realize the MAV attitude control according to the adaption of the system disturbing and system perturbation. Simulation results show that the MAV attitude control scheme is robust and has good tracking performance.

articleTitle: The fuzzy robust cooperative control of the vehicle steering/anti-lock brake system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A new cooperative error was defined firstly and a new cooperative model of the vehicle was developed for the vehicle's steering antilock braking stability fields. A new two-level fuzzy robust cooperative control system was proposed. The architecture was composed with the execution layer and the cooperation layer. The uncertain parameters deteriorate the performance of the systems, so the yaw moment and the front wheel angle robust controllers in the execution layer based on the desired control index were designed to improve the respond, robustness and stability of the vehicle. The vehicle anti-lock brake robust controller was designed. In the cooperation layer, a new practical cooperative control law based on the optimal index and robustness was devised. In order to eliminate the conservation of the controllers, the fuzzy control method was introduced. Then the brake force distribution policy applicable to the complex work condition was presented .

articleTitle: Design and implementation of MCU and the Internet communication system based on GPRS
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: For such an environment, such as radiation, pollution, dangerous, distributed environment where the staff is not easy to reach, it is difficult to complete data collection and real-time monitoring through the traditional manual method. The study of remote wireless monitoring system, which based on the MCU (micro control unit programming) and GPRS (General Packet Radio Service) architecture, can well meet the needs of these applications. This paper introduces the overall system architecture, discusses in detail the key technology of the communication between MCU and the Internet. The reliability and real time performance of the system have been proved through practical application in the engineering project.

articleTitle: Analysis of high frequency transformer leakage in photovoltaic inverter
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Nowadays, exploring and using of new energy resources is becoming more and more important, especially solar energy. However, the development of solar power faces many difficulties, such as efficiency. The efficiency of the solar power generation system is determined by inverter, and the design of high frequency transformer is an important part in the inverter. In high-frequency fly-back transformer, leakage is a key parameter affecting energy consumption. In view of this situation, this paper analyzed methods of reducing leakage, and proposed a new method to calculate leakage through using the air gap, and then build a fly-back transformer model to verify this method.

articleTitle: Research on frequency hopping signals in radar receiver based on digital channelized method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: With its outstanding advantages in the antijamming communications, the frequency hopping technology is used in radar receivers. Based on the theoretical analysis of poly-phase structure in digital channelized receiver, a simple and reliable method technology for channel decision on frequency hopping (FH) signal is proposed. Simulation results certificate the design scheme is easy for hardware to realize.

articleTitle: Energy-saving analysis of neural network control based on PMV in a ship air conditioning system
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In this paper, the design of neural network approach is developed aiming at the control of the indoor thermal comfort in air-conditioned cabins. Thermal environment of an air-conditioned ship cabin is simulated and analyzed. From the simulation results, predicted mean vote (PMV) is maintained near zero value with the fluctuation range of ±0.36 under neural network control. As for energy consumption, energy consumption of neural network control is less than that of control strategy based on temperature feedback. 8.5% energy can be saved.

articleTitle: MPLS survivability choice schemes with QoS guarantees
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Multi-protocol Label Switching (MPLS) has become an attractive technology of choice for Internet backbone service providers because of the support of traffic engineering and quality of service (QoS). At present, the rapid growth of real-time and high-priority traffic over IP networks makes QoS assurances will be more important for guaranteed services with requirements. This paper summarizes various protection and restoration schemes of MPLS networks survivability with QoS guarantees, including their QoS requirements, algorithms, applications, pros and cons. We still integrate the survivability schemes of MPLS networks with DiffServ model in order to choose different survivability methods with QoS guarantees for different service classes.

articleTitle: On auto bionic modeling design study based on cognitive psychology theories
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to help the audience know better about the acknowledgement of auto bionic modeling, this thesis summarizes such research theories as Gestalt visual rules and mediocre visual effect theory that conform to the aesthetic rules of visual perception of the mankind by means of the analysis about the visual cognitive process of auto modeling and the study on the visual cognitive characteristics and rules. It highlights the importance of the affective interaction between the designer and the consumers in the process of auto bionic modeling design and it perception.

articleTitle: Comprehensive forecast system of the thickness of coal seam and its application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to improve prediction accuracy of coal seam thickness, this paper roundly enumerated existing forecast methods in terms of ground and underground. By difference characteristic analysis and suitability contrast evaluation of various forecast methods, we proposed a principle of comprehensive forecast that treating the geological analysis as the target, basing on drilling, bonding geological analysis, drilling and geophysical exploration, combining ground and underground data, fusing multi-information. On the basis of the principle, we established a system of comprehensive prediction. The applying of some coal mine result shows that comprehensive system of predicting coal seam thickness can enhance forecast precision, which had increased coal yield and promoted sustainable development of coal resources.

articleTitle: Image fusion algorithm based on fractal dimension and contrast in multi-wavelet transform domain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: In order to make full use of texture features of image when fusing images, and taking into account the inherent advantages of fractal theory in this respect, a novel image fusion algorithm, which used fractal dimension and directional contrast, based on multi-wavelet transform was proposed in this paper. This fusion algorithm decomposed original images needed to be fused by multi-wavelet transform firstly, then fractal dimensions of the corresponding decomposing low-frequency coefficients were calculated by Differential Box Counting method, and the low frequency fusion rule based on fractal dimension was set up. The high frequency parts were fused by selecting method or weighted averaging method according to the directional contrast values. The fusing experiment using this algorithm to IR image and visible light image was done. In order to illustrate the performance of the algorithm, particularly the impact of introduction of fractal theory on the fusion performance, the result of those fusion algorithms that only uses multi-wavelets transform were given as well. Moreover, the objective indexes, which are image entropy, standard deviation and quality measure, were adopted to evaluate the comparative results of evaluating fusion quality. The results show that the leading of fractal dimension into image fusion processing is effective, and it performs obviously better in increasing the amount of information, the standard deviation and the quality of fused image.

articleTitle: Application investigation on private cloud in the field of group company financial information management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The development of cloud computing technology provides a new option for construction of group company financial management information system. It can complete make up the shortages of traditional financial management mode through application of cloud computing technology. This paper brings forward the applicable scheme of private cloud technology on the construction of group company financial management information system based on private cloud service platform, and creates the overall architecture of new model of group company financial management information system. We hope that the construction progress of group company financial management information system can be pushed forward by this research.

articleTitle: Affective recognition from EMG signal: An approach based on correlation analysis and adaptive Tabu search
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: A novel feature selection method was proposed for electromyography (EMG)-based affective recognition. First of all, correlation analysis was used to reduce the dimension of original feature subset; then adaptive Tabu search algorithm combined with intensification and diversification strategies was adopted for feature selection, and mutation operator of genetic algorithm (GA) was implemented as the diversification strategy. The experimental results show that the method we proposed can achieve high recognition rates with low feature dimensions, and obtain stable and effective features for the establishment of affective recognition system.

articleTitle: A collaborative services grid portal architecture based on OGSA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on solving problems of the existing Grid Portal scalability, portability and adaptability. To overcome the weakness of collaborative services ability in different grid portal, a new grid portal architecture based on CSGPA (Collaborative Services Grid Portal Architecture), is proposed. The CSGPA is built on the basic of OGSA (Open Grid Services Architecture). It divides the grid service into Portlet grid service and application grid service, and separates the display logic from the application logic of grid portal. In the paper, the application system architecture of grid portal based on CSGPA is presented according to network topology and application distribution of grid system. In comparison with the current mainstream grid portal architecture, the results show that CSGPA has great advantage in efficiency, deployment costs, scalability and reusability etc. It is a better grid portal architecture.

articleTitle: Research on test executing system of spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: To meet the complex and variable characteristics of spacecraft testing business, and to increase the expandability of automated testing system, this paper proposed an architecture of spacecraft test executing system which is composed of test executing engine, business component library and registration center based on workflow. And discussed the key issues involved by the three parts of the architecture. Finally, this paper showed a typical application scenario under the architecture.

articleTitle: An algorithm of scenes description and analysis based on MRF
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Markov random fields (MRF) can be used for a wide variety of vision problems. In this paper we will propose an algorithm of scenes feature description and analysis based on MRF. The theoretical framework is based on MRF and Bayesian estimation via the energy optimization. We analyze the texture feature. Using MRF to modeling on the image, then combine with texture information and use of Bayesian to obtain the energy function, through the iterative optimization algorithm to minimize the energy function. Experimental results will be provided to illustrate the performance of our method.

articleTitle: Fractal features of cracking of self-monitoring asphalt concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: Self-monitoring asphalt concrete has a good electrical behavior. The monitoring of damage is valuable for structural health monitoring and service life prediction. In this paper, the process of cracking of self-monitoring asphalt concrete cracks were quantitatively described by indirect tensile test and combination of mathematical fractal theory. The test results show that the distribution of self-monitoring asphalt concrete crack has obviously statistical similarity, and cracks with a clear statistical significance of cracks on the fractal. There is a good congruent relationship among fractal dimension, resistance and deformation, which provides a new thought to the research of the cracking of self-monitoring asphalt concrete.

articleTitle: An exhaust muffler structure based on the expansion chamber
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: The new structure of muffler in simple expansion chamber muffed was designed in this paper. On the base of standard GB/T4760-1996, the testing rig was made to lower exhaust back pressure and reduce engine power consumption, and then three muffler prototypes were manufactured. Comparative analysis is done aim at some parameters, such as the acoustic pressure level of input and output, the sound pressure level difference and pressure difference between input and output. The test result shows that this structure achieves the requirement preferably in middle-high frequency noise.

articleTitle: Fractured vuggy reservoir prediction combined seismic and well logging data based on BP network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Mechatronic Science, Electric Engineering and Computer (MEC)
abstract: It is very difficult to detect and predict the fractured vuggy carbonate reservoirs because of their random and multi-scale spatial distribution. To address this problem, we unified the different sampling interval of seismic and well logging responses of the reservoirs by the mathematical method, within a certain dimension. Then discussed the correlation of them by the multiple linear regression(MLR). On that basis, we established the BP neural network model to predict the effective thickness of the reservoirs. The results shows that the thickness and the developed zone of fracture cavity can be predicted in combination of three dynamic attributes of seismic, i.e. amplitude, 3-D coherence data and attenuation factors of frequency. We conclude that the method to predict the thickness of reservoirs is very practical with an effective and believable result and it could be widely used in predicting other parameters of carbonate reservoirs as well.
